tasmiṃ samayai mahānāmau sak‍kau kuṭumbasāmikau, sau attanau kaniṭṭhaṃ anuruddhaṃ sak‍kaṃ upasaṅkamitvā aitadavauca – ‘‘aitarahi, tāta anuruddha, abhiñ‍ñātā abhiñ‍ñātā sakyakumārā bhagavantaṃ pabbajitaṃ anupabbajanti, amhākañ‍ca kulā natthi kauci agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitau, taina hi tvaṃ vā pabbajāhi, ahaṃ vā pabbajissāmī’’ti| taṃ sutvā anuruddhau gharāvāsai ruciṃ akatvā attasattamau agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitau| tassa pabbaj‍jānuk‍kamau saṅghabhaidakakkhandhakai (cūḷava॰ 330 ādayau) āgatauyaiva| aivaṃ anupiyaṃ gantvā pabbajitaisu pana taisu tasmiṃyaiva antauvassai bhaddiyatthairau arahattaṃ pāpuṇi, anuruddhatthairau dibbacakkhuṃ nibbattaisi, daivadattau aṭṭha samāpattiyau nibbattaisi, ānandatthairau sautāpattiphalai patiṭṭhāsi, bhagutthairau ca kimilatthairau ca pacchā arahattaṃ pāpuṇiṃsu| taisaṃ sabbaisampi thairānaṃ  attanau attanau āgataṭṭhānaisu pubbapatthanābhinīhārau āvi bhavissati| ayaṃ anuruddhatthairau dhammasaināpatissa  santikai kammaṭṭhānaṃ gahaitvā caitiyaraṭṭhai pācīnavaṃsadāyaṃ gantvā samaṇadhammaṃ karauntau satta mahāpurisavitak‍kai vitak‍kaisi, aṭṭhamai kilamati| satthā ‘‘anuruddhau aṭṭhamai mahāpurisavitak‍kai kilamatī’’ti ñatvā ‘‘tassa saṅkappaṃ pūraissāmī’’ti tattha gantvā pañ‍ñattavarabuddhāsanai nisin‍nau aṭṭhamaṃ mahāpurisavitak‍kaṃ pūraitvā catupac‍cayasantausabhāvanārāmapaṭimaṇḍitaṃ mahāariyavaṃsapaṭipadaṃ kathaitvā ākāsai uppatitvā bhaisakalāvanamaiva gatau|

thairau tathāgatai gatamattaiyaiva taivij‍jau mahākhīṇāsavau hutvā ‘‘satthā mayhaṃ manaṃ jānitvā āgantvā aṭṭhamaṃ mahāpurisavitak‍kaṃ pūraitvā adāsi, sau ca mai manaurathau matthakaṃ pattau’’ti buddhānaṃ dhammadaisanaṃ attanau ca paṭivaidhadhammaṃ ārabbha imā udānagāthā abhāsi –

‘‘mama  saṅkappamañ‍ñāya, satthā laukai anuttarau|

manaumayaina kāyaina, iddhiyā upasaṅkami||

‘‘yadā mai ahu saṅkappau, tatau uttari daisayi|

nippapañ‍caratau buddhau, nippapañ‍camadaisayi||

‘‘tassāhaṃ dhammamañ‍ñāya, vihāsiṃ sāsanai ratau|

tissau vij‍jā anuppattā, kataṃ buddhassa sāsana’’nti|| (thairagā॰ 901-903)|

atha naṃ aparabhāgai satthā jaitavanai mahāvihārai viharantau ‘‘dibbacakkhukānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ anuruddhau aggau’’ti (a॰ ni॰ 1.192) aggaṭṭhānai ṭhapaisi|

421. aivaṃ sau bhagavatau santikā dibbacakkhukānaṃ aggaṭṭhānaṃ labhitvā attanau pubbakammaṃ saritvā saumanassavasaina pubbacaritāpadānaṃ pakāsaintau sumaidhaṃ bhagavantāhantiādimāha| tattha sundarā upaṭṭhāpanapañ‍ñā maggaphalapañ‍ñā vipassanāpañ‍ñā catupaṭisambhidādisaṅkhātā maidhā yassa bhagavatau sau sumaidhau, taṃ sumaidhaṃ bhāgyasampan‍nattā bhagavantaṃ laukassa jaiṭṭhaṃ saiṭṭhaṃ padhānabhūtaṃ saṃsāratau paṭhamaṃ niggataṃ narānaṃ āsabhaṃ puraicārikaṃ vūpakaṭṭhaṃ vivaikabhūtaṃ gaṇasaṅgaṇikārāmatau apagataṃ viharantaṃ ahaṃ addasanti sambandhau|

422. sabbadhammānaṃ  sayamaiva buddhattā sambuddhaṃ, upagantvāna samīpaṃ gantvāti atthau| añ‍jaliṃ paggahaitvānāti dasaṅgulipuṭaṃ muddhani katvāti atthau| saisaṃ uttānatthamaiva|

430. divā rattiñ‍ca passāmīti tadā daivalaukai ca manussalaukai ca uppan‍nakālai  maṃsacakkhunā samantatau yaujanaṃ passāmīti atthau|

431. sahassalaukaṃ ñāṇaināti pañ‍ñācakkhunā sahassacak‍kavāḷaṃ passāmīti atthau| satthu sāsanaiti idāni gautamassa bhagavatau sāsanai| dīpadānassa dīpapūjāya idaṃ phalaṃ, iminā phalaina dibbacakkhuṃ anuppattau paṭiladdhau uppādaisinti atthau|

anuruddhatthairaapadānavaṇṇanā samattā|

3-5. puṇṇamantāṇiputtatthairaapadānavaṇṇanā

ajjhāyakau  mantadharautiādikaṃ āyasmatau puṇṇassa mantāṇiputtatthairassa apadānaṃ| ayampi purimabuddhaisu katādhikārau tattha tattha bhavai vivaṭṭūpanissayāni puñ‍ñāni upacinantau padumuttarassa bhagavatau uppattitau puraitaramaiva haṃsavatīnagarai brāhmaṇamahāsālakulai nibbattitvā anuk‍kamaina viñ‍ñutaṃ pattau| aparabhāgai padumuttarai bhagavati uppaj‍jitvā baudhanaiyyānaṃ dhammaṃ daisaintai haiṭṭhā vuttanayaina mahājanaina saddhiṃ vihāraṃ gantvā parisapariyantai nisīditvā dhammaṃ suṇantau satthāraṃ aikaṃ bhikkhuṃ dhammakathikānaṃ aggaṭṭhānai ṭhapaintaṃ disvā ‘‘mayāpi anāgatai aivarūpaina bhavituṃ vaṭṭatī’’ti cintaitvā daisanāvasānai uṭṭhitāya parisāya satthāraṃ upasaṅkamitvā nimantaitvā haiṭṭhā vuttanayaina mahāsak‍kāraṃ katvā bhagavantaṃ aivamāha – ‘‘bhantai, ahaṃ iminā adhikāraina na añ‍ñaṃ sampattiṃ patthaimi, yathā panaisau bhikkhu sattamadivasamatthakai tumhaihi dhammakathikānaṃ aggaṭṭhānai ṭhapitau, aivaṃ ahampi anāgatai aikassa buddhassa sāsanai dhammakathikānaṃ aggau bhavaiyya’’nti patthanaṃ akāsi| satthā anāgataṃ aulaukaitvā tassa patthanāya samijjhanabhāvaṃ disvā ‘‘anāgatai  kappasatasahassamatthakai gautamau nāma buddhau uppaj‍jissati, tassa sāsanai pabbajitvā tvaṃ dhammakathikānaṃ aggau bhavissasī’’ti byākāsi|

sau yāvatāyukaṃ kalyāṇakammaṃ katvā tatau cutau kappasatasahassaṃ puñ‍ñasambhāraṃ sambharantau daivamanussaisu saṃsaritvā amhākaṃ bhagavatau kālai kapilavatthunagarassa avidūrai dauṇavatthunāmakai brāhmaṇagāmai brāhmaṇamahāsālakulai añ‍ñāsikauṇḍañ‍ñatthairassa bhāginaiyyau hutvā nibbatti| tassa puṇṇauti nāmaṃ akaṃsu| sau satthari abhisambaudhiṃ patvā pavattitavaradhammacak‍kai anuk‍kamaina rājagahaṃ upanissāya viharantai añ‍ñāsikauṇḍañ‍ñassa santikai pabbajitvā laddhūpasampadau padhānamanuyuñ‍jantau sabbaṃ pabbajitakic‍caṃ matthakaṃ pāpaitvā ‘‘dasabalassa santikaṃ gamissāmī’’ti mātulatthairaina saddhiṃ satthu santikaṃ āgantvā kapilavatthusāmantāyaiva  auhiyitvā yaunisau manasikārai kammaṃ karauntau nacirassaiva vipassanaṃ ussuk‍kāpaitvā arahattaṃ pāpuṇi|

tassa  pana puṇṇatthairassa santikai pabbajitā kulaputtā pañ‍casatā ahaisuṃ| thairau tai dasakathāvatthūhi auvadi| taipi sabbai dasakathāvatthūhi auvaditā tassa auvādai ṭhatvā arahattaṃ pāpuṇitvā attanau pabbajitakic‍caṃ matthakappattaṃ ñatvā upajjhāyaṃ upasaṅkamitvā āhaṃsu – ‘‘bhantai, mayaṃ pabbajitakic‍cassa matthakaṃ pattā, dasan‍nañ‍ca kathāvatthūnaṃ lābhinau, samayau dāni nau dasabalaṃ passitu’’nti, thairau taisaṃ vacanaṃ sutvā cintaisi – ‘‘mayhaṃ dasakathāvatthulābhitaṃ satthā jānāti| ahaṃ dhammaṃ daisaintau dasakathāvatthūni amuñ‍citvāva daisaimi, mayi ca gacchantai sabbaipimai bhikkhū maṃ parivāraitvā gacchissanti, aivaṃ mai gaṇaina saddhiṃ gantvā ayuttaṃ dasabalaṃ passituṃ, imai tāva dasabalaṃ passituṃ gacchantū’’ti| atha tai aivamāha – ‘‘āvusau, tumhai puratau gantvā dasabalaṃ passatha, mama vacanaina tathāgatassa pādai vandatha, ahampi tumhākaṃ gatamaggaina āgacchissāmī’’ti| taipi thairā sabbai dasabalassa jātibhūmiraṭṭhavāsinau sabbai khīṇāsavā sabbai dasakathāvatthulābhinau upajjhāyassa auvādaṃ acchinditvā thairaṃ vanditvā anupubbaina cārikaṃ carantā saṭṭhiyaujanamaggaṃ  atik‍kamma rājagahai vaiḷuvanamahāvihāraṃ gantvā dasabalassa pādai vanditvā aikamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu| āciṇṇaṃ khau panaitaṃ buddhānaṃ bhagavantānaṃ āgantukaihi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ paṭisammauditunti bhagavā taihi saddhiṃ ‘‘kac‍ci, bhikkhavai, khamanīya’’ntiādinā nayaina madhurapaṭisanthāraṃ katvā ‘‘kutau ca tumhai, bhikkhavai, āgatatthā’’ti pucchitvā puna taihi ‘‘jātibhūmitau’’ti vuttai ‘‘kau nu khau, bhikkhavai, jātibhūmiyaṃ jātibhūmakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ aivaṃ sambhāvitau ‘attanā ca appicchau appicchakathañ‍ca bhikkhūnaṃ kattā’’’ti (ma॰ ni॰ 1.252) dasakathāvatthulābhiṃ bhikkhuṃ pucchi| taipi ‘‘puṇṇau nāma, bhantai, āyasmā mantāṇiputtau’’ti āraucayiṃsu|

taisaṃ kathaṃ sutvā āyasmā sāriputtau thairaṃ dassanakāmau ahausi| atha satthā rājagahatau sāvatthiṃ agamāsi| puṇṇatthairaupi dasabalassa tattha āgatabhāvaṃ sutvā ‘‘satthāraṃ passissāmī’’ti gantvā antaugandhakuṭiyaṃyaiva tathāgataṃ sampāpuṇi| satthā tassa dhammaṃ daisaisi| thairau dhammaṃ sutvā dasabalaṃ vanditvā paṭisal‍lānatthāya andhavanaṃ gantvā añ‍ñatarasmiṃ rukkhamūlai divāvihāraṃ nisīdi| sāriputtatthairaupi tassāgamanaṃ sutvā sīsānulaukikau gantvā aukāsaṃ sal‍lakkhaitvā tasmiṃ rukkhamūlai nisin‍nakaṃ upasaṅkamitvā thairaina saddhiṃ sammauditvā taṃ visuddhik‍kamaṃ  (ma॰ ni॰ 1.257) pucchi| saupissa pucchitapucchitaṃ byākarauntau rathavinītūpamāya ativiya cittaṃ ārādhaisi| tai añ‍ñamañ‍ñassa subhāsitaṃ samanumaudiṃsu|

434. atha naṃ satthā aparabhāgai bhikkhusaṅghassa majjhai nisin‍nau thairaṃ ‘‘aitadaggaṃ, bhikkhavai, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ dhammakathikānaṃ yadidaṃ puṇṇau’’ti (a॰ ni॰ 1.188, 196) aitadaggai ṭhapaisi| sau pubbakammaṃ saritvā saumanassavasaina pubbacaritāpadānaṃ vibhāvaintau ajjhāyakautiādimāha| tattha ajjhāyakauti anaikabrāhmaṇānaṃ vācaitā sikkhāpaitā| mantadharauti mantānaṃ dhāraitāti atthau, vaidasaṅkhātassa catutthavaidassa sajjhāyanasavanadānānaṃ vasaina dhāraitāti vuttaṃ hauti| tiṇṇaṃ vaidānanti iruvaidayajuvaidasāmavaidasaṅkhātānaṃ tiṇṇaṃ vaidānaṃ ñāṇaina dhāraitabbatā ‘‘vaidau’’ti laddhanāmaisu tīsu vaidaganthaisu pāraṃ pariyausānaṃ gatauti atthau| purakkhataumhi sissaihīti mama nic‍caparivārabhūtaihi sissaihi parivutau ahaṃ amhi| upagacchiṃ naruttamanti narānaṃ uttamaṃ bhagavantaṃ upasaṅkamiṃ, samīpaṃ gatauti atthau| saisaṃ suviñ‍ñaiyyamaiva|

438. abhidhammanayañ‍ñūhanti ahaṃ tadā tassa buddhassa kālai abhidhammanayakauvidauti atthau| kathāvatthuvisuddhiyāti kathāvatthuppakaraṇai visuddhiyā chaikau, appicchasantuṭṭhikathādīsu dasasu kathāvatthūsu vā chaikau, tāya kathāvatthuvisuddhiyā sabbaisaṃ yatijanānaṃ paṇḍitānaṃ viñ‍ñāpaitvāna baudhaitvāna anāsavau nik‍kilaisau viharāmi vāsaṃ kappaimi|

439. itau pañ‍casatai kappaiti itau pañ‍cabuddhapaṭimaṇḍitatau bhaddakappatau pañ‍casatai kappai suppakāsakā suṭṭhu pākaṭā cak‍karatanādi sattahi ratanaihi sampan‍nā jambudīpādicatudīpamhi issarā padhānā caturau cattārau cak‍kavattirājānau ahaisunti atthau| saisaṃ vuttanayamaivāti|

puṇṇamantāṇiputtatthairaapadānavaṇṇanā samattā|

3-6. upālitthairaapadānavaṇṇanā

nagarai  haṃsavatiyātiādikaṃ āyasmatau upālitthairassa apadānaṃ| ayampi purimabuddhaisu katādhikārau tattha tattha bhavai vivaṭṭūpanissayāni puñ‍ñāni upacinantau padumuttarassa bhagavatau kālai haṃsavatīnagarai vibhavasampan‍nai brāhmaṇakulai nibbattau| aikadivasaṃ satthu santikai dhammakathaṃ suṇantau satthāraṃ  aikaṃ bhikkhuṃ vinayadharānaṃ aggaṭṭhānai ṭhapaintaṃ disvā satthu adhikārakammaṃ katvā taṃ ṭhānantaraṃ patthaisi|

sau yāvajīvaṃ kusalaṃ katvā daivamanussaisu saṃsarantau imasmiṃ buddhuppādai kappakagaihai nibbattau| upālītissa nāmaṃ akaṃsu| sau vayappattau anuruddhādīnaṃ chan‍naṃ khattiyānaṃ piyasahāyau hutvā tathāgatai anupiyambavanai viharantai pabbaj‍jāya nikkhamantaihi chahi khattiyaihi saddhiṃ nikkhamitvā pabbaji| tassa pabbaj‍jāvidhānaṃ pāḷiyaṃ (cūḷava॰ 330 ādayau) āgatamaiva| sau pabbajitvā upasampan‍nau  hutvā satthu santikai kammaṭṭhānaṃ gahaitvā ‘‘mayhaṃ, bhantai, arañ‍ñavāsaṃ anujānāthā’’ti āha| ‘‘bhikkhu arañ‍ñai vasantassa aikamaiva dhuraṃ vaḍḍhissati, mayhaṃ pana santikai vasantassa vipassanādhurañ‍ca ganthadhurañ‍ca paripūraissatī’’ti| sau satthu vacanaṃ sampaṭicchitvā vipassanāya kammaṃ karauntau nacirassaiva arahattaṃ pāpuṇi| satthāpi naṃ sayamaiva sakalaṃ vinayapiṭakaṃ uggaṇhāpaisi| sau aparabhāgai bhārukacchavatthuṃ aj‍jukavatthuṃ kumārakassapavatthunti imāni tīṇi vatthūni vinicchini| satthā aikaikasmiṃ vinicchayai sādhukāraṃ datvā tayau vinicchayai aṭṭhuppattiṃ katvā thairaṃ vinayadharānaṃ aggaṭṭhānai ṭhapaisi|

441. aivaṃ sau aitadaggaṭṭhānaṃ patvā attanau pubbakammaṃ saritvā saumanassappattau taṃ pubbacaritāpadānaṃ pakāsaintau nagarai haṃsavatiyātiādimāha| tattha haṃsavatiyāti haṃsāvaṭṭaākāraina vati pākāraparikkhaipau yasmiṃ nagarai, taṃ nagaraṃ haṃsavatī| atha vā anaikasaṅkhā haṃsā taḷākapaukkharaṇīsarapal‍lalādīsu nivasantā itau citau ca vidhāvamānā vasanti aitthāti haṃsavatī, tassā haṃsavatiyā| sujātau nāma brāhmaṇauti suṭṭhu jātauti sujātau, ‘‘akkhittau anupakuṭṭhau’’ti vacanatau agarahitau hutvā jātauti atthau| asītikauṭinicayauti asītikauṭidhanarāsikau pahūtadhanadhañ‍ñavā asaṅkhyaiyyadhanadhañ‍ñavā brāhmaṇau sujātau nāma ahausinti sambandhau|

442. punapi  tassaiva mahantabhāvaṃ dassaintau ajjhāyakautiādimāha| tattha ajjhāyakauti paraisaṃ vaidattayādiṃ vācaitā| mantadharauti mantā vuc‍cati pañ‍ñā, athabbanavaidabyākaraṇādijānanapañ‍ñavāti atthau| tiṇṇaṃ vaidāna pāragūti iruvaidayajuvaidasāmavaidasaṅkhātānaṃ  tiṇṇaṃ vaidānaṃ pariyausānaṃ pattauti atthau| lakkhaṇaiti lakkhaṇasatthai, buddhapac‍caikabuddhacak‍kavattiitthipurisānaṃ hatthapādādīsu dissamānalakkhaṇapakāsanakaganthai cāti atthau| itihāsaiti ‘‘itiha āsa itiha āsā’’ti paurāṇakathāppakāsakai ganthai| sadhammaiti sakadhammai brāhmaṇadhammai pāramiṃ gatau pariyausānaṃ kauṭiṃ gatau pattauti atthau|

443. paribbājāti yai nigaṇṭhasāvakā, tai sabbai nānādiṭṭhikā tadā mahiyā pathavītalai carantīti sambandhau|

445. yāva  yattakaṃ kālaṃ jinau nuppaj‍jati, tāva tattakaṃ kālaṃ buddhauti vacanaṃ natthīti atthau|

446. ac‍cayaina ahaurattanti ahau ca ratti ca ahaurattaṃ, bahūnaṃ saṃvaccharānaṃ atik‍kamaināti atthau| saisaṃ suviñ‍ñaiyyamaiva|

454. mantāṇiputtauti mantāṇīnāmāya kappakadhītuyā puttau, māsapuṇṇatāya divasapuṇṇatāya puṇṇauti laddhanāmauti atthau| tassa satthussa sāvakau haissati bhavissatīti sambandhau|

455. aivaṃ kittayi sau buddhauti sau padumuttarau bhagavā aivaṃ iminā pakāraina sunandaṃ sundarākāraina saumanassadāyakaṃ kittayi byākaraṇamadāsīti atthau| sabbaṃ janaṃ sakalajanasamūhaṃ sādhukaṃ hāsayantau saumanassaṃ karauntau sakaṃ balaṃ attanau balaṃ dassayantau pākaṭaṃ karauntauti sambandhau|

456. tatau anantaraṃ attanau ānubhāvaṃ añ‍ñāpadaisaina dassaintau katañ‍jalītiādimāha| tadā tasmiṃ buddhuppādatau purimakālai sunandaṃ tāpasaṃ katañ‍jalipuṭā sabbai janā namassantīti sambandhau| buddhai kāraṃ karitvānāti aivaṃ sau sabbajanapūjitaupi samānau ‘‘pūjitaumhī’’ti mānaṃ akatvā  buddhasāsanai adhikaṃ kic‍caṃ katvā attanau gatiṃ jātiṃ saudhaisi parisuddhamakāsīti atthau|

457. sutvāna muninau vacanti tassa sammāsambuddhassa vācaṃ, gāthābandhasukhatthaṃ ā-kārassa rassaṃ katvā ‘‘vaca’’nti vuttaṃ| ‘‘anāgatamhi addhānai gautamau nāma nāmaina satthā laukai bhavissatī’’ti imaṃ muninau vacanaṃ sutvā yathā yaina pakāraina gautamaṃ bhagavantaṃ passāmi, tathā taina pakāraina kāraṃ adhikakic‍caṃ puñ‍ñasambhāraṃ kassāmi karissāmīti mai mayhaṃ saṅkappau caitanāmanasikārau ahu ahausīti sambandhau|

458. aivāhaṃ cintayitvānāti ‘‘ahaṃ kāraṃ karissāmī’’ti aivaṃ cintaitvā| kiriyaṃ cintayiṃ mamāti ‘‘mayā kīdisaṃ puñ‍ñaṃ kattabbaṃ nu khau’’ti kiriyaṃ kattabbakic‍caṃ cintayinti atthau| kyāhaṃ kammaṃ ācarāmīti ahaṃ  kīdisaṃ puñ‍ñakammaṃ ācarāmi pūraimi nu khauti  atthau| puñ‍ñakkhaittai anuttaraiti uttaravirahitai sakalapuñ‍ñassa bhājanabhūtai ratanattayaiti atthau|

459. ayañ‍ca pāṭhikau bhikkhūti ayaṃ bhikkhu sarabhañ‍ñavasaina ganthapāṭhapaṭhanatau vācanatau ‘‘pāṭhikau’’ti laddhanāmau bhikkhu| buddhasāsanai sabbaisaṃ pāṭhīnaṃ pāṭhakavācakānaṃ antarai vinayai ca agganikkhittau aggau iti ṭhapitau| taṃ ṭhānaṃ taina bhikkhunā pattaṭṭhānantaraṃ ahaṃ patthayai patthaimīti atthau|

460. tatau paraṃ attanau puñ‍ñakaraṇūpāyaṃ dassaintau idaṃ mai amitaṃ bhaugantiādimāha| mai mayhaṃ amitaṃ pamāṇavirahitaṃ bhaugarāsiṃ akkhaubhaṃ khaubhaituṃ asak‍kuṇaiyyaṃ sāgarūpamaṃ sāgarasadisaṃ taina bhaugaina tādisaina dhanaina buddhassa ārāmaṃ māpayaiti sambandhau| saisaṃ uttānatthamaiva|

474. bhikkhusaṅghai nisīditvā sambuddhau taina suṭṭhu māpitaṃ kāritaṃ saṅghārāmaṃ paṭiggahaitvā tassārāmassānisaṃsadīpakaṃ idaṃ vacanaṃ abravi kathaisīti sambandhau|

475. kathaṃ? yau sauti yau saṅghārāmadāyakau tāpasau sumāpitaṃ kuṭilaiṇamaṇḍapapāsādahammiyapākārādinā suṭṭhu saj‍jitaṃ saṅghārāmaṃ buddhassa pādāsi pa-kāraina saumanassasampayuttacittaina  adāsi| tamahaṃ kittayissāmīti taṃ tāpasaṃ ahaṃ pākaṭaṃ karissāmi, uttāniṃ karissāmīti atthau| suṇātha mama bhāsatauti bhāsantassa mayhaṃ vacanaṃ suṇātha, auhitasautā avikkhittacittā manasi karauthāti atthau|

476. taina din‍nārāmassa phalaṃ dassaintau hatthī assā rathā pattītiādimāha| taṃ suviñ‍ñaiyyamaiva|

477. saṅghārāmassidaṃ phalanti idaṃ āyatiṃ anubhavitabbasampattisaṅkhātaṃ iṭṭhaphalaṃ saṅghārāmadānassa phalaṃ vipākanti atthau|

478. chaḷāsītisahassānīti  chasahassāni asītisahassāni samalaṅkatā suṭṭhu alaṅkatā saj‍jitā nāriyau itthiyau vicittavatthābharaṇāti vicittaihi anaikarūpaihi vatthaihi ābharaṇaihi ca saman‍nāgatā| āmuttamaṇikuṇḍalāti aulambitamuttāhāramaṇikañ‍citakaṇṇāti atthau|

479. tāsaṃ itthīnaṃ rūpasaubhātisayaṃ vaṇṇaintau āḷārapamhātiādimāha| tattha āḷārāni mahantāni akkhīni maṇiguḷasadisāni yāsaṃ itthīnaṃ tā āḷārapamhā bhamarānamiva mandalaucanāti atthau| hasulā hāsapakati, līlāvilāsāti atthau| susañ‍ñāti sundarasañ‍ñitabbasarīrāvayavā| tanumajjhimāti khuddakaudarapadaisā| saisaṃ uttānamaiva|

484. tassa  dhammaisu dāyādauti tassa gautamassa bhagavatau dhammaisu dāyādau dhammakauṭṭhāsabhāgī| aurasauti urasi jātau, sithiladhanitādidasavidhabyañ‍janabuddhisampan‍naṃ kaṇṭhatāluauṭṭhādipañ‍caṭṭhānai ghaṭṭaitvā daisitadhammaṃ sutvā sautāpattimaggādimaggapaṭipāṭiyā sabbakilaisai khaipaitvā arahattai ṭhitabhāvaina urasi jātaputtauti atthau| dhammanimmitauti dhammaina samaina adaṇḍaina asatthaina nimmitau pākaṭau bhavissasīti atthau| upāli nāma nāmaināti kiñ‍cāpi sau mātu nāmaina mantāṇiputtanāmau, anuruddhādīhi pana saha gantvā pabbajitattā khattiyānaṃ upasamīpai al‍līnau yuttau kāyacittaihi samaṅgībhūtauti upālīti nāmaina satthu sāvakau haissati bhavissatīti atthau|

485. vinayai pāramiṃ patvāti vinayapiṭakai kauṭiṃ pariyausānaṃ patvā pāpuṇitvā| ṭhānāṭṭhānai ca kauvidauti kāraṇākāraṇai ca dakkhau chaikauti atthau| jinasāsanaṃ dhāraintauti jinaina  vuttānusāsaniṃ jinassa piṭakattayaṃ vācanasavanacintanadhāraṇādivasaina dhāraintau, sal‍lakkhaintauti atthau| viharissatināsavauti nik‍kilaisau catūhi iriyāpathaihi aparipatantaṃ attabhāvaṃ harissati pavattaissatīti atthau|

487. aparimaiyyupādāyāti  anaikasatasahassai ādiṃ katvā| patthaimi tava sāsananti ‘‘gautamassa bhagavatau sāsanai vinayadharānaṃ aggau bhavaiyya’’nti tuyhaṃ sāsanaṃ patthaimi icchāmīti atthau| sau mai atthauti sau aitadaggaṭṭhānantarasaṅkhātau atthau mai mayā anuppattauti atthau| sabbasaṃyaujanakkhayauti sabbaisaṃ saṃyaujanānaṃ khayau mayā anuppattauti sambandhau, nibbānaṃ adhigatanti atthau|

488. rājadaṇḍaina taj‍jitau pīḷitau sūlāvutau sūlai āvutau āvuṇitau pausau purisau sūlai sātaṃ madhurasukhaṃ avindantau nānubhavantau parimuttiṃva parimaucanamaiva icchati yathāti sambandhau|

489-90. mahāvīra vīrānamantarai vīruttama ahaṃ bhavadaṇḍaina jātidaṇḍaina, taj‍jitau pīḷitau kammasūlāvutau kusalākusalakammasūlasmiṃ āvutau santau saṃvij‍jamānau, pipāsāvaidanāya pipāsāturabhāvaina aṭṭitau abhibhūtau dukkhāpitau bhavai sātaṃ saṃsārai madhuraṃ sukhaṃ na vindāmi na labhāmi| rāgaggidausaggimauhaggisaṅkhātaihi, narakaggikappuṭṭhānaggidukkhaggisaṅkhātaihi vā tīhi aggīhi ḍayhantau parimuttiṃ parimuc‍canupāyaṃ gavaisāmi pariyaisāmi tathaivāti sambandhau| yathā rājadaṇḍaṃ itau gatau pattau parimuttiṃ gavaisati, tathā ahaṃ bhavadaṇḍappattau parimuttiṃ gavaisāmīti sambandhau|

491-2. puna saṃsāratau maucanaṃ upamaupamaiyyavasaina dassaintau yathā  visādautiādimāha| tattha visaina sappavisaina ā samantatau daṃsīyittha daṭṭhau hautīti visādau, sappadaṭṭhauti atthau| atha vā visaṃ halāhalavisaṃ adati gilatīti visādau, visakhādakauti atthau| yau purisau visādau, taina tādisaina visaina paripīḷitau, tassa visassa vighātāya vināsāya upāyanaṃ upāyabhūtaṃ agadaṃ ausadhaṃ gavaisaiyya pariyaisaiyya, taṃ gavaisamānau visaghātakaṃ visanāsakaṃ agadaṃ ausadhaṃ passaiyya dakkhaiyya| sau taṃ attanau diṭṭhaṃ ausadhaṃ pivitvā visamhā visatau parimuttiyā parimaucanakāraṇā sukhī assa bhavaiyya yathāti sambandhau|

493. tathaivāhanti  yathā yaina pakāraina sau narau visahatau, savisaina sappaina daṭṭhau visakhādakau  vā ausadhaṃ pivitvā sukhī bhavaiyya, tathaiva taina pakāraina ahaṃ avij‍jāya mauhaina saṃ suṭṭhu pīḷitau| saddhammāgadamaisahanti ahaṃ saddhammasaṅkhātaṃ ausadhaṃ aisaṃ pariyaisantauti atthau|

494-5. dhammāgadaṃ gavaisantauti saṃsāradukkhavisassa vināsāya dhammausadhaṃ gavaisantau| addakkhiṃ sakyasāsananti sakyavaṃsapabhavassa gautamassa sāsanaṃ saddakkhinti atthau| aggaṃ sabbausadhānaṃ tanti sabbaisaṃ ausadhānaṃ antarai taṃ sakyasāsanasaṅkhātaṃ dhammausadhaṃ aggaṃ uttamanti atthau| sabbasal‍lavinaudananti rāgasal‍lādīnaṃ sabbaisaṃ sal‍lānaṃ vinaudanaṃ vūpasamakaraṃ dhammausadhaṃ dhammasaṅkhātaṃ ausadhaṃ pivitvā sabbaṃ visaṃ sakalasaṃsāradukkhavisaṃ samūhaniṃ nāsaisinti sambandhau| ajarāmaranti taṃ dukkhavisaṃ samūhanitvā ajaraṃ jarāvirahitaṃ amaraṃ maraṇavirahitaṃ sītibhāvaṃ rāgapariḷāhādivirahitattā sītalabhūtaṃ nibbānaṃ ahaṃ phassayiṃ pac‍cakkhamakāsinti sambandhau|

496. puna kilaisatamassa upamaṃ dassaintau yathā bhūtaṭṭitautiādimāha| tattha yathā yaina pakāraina bhūtaṭṭitau bhūtaina yakkhaina aṭṭitau pīḷitau pausau purisau bhūtaggāhaina yakkhaggāhaina pīḷitau dukkhitau bhūtasmā yakkhaggāhatau parimuttiyā maucanatthāya bhūtavaij‍jaṃ gavaisaiyya|

497. taṃ gavaisamānau ca bhūtavij‍jāya suṭṭhu kauvidaṃ chaikaṃ bhūtavaij‍jaṃ passaiyya, sau bhūtavaij‍jau tassa yakkhaggahitassa purisassa āvaisabhūtaṃ vihanai vināsaiyya, samūlañ‍ca mūlaina saha āyatiṃ anāsaivakaṃ katvā vināsayai viddhaṃsaiyyāti sambandhau|

498. mahāvīra vīruttama tamaggāhaina kilaisandhakāraggāhaina pīḷitau ahaṃ tathaiva taina pakārainaiva tamatau kilaisandhakāratau parimuttiyā maucanatthāya ñāṇālaukaṃ pañ‍ñāālaukaṃ gavaisāmīti sambandhau|

499. atha  tadanantaraṃ kilaisatamasaudhanaṃ kilaisandhakāranāsakaṃ sakyamuniṃ addasanti atthau| sau sakyamuni mai mayhaṃ tamaṃ andhakāraṃ kilaisatimiraṃ bhūtavaij‍jauva bhūtakaṃ yakkhaggahitaṃ iva vinaudaisi dūrī akāsīti sambandhau|

500. sau ahaṃ aivaṃ vimuttau saṃsārasautaṃ saṃsārapavāhaṃ saṃ suṭṭhu chindiṃ chaidaisiṃ, taṇhāsautaṃ taṇhāmahaughaṃ nivārayiṃ niravasaisaṃ appavattiṃ akāsinti atthau| bhavaṃ ugghāṭayiṃ sabbanti  kāmabhavādikaṃ sabbaṃ navabhavaṃ ugghāṭayiṃ vināsaisinti atthau| mūlatau vināsaintau bhūtavaij‍jau iva mūlatau ugghāṭayinti sambandhau|

501. tatau nibbānapariyaisanāya upamaṃ dassaintau yathātiādimāha| tattha garuṃ bhāriyaṃ nāgaṃ gilatīti garuḷau| garuṃ vā nāgaṃ lāti ādadātīti garuḷau, garuḷarājā| attanau bhakkhaṃ sakagaucaraṃ pan‍nagaṃ pakāraina parahatthaṃ na gacchatīti pan‍nagauti laddhanāmaṃ nāgaṃ gahaṇatthāya aupatati avapatati, samantā samantatau yaujanasataṃ satayaujanappamāṇaṃ mahāsaraṃ mahāsamuddaṃ attanau pakkhavātaihi vikkhaubhaiti ālauḷaiti yathāti sambandhau|

502. sau supaṇṇau vihaṅgamau vaihāsagamanasīlau pan‍nagaṃ nāmaṃ gahaitvā adhausīsaṃ aulambaitvā vihaiṭhayaṃ tattha tattha vividhaina haiṭhanaina haiṭhaintau ādāya daḷhaṃ gahaitvā yaina kāmaṃ yattha gantukāmau, tattha pak‍kamati gacchatīti sambandhau|

503. bhantai mahāvīra, yathā garuḷau balī balavā pan‍nagaṃ gahaitvā pak‍kamati, tathā aiva ahaṃ asaṅkhataṃ pac‍cayaihi akataṃ nibbānaṃ gavaisantau paṭipattipūraṇavasaina pariyaisantau dausai sakaladiyaḍḍhakilaisasahassai vikkhālayiṃ visaisaina samucchaidappahānaina saudhaisiṃ ahanti sambandhau|

504. yathā garuḷau pan‍nagaṃ gahaitvā bhuñ‍jitvā viharati, tathā ahaṃ dhammavaraṃ uttamadhammaṃ diṭṭhau passantau aitaṃ santipadaṃ nibbānapadaṃ anuttaraṃ uttaravirahitaṃ maggaphalaihi ādāya gahaitvā vaḷañ‍jaitvā viharāmīti sambandhau|

505. idāni  nibbānassa dul‍labhabhāvaṃ dassaintau āsāvatī nāma latātiādimāha| tattha sabbaisaṃ daivānaṃ āsā icchā aitissaṃ latāyaṃ atthīti āsāvatī nāma latā, cittalatāvanai anaikavicittāhi latāhi gahanībhūtai vanai uyyānai jātā nibbattāti atthau| tassā latāya vassasahassaina vassasahassac‍cayaina aikaṃ phalaṃ nibbattatai aikaṃ phalaṃ gaṇhāti|

506. taṃ daivāti taṃ āsāvatiṃ lataṃ tāva dūraphalaṃ tattakaṃ cirakālaṃ atik‍kamitvā phalaṃ gaṇhantaṃ saṃvij‍jamānaṃ  daivā tāvatiṃsadaivatā payirupāsanti bhajanti, sā āsāvatī nāma latuttamā latānaṃ antarai uttamalatā aivaṃ daivānaṃ piyā ahausīti sambandhau|

507. satasahassupādāyāti  satasahassasaṃvaccharaṃ ādiṃ katvā| tāhaṃ paricarai munīti maunaṃ vuc‍cati ñāṇaṃ, bhantai, muni ñāṇavanta sabbañ‍ñu, ahaṃ taṃ bhagavantaṃ paricarai payirupāsāmi| sāyaṃpātaṃ namassāmīti sāyanhasamayañ‍ca pubbaṇhasamayañ‍cāti dvikkhattuṃ namassāmi paṇāmaṃ karaumi| yathā daivā tāvatiṃsā daivā viya āsāvatīlataṃ sāyaṃpātañ‍ca payirupāsantīti sambandhau|

508. avañjhā pāricariyāti yasmā buddhadassanahaitu nibbānappatti ahausi, tasmā buddhapāricariyā vattapaṭipattikiriyā avañjhā atucchā namassanā paṇāmakiriyā ca amaughā atucchā| tathā hi dūrāgataṃ dūratau saṃsāraddhānatau āgatampi, santaṃ saṃvij‍jamānaṃ khaṇauyaṃ ayaṃ buddhuppādakkhaṇau na virādhayi nātik‍kami, maṃ atik‍kamitvā na gatauti atthau|

509. buddhadassanahaitu nibbānappattau ahaṃ āyatiṃ uppaj‍janakabhavai mama paṭisandhiṃ vicinantau upaparikkhantau na passāmīti sambandhau| nirūpadhi khandhūpadhikilaisūpadhīhi virahitau vippamuttau sabbakilaisaihi vinābhūtau upasantau kilaisapariḷāhābhāvaina santamānasau carāmi ahanti sambandhau|

510. puna attanau buddhadassanāya upamaṃ dassaintau yathāpi padumaṃ nāmātiādimāha| sūriyaraṃsaina sūriyaraṃsisamphassaina yathā padumaṃ nāma  api pupphati vikasati mahāvīra vīruttama ahaṃ tathā aiva buddharaṃsaina buddhaina bhagavatā daisitadhammaraṃsippabhāvaina pupphitauti atthau|

511-12. puna buddhadassanaina nibbānadassanaṃ dīpaintau yathā balākātiādimāha| tattha balākayaunimhi balākajātiyaṃ sadā sabbasmiṃ kālai pumā purisau yathā na vij‍jati| pumai avij‍jamānai kathaṃ balākānaṃ gabbhaggahaṇaṃ hautīti cai? maighaisu gaj‍jamānaisu saddaṃ karauntaisu maighagaj‍janaṃ sutvā tā balākiniyau sadā sabbakālai gabbhaṃ gaṇhanti aṇḍaṃ dhāraintīti atthau| yāva yattakaṃ kālaṃ maighau na gaj‍jati maighau saddaṃ na karauti, tāva tattakaṃ kālaṃ ciraṃ cirakālaina gabbhaṃ aṇḍaṃ dhārainti| yadā yasmiṃ kālai maighau pavassati pakāraina gaj‍jitvā vassati vuṭṭhidhāraṃ paggharati, tadā tasmiṃ kālai bhāratau gabbhadhāraṇatau parimuc‍canti aṇḍaṃ pātaintīti atthau|

513. tatau paraṃ upamaiyyasampadaṃ dassaintau padumuttarabuddhassātiādimāha| padumuttarassa buddhassa dhammamaighaina vauhāraparamatthadaisanāsaṅkhātamaighaina gaj‍jatau gaj‍jantassa daisaintassa  dhammamaighassa saddaina  ghausānusāraina ahaṃ tadā dhammagabbhaṃ vivaṭṭūpanissayaṃ dānasīlādipuñ‍ñasambhāragabbhaṃ agaṇhiṃ gahaisiṃ tathāti sambandhau|

514. satasahassupādāya kappasatasahassaṃ ādiṃ katvā puñ‍ñagabbhaṃ dānasīlādipuñ‍ñasambhāraṃ ahaṃ dharaimi pūraimi| yāva dhammamaighau dhammadaisanā na gaj‍jati buddhaina na daisīyati, tāva ahaṃ bhāratau saṃsāragabbhabhāratau nappamuc‍cāmi na maucaimi na visuṃ bhavāmīti sambandhau|

515. bhantai, sakyamuni sakyavaṃsappabhava yadā yasmiṃ kālai suddhaudanamahārājassa tava pitu rammai ramaṇīyai kapilavatthavai kapilavatthunāmakai nagarai tuvaṃ dhammamaighaina gaj‍jati ghausaiti, tadā tasmiṃ kālai ahaṃ bhāratau saṃsāragabbhabhāratau parimuc‍ciṃ muttau ahausinti sambandhau|

516. tatau paraṃ attanā adhigatai maggaphalai dassaintau suñ‍ñatantiādimāha| tattha attaattaniyādīnaṃ abhāvatau suñ‍ñataṃ vimaukkhañ‍ca rāgadausamauhasabbakilaisanimittānaṃ abhāvatau, animittaṃ vimaukkhañ‍ca  taṇhāpaṇidhissa abhāvatau, appaṇihitaṃ vimaukkhañ‍ca ariyamaggaṃ adhigañchiṃ bhāvaisinti sambandhau| caturau ca phalai sabbaiti cattāri sāmañ‍ñaphalāni sabbāni sacchi akāsinti atthau| dhammaivaṃ vijaṭayiṃ ahanti ahaṃ aivaṃ sabbadhammai jaṭaṃ gahanaṃ vijaṭayiṃ viddhaṃsaisinti atthau|

dutiyabhāṇavāravaṇṇanā samattā|

517. tatau paraṃ attanā adhigatavisaisamaiva dassaintau aparimaiyyupādāyātiādimāha| tattha na parimaiyyauti aparimaiyyau, saṃvaccharagaṇanavasaina pamaituṃ saṅkhātuṃ asak‍kuṇaiyyauti atthau| taṃ aparimaiyyaṃ kappaṃ upādāya ādiṃ katvā tava sāsanaṃ tuyhaṃ sāsanaṃ ‘‘anāgatai gautamassa bhagavatau sāsanai vinayadharānaṃ aggau bhavaiyya’’nti aivaṃ patthaimi| atītatthai vattamānavacanaṃ, patthaisinti atthau| sau mai atthauti sau patthanāsaṅkhātau atthau mai mayā anuppattau nipphāditauti atthau| anuttaraṃ santipadaṃ nibbānaṃ anuppattaṃ adhigatanti sambandhau|

518. sau ahaṃ adhigatattā vinayai vinayapiṭakai pāramiṃ pattau pariyausānappattau| yathāpi pāṭhikau isīti yathā padumuttarassa bhagavatau sāsanai vinayadharānaṃ aggau isi bhikkhu pāṭhikau pākaṭau  ahausi, tathaivāhanti atthau| na mai samasamau atthīti vinayadhāritāya  mai mayā samasamau samānau añ‍ñau na atthīti atthau| sāsanaṃ auvādānusāsanīsaṅkhātaṃ sāsanaṃ dhāraimi pūraimīti atthau|

519. punapi attanau visaisaṃ dassaintau vinayai khandhakai cāpītiādimāha| tattha vinayaiti ubhatauvibhaṅgai| khandhakaiti mahāvaggacūḷavaggai| tikacchaidai cāti tikasaṅghādisaisatikapācittiyādikai ca| pañ‍camaiti parivārai ca| aittha aitasmiṃ sakalai vinayapiṭakai mayhaṃ vimati dvaiḷhakaṃ natthi na saṃvij‍jati| akkharaiti vinayapiṭakapariyāpan‍nai a-kārādikai akkharai| byañ‍janaiti ka-kārādikai byañ‍janai vā mai vimati saṃsayau natthīti sambandhau|

520. niggahai  paṭikammai cāti pāpabhikkhūnaṃ niggahai ca sāpattikānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ parivāsadānādikai paṭikammai ca ṭhānāṭṭhānai ca kāraṇai ca akāraṇai ca kauvidau chaikauti atthau| ausāraṇai ca taj‍janīyādikammassa paṭippassaddhivasaina ausāraṇai pavaisanai ca| vuṭṭhāpanai ca āpattitau vuṭṭhāpanai nirāpattikaraṇai ca chaikauti sambandhau| sabbattha pāramiṃ gatauti sabbasmiṃ vinayakammai pariyausānaṃ pattau, dakkhau chaikauti atthau|

521. vinayai khandhakai cāpīti vuttappakārai vinayai ca khandhakai ca, padaṃ suttapadaṃ nikkhipitvā paṭṭhapaitvā| ubhatau vinivaiṭhaitvāti vinayatau khandhakatau cāti ubhayatau nibbattaitvā vijaṭaitvā nayaṃ āharitvā| rasatauti kic‍catau| ausaraiyyaṃ ausāraṇaṃ karaumīti atthau|

522. niruttiyā ca kusalauti ‘‘rukkhau paṭau kumbhau mālā citta’’ntiādīsu vauhāraisu chaikau| atthānatthai ca kauvidauti atthai vaḍḍhiyaṃ anatthai hāniyañ‍ca kauvidau dakkhauti atthau| anañ‍ñātaṃ mayā natthīti vinayapiṭakai sakalai vā piṭakattayai mayā anañ‍ñātaṃ aviditaṃ apākaṭaṃ kiñ‍ci natthīti atthau| aikaggau satthu sāsanaiti buddhasāsanai ahamaiva aikau vinayadharānaṃ aggau saiṭṭhau uttamauti atthau|

523. rūpadakkhai ahaṃ aj‍jāti aj‍ja aitarahi kālai sakyaputtassa bhagavatau sāsanai pāvacanai ahaṃ rūpadakkhai rūpadassanai vinayavinicchayadassanai sabbaṃ kaṅkhaṃ sakalaṃ saṃsayaṃ vinaudaimi vināsaimīti sambandhau| chindāmi sabbasaṃsayanti ‘‘ahausiṃ nu khau ahamatītamaddhāna’’ntiādikaṃ (ma॰ ni॰ 1.18; saṃ॰ ni॰ 2.20; mahāni॰ 174)  kālattayaṃ ārabbha uppan‍naṃ sabbaṃ sauḷasavidhaṃ kaṅkhaṃ chindāmi vūpasamaimi sabbasau viddhaṃsaimīti atthau|

524. padaṃ anupadañ‍cāpīti padaṃ pubbapadañ‍ca anupadaṃ parapadañ‍ca akkharaṃ aikaikamakkharañ‍ca byañ‍janaṃ sithiladhanitādidasavidhaṃ  byañ‍janavidhānañ‍ca| nidānaiti taina samayainātiādikai nidānai ca| pariyausānaiti nigamanai| sabbattha kauvidauti sabbaisu chasu ṭhānaisu chaikauti atthau|

525. tatau  paraṃ bhagavatauyaiva guṇai pakāsaintau yathāpi rājā balavātiādimāha| tattha yathā balavā thāmabalasampan‍nau sainābalasampan‍nau vā rājā, paraṃ paraisaṃ paṭirājūnaṃ sainaṃ niggaṇhitvā nissaisatau gahaitvā palāpaitvā vā, tapai tapaiyya santapaiyya dukkhāpaiyya| vijinitvāna saṅgāmanti saṅgāmaṃ parasaināya samāgamaṃ yuddhaṃ vijinitvā visaisaina jinitvā jayaṃ patvā| nagaraṃ tattha māpayaiti tattha tasmiṃ vijitaṭṭhānai nagaraṃ pāsādahammiyādivibhūsitaṃ vasanaṭṭhānaṃ māpayai kārāpaiyyāti atthau|

526. pākāraṃ parikhañ‍cāpīti tattha māpitanagarai pākāraṃ sudhādhavalaiṭṭhakāmayapākārañ‍ca kārayaiti sambandhau| parikhañ‍cāpi kaddamaparikhaṃ, udakaparikhaṃ, sukkhaparikhañ‍ca api kārayai| aisikaṃ dvārakauṭṭhakanti nagarasaubhanatthaṃ ussāpitaaisikāthambhañ‍ca mahantaṃ kauṭṭhakañ‍ca catubhūmakādidvārakauṭṭhakañ‍ca kārayai| aṭṭālakai ca vividhaiti catubhūmakādibhaidai atiuc‍caaṭṭālakai ca vividhai nānappakārakai bahū kārayai kārāpaiyyāti sambandhau|

527. siṅghāṭakaṃ cac‍carañ‍cāti na kaivalaṃ pākārādayau kārayai, siṅghāṭakaṃ catumaggasandhiñ‍ca cac‍caraṃ antarāvīthiñ‍ca kārayaiti sambandhau| suvibhattantarāpaṇanti suṭṭhu vibhattaṃ vibhāgatau kauṭṭhāsavantaṃ antarāpaṇaṃ anaikāpaṇasahassaṃ kārāpaiyyāti atthau| kārayaiyya sabhaṃ tatthāti tasmiṃ māpitanagarai sabhaṃ dhammādhikaraṇasālaṃ kārayai| atthānatthavinicchayaṃ vaḍḍhiñ‍ca avaḍḍhiñ‍ca vinicchayakaraṇatthaṃ vinicchayasālaṃ kārayaiti sambandhau|

528. nigghātatthaṃ amittānanti paṭirājūnaṃ paṭibāhanatthaṃ| chiddāchiddañ‍ca jānitunti dausañ‍ca adausañ‍ca jānituṃ| balakāyassa rakkhāyāti hatthiassarathapattisaṅkhātassa balakāyassa saināsamūhassa  ārakkhaṇatthāya sau nagarasāmikau rājā, saināpac‍caṃ saināpatiṃ sainānāyakaṃ mahāmattaṃ ṭhapaiti ṭhānantarai patiṭṭhapaitīti atthau|

529. ārakkhatthāya  bhaṇḍassāti jātarūparajatamuttāmaṇiādirājabhaṇḍassa ārakkhaṇatthāya samantatau gaupanatthāya mai mayhaṃ bhaṇḍaṃ mā vinassīti nidhānakusalaṃ rakkhaṇai kusalaṃ chaikaṃ naraṃ  purisaṃ bhaṇḍarakkhaṃ bhaṇḍarakkhantaṃ sau rājā bhaṇḍāgārai ṭhapaitīti sambandhau|

530. mamattau hauti yau rañ‍ñauti yau paṇḍitau rañ‍ñau mamattau māmakau pakkhapātau hauti| vuddhiṃ yassa ca icchatīti assa rañ‍ñau vuddhiñ‍ca virūḷhiṃ yau icchati kāmaiti, tassa itthambhūtassa paṇḍitassa rājā adhikaraṇaṃ vinicchayādhipac‍caṃ daiti mittassa mittabhāvassa paṭipaj‍jitunti sambandhau|

531. uppātaisūti uk‍kāpātadisāḍāhādiuppātaisu ca| nimittaisūti mūsikacchin‍nādīsu ‘‘idaṃ nimittaṃ subhaṃ, idaṃ nimittaṃ asubha’’nti aivaṃ nimittajānanasatthaisu ca| lakkhaṇaisu cāti itthipurisānaṃ hatthapādalakkhaṇajānanasatthaisu ca kauvidaṃ chaikaṃ ajjhāyakaṃ anaikaisaṃ sissānaṃ byākaraṇavācakaṃ mantadharaṃ vaidattayasaṅkhātamantadhārakaṃ paṇḍitaṃ sau rājā paurauhic‍cai purauhitaṭṭhānantarai ṭhapaitīti sambandhau|

532. aitaihaṅgaihi sampan‍nauti aitaihi vuttappakāraihi aṅgaihi avayavaihi sampan‍nau samaṅgībhūtau sau rājā ‘‘khattiyau’’ti pavuc‍cati kathīyatīti sambandhau| sadā rakkhanti rājānanti aitai saināpac‍cādayau amac‍cā sadā sabbakālaṃ taṃ rājānaṃ rakkhanti gaupainti| kimiva? cak‍kavākauva dukkhitaṃ dukkhappattaṃ sakañātiṃ rakkhantau cak‍kavākau pakkhī ivāti atthau|

533. tathaiva tvaṃ mahāvīrāti vīruttama, yathā sau rājā saināpac‍cādiaṅgasampan‍nau nagaradvāraṃ thakaitvā paṭivasati, tathaiva tuvaṃ hatāmittau nihatapac‍catthikau khattiyau iva sadaivakassa laukassa saha daivaihi pavattamānassa laukassa dhammarājā dhammaina samaina rājā dasapāramitādhammaparipūraṇaina rājabhūtattā ‘‘dhammarājā’’ti pavuc‍cati kathīyatīti sambandhau|

534. titthiyai nīharitvānāti dhammarājabhāvaina paṭipakkhabhūtai sakalatitthiyai nīharitvā nissaisaina haritvā nibbisaivanaṃ katvā sasainakaṃ dhārañ‍cāpi saināya saha vasavattimārampi nīharitvā| tamandhakāraṃ vidhamitvāti  tamasaṅkhātaṃ mauhandhakāraṃ vidhamitvā viddhaṃsaitvā| dhammanagaraṃ sattatiṃsabaudhipakkhiyadhammasaṅkhātaṃ, khandhāyatanadhātupaṭic‍casamuppādabalabaujjhaṅgagambhīranayasamantapaṭṭhānadhammasaṅkhātaṃ vā nagaraṃ amāpayi nimmini patiṭṭhāpaisīti atthau|

535. sīlaṃ pākārakaṃ tatthāti tasmiṃ patiṭṭhāpitai dhammanagarai catupārisuddhisīlaṃ pākāraṃ| ñāṇaṃ tai dvārakauṭṭhakanti tai tuyhaṃ sabbañ‍ñutañ‍ñāṇaāsayānusayañāṇaanāgataṃsañāṇaatītaṃsañāṇādikamaiva ñāṇaṃ dvārakauṭṭhakanti atthau| saddhā tai aisikā vīrāti, bhantai, asithilaparak‍kama tai tuyhaṃ dīpaṅkarapādamūlatau pabhuti sabbañ‍ñutañ‍ñāṇakāraṇā saddahanasaddhā ussāpitaalaṅkāraalaṅkatathambhauti  atthau| dvārapālau ca saṃvarauti tai tuyhaṃ chadvārikasaṃvarau rakkhāvaraṇagutti dvārapālau dvārarakkhakauti atthau|

536. satipaṭṭhānamaṭṭālanti tai tuyhaṃ catusatipaṭṭhānaaṭṭālamuṇḍacchadanaṃ| pañ‍ñā tai cac‍caraṃ munaiti, bhantai, munai ñāṇavanta tai tuyhaṃ pāṭihāriyādianaikavidhā pañ‍ñā cac‍caraṃ maggasamaudhānaṃ nagaravīthīti atthau| iddhipādañ‍ca siṅghāṭanti tuyhaṃ chandavīriyacittavīmaṃsasaṅkhātā cattārau iddhipādā siṅghāṭaṃ catumaggasanti| dhammavīthi sumāpitanti sattatiṃsabaudhipakkhiyadhammasaṅkhātāya vīthiyā suṭṭhu māpitaṃ saj‍jitaṃ, taṃ dhammanagaranti atthau|

537. suttantaṃ abhidhammañ‍cāti tava tuyhaṃ aittha dhammanagarai suttantaṃ abhidhammaṃ vinayañ‍ca kaivalaṃ sakalaṃ suttagaiyyādikaṃ navaṅgaṃ buddhavacanaṃ dhammasabhā dhammādhikaraṇasālāti atthau|

538. suñ‍ñataṃ animittañ‍cāti anattānupassanāvasaina paṭiladdhaṃ suñ‍ñatavihārañ‍ca, anic‍cānupassanāvasaina paṭiladdhaṃ animittavihārañ‍ca| vihārañ‍cappaṇihitanti dukkhānupassanāvasaina paṭiladdhaṃ appaṇihitavihārañ‍ca| ānaiñ‍jañ‍cāti acalaṃ aphanditaṃ catusāmañ‍ñaphalasaṅkhātaṃ ānaiñ‍javihārañ‍ca| niraudhau cāti sabbadukkhaniraudhaṃ nibbānañ‍ca| aisā dhammakuṭī tavāti aisā sabbanavalaukuttaradhammasaṅkhātā tava tuyhaṃ dhammakuṭi vasanagaihanti atthau|

539. pañ‍ñāya  aggau nikkhittauti pañ‍ñāvasaina pañ‍ñavantānaṃ aggau| iti bhagavatā nikkhittau ṭhapitau thairau paṭibhānai ca pañ‍ñāya kattabbai kic‍cai, yuttamuttapaṭibhānai vā kauvidau chaikau nāmaina sāriputtauti pākaṭau tava tuyhaṃ dhammasaināpati tayā daisitassa piṭakattayadhammasamūhassa dhāraṇatau pati padhānau hutvā sainākic‍caṃ karautīti atthau|

540. cutūpapātakusalauti  bhantai muni, cutūpapātai cutiyā upapattiyā ca kusalau chaikau| iddhiyā pāramiṃ gatauti ‘‘aikaupi hutvā bahudhā hauti, bahudhāpi hutvā aikau hautī’’tiādinā (dī॰ ni॰ 1.238; paṭi॰ ma॰ 1.102) vuttāya iddhippabhaidāya pāramiṃ pariyausānaṃ gatau pattau nāmaina kaulitau nāma mauggal‍lānatthairau paurauhic‍cau tava tuyhaṃ purauhitauti sambandhau|

541. paurāṇakavaṃsadharauti bhantai munai, ñāṇavantaṃ paurāṇassa vaṃsassa dhārakau, paramparajānanakau vā uggataijau pākaṭataijau, durāsadau  āsādaituṃ ghaṭṭaituṃ dukkhau asak‍kuṇaiyyauti atthau| dhutavādiguṇainaggauti taicīvarikaṅgādīni tairasa dhutaṅgāni vadati auvadatīti dhutavādīguṇaina dhutaṅgaguṇaina aggau saiṭṭhau mahākassapatthairau tava tuyhaṃ akkhadassau vauhārakaraṇai padhānauti atthau|

542. bahussutau dhammadharauti bhantai munai, bahūnaṃ caturāsītidhammakkhandhasahassānaṃ sutattā bhagavatā bhikkhusaṅghatau ca uggahitattā bahussutau anaikaisaṃ chasatasahassasaṅkhyānaṃ āgamadhammānaṃ satipaṭṭhānādīnañ‍ca paramatthadhammānaṃ dhāraṇatau dhammadharau ānandau| sabbapāṭhī ca sāsanaiti buddhasāsanai sabbaisaṃ pāṭhīnaṃ paṭhantānaṃ sajjhāyantānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ aggau saiṭṭhauti sabbapāṭhī nāmaina ānandau nāma thairau| dhammārakkhau tavāti tava tuyhaṃ dhammassa piṭakattayadhammabhaṇḍassa ārakkhau rakkhakau pālakau, dhammabhaṇḍāgārikauti atthau|

543. aitai  sabbai atik‍kammāti bhagavā bhagyavā sammāsambuddhau aitai sāriputtādayau mahānubhāvaipi thairai atik‍kamma vaj‍jaitvā mamaṃyaiva pamaisi pamāṇaṃ akāsi, manasi akāsīti atthau| vinicchayaṃ mai pādāsīti vinayañ‍ñūhi paṇḍitaihi daisitaṃ pakāsitaṃ vinayai vinicchayaṃ dausavicāraṇaṃ mai mayhaṃ bhagavā pādāsi pakāraina adāsi, mayhamaiva bhāraṃ akāsīti sambandhau|

544. yau kauci vinayai pañhanti yau kauci bhikkhu buddhasāvakau vinayanissitaṃ pañhaṃ maṃ pucchati, tattha tasmiṃ pucchitapañhai mai mayhaṃ cintanā vimati kaṅkhā natthi| tañhaivatthaṃ taṃ aiva pucchitaṃ atthaṃ ahaṃ kathaimīti sambandhau|

545. yāvatā buddhakhaittamhīti yāvatā yattakai ṭhānai buddhassa āṇākhaittai taṃ mahāmuniṃ  sammāsambuddhaṃ ṭhapaitvā vinayai vinayapiṭakai vinayavinicchayakaraṇai vā mādisau mayā sadisau natthi, ahamaiva aggau, bhiyyau mamādhikau kutau bhavissatīti sambandhau|

546. bhikkhusaṅghai nisīditvā bhikkhusaṅghamajjhai nisin‍nau gautamau bhagavā aivaṃ gaj‍jati sīhanādaṃ karauti| kathaṃ? vinayai ubhatauvibhaṅgai, khandhakaisu mahāvaggacūḷavaggaisu, ca-saddaina parivārai, upālissa upālinā samau sadisau natthīti aivaṃ gaj‍jati|

547. yāvatāti yattakaṃ buddhabhaṇitaṃ buddhaina daisitaṃ navaṅgaṃ suttagaiyyādisatthusāsanaṃ satthunā pakāsitaṃ sabbaṃ vinayaugadhaṃ taṃ vinayai antaupaviṭṭhaṃ vinayamūlakaṃ ic‍caivaṃ passinau passantassa|

548. mama kammaṃ saritvānāti gautamau sakyapuṅgavau sakyavaṃsappadhānau, mama kammaṃ mayhaṃ pubbapatthanākammaṃ atītaṃsañāṇaina saritvāna pac‍cakkhatau ñatvā bhikkhusaṅghamajjhai  gatau ‘‘aitadaggaṃ, bhikkhavai, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ vinayadharānaṃ yadidaṃ upālī’’ti (a॰ ni॰ 1.219, 228) maṃ aitadaggai ṭhānai ṭhapaisīti sambandhau|

549. satasahassupādāyāti satasahassakappai ādiṃ katvā yaṃ imaṃ ṭhānaṃ apatthayiṃ patthaisiṃ, sau mai atthau mayā anuppattau adhigatau paṭiladdhau vinayai pāramiṃ gatau kauṭiṃ pattauti atthau|

550. sakyānaṃ  sakyavaṃsarājūnaṃ nandijananau saumanassakārakau ahaṃ purai pubbai kappakau āsiṃ ahausiṃ, taṃ jātiṃ taṃ kulaṃ taṃ yauniṃ vijahitvā visaisaina jahitvā chaḍḍaitvā mahaisinau sammāsambuddhassa puttau jātau sakyaputtauti saṅkhyaṃ gatau sāsanadhāraṇatauti atthau|

551. tatau paraṃ attanau dāsakulai nibbattanāpadānaṃ dassaintau itau dutiyakai kappaitiādimāha| tattha itau bhaddakappatau haiṭṭhā dutiyai kappai nāmaina añ‍jasau nāma khattiyau aikau rājā anantataijau saṅkhyātik‍kantataijau amitayasau pamāṇātik‍kantaparivārau mahaddhanau anaikakauṭisatasahassadhanavā bhūmipālau pathavīpālakau rakkhakau ahausīti sambandhau|

552. tassa rañ‍ñauti tassa tādisassa rājinau puttau ahaṃ candanau nāma khattiyau khattiyakumārau ahausinti sambandhau| sau ahaṃ jātimadaina ca yasamadaina ca bhaugamadaina ca upatthaddhau thambhitau un‍natauti atthau|

553. nāgasatasahassānīti  satasahassahatthinau mātaṅgā mātaṅgakulai jātā tidhā pabhin‍nā akkhikaṇṇakausasaṅkhātaihi tīhi ṭhānaihi pabhin‍nā madagaḷitā sabbālaṅkārabhūsitā sabbaihi hatthālaṅkāraihi alaṅkatā sadā sabbakālaṃ maṃ parivāraintīti sambandhau|

554. sabalaihi paraitauhanti tadā tasmiṃ kālai ahaṃ sabalaihi attanau sainābalaihi paraitau parivāritau uyyānaṃ gantukāmakau icchantau sirikaṃ nāma nāgaṃ hatthiṃ āruyha abhiruhitvā nagaratau nikkhaminti sambandhau|

555. caraṇaina ca sampan‍nauti sīlasaṃvarādipan‍narasacaraṇadhammaina saman‍nāgatau guttadvārau pihitacakkhādichadvārau susaṃvutau suṭṭhu rakkhitakāyacittau daivalau nāma sambuddhau pac‍caikasambuddhau, mama mayhaṃ puratau sammukhai āgacchi pāpuṇīti atthau|

556. paisaitvā  sirikaṃ nāganti taṃ āgataṃ pac‍caikabuddhaṃ disvā ahaṃ sirikaṃ nāma nāgaṃ abhimukhaṃ paisaitvā buddhaṃ āsādayiṃ ghaṭṭaisiṃ padussaisinti atthau| tatau sañ‍jātakaupau sauti tatau tasmā mayā atīva pīḷaitvā paisitattā sau hatthināgau mayi sañ‍jātakaupau  padaṃ attanau pādaṃ nuddharatai na uddharati, nic‍calauva hautīti atthau|

557. nāgaṃ duṭṭhamanaṃ disvāti duṭṭhamanaṃ kuddhacittaṃ nādaṃ disvā ahaṃ buddhai pac‍caikabuddhai kaupaṃ akāsiṃ dausaṃ uppādaisinti atthau| vihaisayitvā sambuddhanti daivalaṃ pac‍caikasambuddhaṃ vihaisayitvā vihaiṭhaitvā ahaṃ uyyānaṃ agamāsinti sambandhau|

558. sātaṃ tattha na vindāmīti tasmiṃ āsādanai sātaṃ na vindāmi| āsādananimittaṃ madhuraṃ sukhaṃ na labhāmīti atthau| sirau paj‍jalitau yathāti sirau mama sīsaṃ paj‍jalitau yathā paj‍jalamānaṃ viya hautīti atthau| pariḷāhaina ḍayhāmīti pac‍caikabuddhai kaupassa katattā pacchānutāpapariḷāhaina ḍayhāmi uṇhacittau haumīti atthau|

559. sasāgarantāti tainaiva pāpakammabalaina sasāgarantā sāgarapariyausānā sakalamahāpathavī mai mayhaṃ ādittā viya jalitā viya hauti khāyatīti atthau| pitu santikupāgammāti aivaṃ bhayai uppan‍nai ahaṃ attanau pitu rañ‍ñau santikaṃ upāgamma upagantvā idaṃ vacanaṃ abraviṃ kathaisinti atthau|

560. āsīvisaṃva  kupitanti āsīvisaṃ sabbaṃ kupitaṃ kuddhaṃ iva jalamānaṃ aggikkhandhaṃ iva mattaṃ tidhā pabhin‍naṃ dantiṃ dantavantaṃ kuñ‍jaraṃ uttamaṃ hatthiṃ iva ca āgataṃ yaṃ pac‍caikabuddhaṃ sayambhuṃ sayamaiva buddhabhūtaṃ ahaṃ āsādayiṃ ghaṭṭaisinti sambandhau|

561. āsāditau mayā buddhauti sau pac‍caikabuddhau mayā āsāditau ghaṭṭitau ghaurau añ‍ñaihi ghaṭṭaituṃ asak‍kuṇaiyyattā ghaurau, uggatapau pākaṭatapau jinau pañ‍ca mārai jitavā aivaṃguṇasampan‍nau  pac‍caikabuddhau mayā ghaṭṭitauti atthau| purā sabbai vinassāmāti tasmiṃ pac‍caikabuddhai kataanādaraina sabbai mayaṃ vinassāma vividhainākāraina nassāma, bhasmā viya bhavāmāti atthau| khamāpaissāma taṃ muninti taṃ pac‍caikabuddhaṃ muniṃ yāva na vinassāma, tāva khamāpaissāmāti sambandhau|

562. nau cai taṃ nijjhāpaissāmāti attadantaṃ damitacittaṃ samāhitaṃ aikaggacittaṃ taṃ pac‍caikabuddhaṃ nau cai nijjhāpaissāma khamāpaissāma| auraina sattadivasā sattadivasatau aurabhāgai sattadivasai anatik‍kamitvā sampuṇṇaṃ raṭṭhaṃ mai sabbaṃ vidhamissati vinassissati|

563. sumaikhalau kausiyau cāti aitai sumaikhalādayau cattārau rājānau isayau āsādayitvā ghaṭṭaitvā anādaraṃ katvā saraṭṭhakā saha raṭṭhajanapadavāsīhi duggatā vināsaṃ gatāti atthau|

564. yadā  kuppanti isayauti yadā yasmiṃ kālai sañ‍ñatā kāyasañ‍ñamādīhi sañ‍ñatā santā brahmacārinau uttamacārinau saiṭṭhacārinau isayau kuppanti daumanassā bhavanti, tadā sasāgaraṃ sapabbataṃ sadaivakaṃ laukaṃ vināsaintīti sambandhau|

565. tiyaujanasahassamhīti taisaṃ isīnaṃ ānubhāvaṃ ñatvā tai khamāpaituṃ ac‍cayaṃ aparādhaṃ daisanatthāya pakāsanatthāya tiyaujanasahassappamāṇai padaisai purisai san‍nipātayinti sambandhau| sayambhuṃ upasaṅkaminti sayambhuṃ pac‍caikabuddhaṃ upasaṅkamiṃ samīpaṃ agamāsinti atthau|

566. al‍lavatthāti mayā saddhiṃ rāsibhūtā sabbai janā al‍lavatthā udakaina tintavatthauttarāsaṅgā al‍lasirā tintakaisā pañ‍jalīkatā muddhani kataañ‍jalipuṭā buddhassa pac‍caikamuninau  pādai pādasamīpai nipatitvā nipaj‍jitvā idaṃ vacanamabravunti ‘‘khamassu tvaṃ, mahāvīrā’’tiādikaṃ vacanaṃ abravuṃ kathaisunti atthau|

567. mahāvīra vīruttama bhantai pac‍caikabuddha, mayā tumhaisu añ‍ñāṇaina kataṃ aparādhaṃ khamassu tvaṃ vinaudaihi, mā manasi karauhīti atthau| janau janasamūhau taṃ bhagavantaṃ abhi visaisaina yācati| pariḷāhaṃ dausamauhaihi katacittadukkhapariḷāhaṃ amhākaṃ vinaudaihi tanuṃ karauhi, nau amhākaṃ raṭṭhaṃ sakalaraṭṭhajanapadavāsinau mā vināsaya mā vināsaihīti atthau|

568. sadaivamānusā sabbaiti sabbai mānusā sadaivā sadānavā pahārādādīhi asuraihi saha sarakkhasā ayaumayaina kūṭaina mahāmuggaraina sadā sabbakālaṃ mai siraṃ mayhaṃ matthakaṃ bhindaiyyuṃ padālaiyyuṃ|

569. tatau paraṃ buddhānaṃ khamitabhāvañ‍ca kaupābhāvañ‍ca pakāsaintau dakai aggi na saṇṭhātītiādimāha| tattha yathā udakai aggi na saṇṭhāti na patiṭṭhāti, yathā bījaṃ sailai silāmayai pabbatai na viruhati, yathā agadai ausadhai kimi pāṇakau na saṇṭhāti| tathā kaupau cittappakaupau dummanatā buddhai paṭividdhasac‍cai pac‍caikabuddhai na jāyati na uppaj‍jatīti atthau|

570. punapi buddhānaṃ ānubhāvaṃ pakāsaintau yathā ca bhūmītiādimāha| tattha yathā ca bhūmi pathavī acalā nic‍calā, tathā buddhau acalauti atthau| yathā sāgarau mahāsamuddau appamaiyyau pamaituṃ pamāṇaṃ gahaituṃ asak‍kuṇaiyyau, tathā buddhau appamaiyyauti atthau| yathā ākāsau aphuṭṭhākāsau anantakau pariyausānarahitau, aivaṃ tathā buddhau akkhaubhiyau khaubhaituṃ ālauḷaituṃ asak‍kuṇaiyyauti atthau|

571. tatau paraṃ pac‍caikabuddhassa khamanavacanaṃ dassaintau sadā  khantā mahāvīrātiādimāha| tattha mahāvīrā uttamavīriyavantā buddhā tapassinau pāpānaṃ tapanatau ‘‘tapau’’ti laddhanāmaina vīriyaina saman‍nāgatā khantā ca khantiyā ca sampan‍nā khamitā ca paraisaṃ aparādhaṃ khamitā sahitā sadā sabbakālaṃ bhavantīti sambandhau| khantānaṃ khamitānañ‍cāti taisaṃ buddhānaṃ khantānaṃ khantiyā yuttānaṃ khamitānaṃ parāparādhakhamitānaṃ sahitānañ‍ca gamanaṃ chandādīhi agatigamanaṃ na vij‍jatīti atthau|

572. iti  idaṃ vacanaṃ vatvā sambuddhau pac‍caikasambuddhau pariḷāhaṃ sattānaṃ uppan‍nadāhaṃ vinaudayaṃ vinaudayantau mahājanassa puratau san‍nipatitassa sarājakassa mahatau janakāyassa sammukhatau tadā tasmiṃ kālai nabhaṃ ākāsaṃ abbhuggami uggañchīti atthau|

573. taina kammainahaṃ dhīrāti dhīra dhitisampan‍na ahaṃ taina kammaina pac‍caikabuddhai kataina anādarakammaina imasmiṃ pacchimattabhavai hīnattaṃ lāmakabhāvaṃ rājūnaṃ kappakakammakaraṇajātiṃ ajjhupāgatau sampattauti atthau| samatik‍kamma taṃ jātinti taṃ parāyattajātiṃ saṃ suṭṭhu atik‍kamma atik‍kamitvā| pāvisiṃ abhayaṃ puranti bhayarahitaṃ nibbānapuraṃ nibbānamahānagaraṃ pāvisiṃ paviṭṭhau āsinti atthau|

574. tadāpi maṃ mahāvīrāti vīruttama tadāpi tasmiṃ pac‍caikabuddhassa āsādanasamayai api sayambhū pac‍caikabuddhau pariḷāhaṃ āsādanahaitu uppan‍naṃ kāyacittadarathaṃ vinaudaisi dūrīakāsi| ḍayhamānaṃ tatau aiva pacchānutāpaina kuk‍kuc‍caina ḍayhamānaṃ santapantaṃ maṃ susaṇṭhitaṃ dausaṃ dausatau dassanai suṭṭhu saṇṭhitaṃ disvā khamāpayi taṃ aparādhaṃ adhivāsaisīti sambandhau|

575. aj‍jāpi maṃ mahāvīrāti vīruttama, aj‍jāpi tuyhaṃ samāgamakālai api, tihaggībhi rāgaggidausaggimauhaggisaṅkhātaihi vā nirayaggipaitaggisaṃsāraggisaṅkhātaihi vā tīhi aggīhi ḍayhamānaṃ dukkhamanubhavantaṃ maṃ bhagavā sītibhāvaṃ daumanassavināsaina santakāyacittasaṅkhātaṃ sītibhāvaṃ nibbānamaiva vā apāpayi sampāpaisi| tayau aggī vuttappakārai tai tayau aggī nibbāpaisi vūpasamaisīti sambandhau|

576. aivaṃ attanau hīnāpadānaṃ bhagavatau dassaitvā idāni añ‍ñaipi tassa savanai niyaujaitvā auvadantau ‘‘yaisaṃ sautāvadhānatthī’’tiādimāha| tattha yaisaṃ tumhākaṃ sautāvadhānaṃ sautassa avadhānaṃ ṭhapanaṃ atthi vij‍jati, tai tumhai bhāsatau sāsantassa mama vacanaṃ  suṇātha manasi karautha| atthaṃ tumhaṃ pavakkhāmīti yathā yaina pakāraina mama mayā diṭṭhaṃ padaṃ nibbānaṃ, tathā taina pakāraina nibbānasaṅkhātaṃ paramatthaṃ tumhākaṃ pavakkhāmīti sambandhau|

577. taṃ  dassaintau sayambhuṃ taṃ vimānaitvātiādimāha| tattha sayambhuṃ sayamaiva bhūtaṃ ariyāya jātiyā jātaṃ santacittaṃ samāhitaṃ pac‍caikabuddhaṃ vimānaitvā anādaraṃ katvā taina kammaina  katainākusalaina aj‍ja imasmiṃ vattamānakālai ahaṃ nīcayauniyaṃ parāyattajātiyaṃ kappakajātiyaṃ jātau nibbattau amhi bhavāmi|

578. mā vau khaṇaṃ virādhaithāti buddhuppādakkhaṇaṃ vau tumhai mā virādhaitha gaḷitaṃ mā karautha, hi sac‍caṃ khaṇātītā buddhuppādakkhaṇaṃ atītā atik‍kantā sattā saucarai saucanti, ‘‘mayaṃ alakkhikā dummaidhā bhavāmā’’ti aivaṃ saucantīti atthau| sadatthai attanau atthai vuḍḍhiyaṃ vāyamaiyyātha vīriyaṃ karautha| vau tumhaihi khaṇau buddhuppādakkhaṇau samayau paṭipāditau nipphāditau pattauti atthau|

579. tatau paraṃ saṃsāragatānaṃ ādīnavaṃ upamāupamaiyyavasaina dassaintau aikac‍cānañ‍ca vamanantiādimāha| aikac‍cānaṃ kaisañ‍ci puggalānaṃ vamanaṃ uddhaṃ uggiraṇaṃ aikac‍cānaṃ viraicanaṃ adhaupaggharaṇaṃ aikai aikac‍cānaṃ halāhalaṃ visaṃ mucchākaraṇavisaṃ, aikac‍cānaṃ puggalānaṃ ausadhaṃ rakkhanupāyaṃ bhagavā aivaṃ paṭipāṭiyā akkhāsīti sambandhau|

580. vamanaṃ paṭipan‍nānanti paṭipan‍nānaṃ maggasamaṅgīnaṃ vamanaṃ saṃsārachaḍḍanaṃ saṃsāramaucanaṃ bhagavā akkhāsīti sambandhau| phalaṭṭhānaṃ phalai ṭhitānaṃ viraicanaṃ saṃsārapaggharaṇaṃ akkhāsi| phalalābhīnaṃ phalaṃ labhitvā ṭhitānaṃ nibbānaausadhaṃ akkhāsi| gavaisīnaṃ manussadaivanibbānasampattiṃ gavaisīnaṃ pariyaisantānaṃ puñ‍ñakhaittabhūtaṃ saṅghaṃ akkhāsīti sambandhau|

581. sāsanaina viruddhānanti sāsanassa paṭipakkhānaṃ halāhalaṃ kutūhalaṃ pāpaṃ akusalaṃ akkhāsīti sambandhau| yathā āsīvisauti assaddhānaṃ katapāpānaṃ puggalānaṃ saṃsārai dukkhāvahanatau āsīvisasadisaṃ yathā āsīvisau diṭṭhamattaina bhasmakaraṇatau diṭṭhavisau sappau attanā daṭṭhaṃ naraṃ jhāpaiti ḍayhati dukkhāpaiti| taṃ naraṃ taṃ assaddhaṃ katapāpaṃ naraṃ halāhalavisaṃ aivaṃ jhāpaiti catūsu apāyaisu ḍayhati sausaisīti sambandhau|

582. sakiṃ  pītaṃ halāhalanti visaṃ halāhalaṃ pītaṃ sakiṃ aikavāraṃ  jīvitaṃ uparundhati nāsaiti| sāsanaina sāsanamhi virajjhitvā aparādhaṃ katvā puggalau kappakauṭimhi kauṭisaṅkhyai kappaipi ḍayhati nijjhāyatīti atthau|

583. aivaṃ assaddhānaṃ puggalānaṃ phalavipākaṃ dassaitvā idāni buddhānaṃ ānubhāvaṃ dassaintau  khantiyātiādimāha| tattha yau buddhau vamanādīni akkhāsi, sau buddhau khantiyā khamanaina ca avihiṃsāya sattānaṃ avihiṃsanaina ca maittacittavatāya ca maittacittavantabhāvaina ca sadaivakaṃ saha daivaihi vattamānaṃ laukaṃ tāraiti atik‍kamāpaiti nibbāpaiti, tasmā kāraṇā buddhā vau tumhaihi avirādhiyā virujjhituṃ na sak‍kuṇaiyyā, buddhasāsanai paṭipaj‍jaiyyāthāti atthau|

584. lābhai ca alābhai ca na saj‍janti na bhajanti na lagganti| sammānanai ādarakaraṇai ca vimānanai anādarakaraṇai ca acalā pathavīsadisā buddhā bhavanti, tasmā kāraṇā tai buddhā tumhaihi na viraudhiyā na viraudhaitabbā virujjhituṃ asak‍kuṇaiyyāti atthau|

585. buddhānaṃ majjhattataṃ dassaintau daivadattaitiādimāha| tattha vadhakāvadhakaisu sabbaisu sattaisu samakau samamānasau muni buddhamunīti atthau|

586. aitaisaṃ paṭighau natthīti aitaisaṃ buddhānaṃ paṭighau caṇḍik‍kaṃ dausacittataṃ natthi na saṃvij‍jati| rāgaumaisaṃ na vij‍jatīti imaisaṃ buddhānaṃ rāgaupi raj‍janaṃ al‍līyanaṃ na vij‍jati, na upalabbhati, tasmā kāraṇā, vadhakassa ca aurasassa cāti sabbaisaṃ samakau samacittau buddhau hautīti sambandhau|

587. punapi buddhānaṃyaiva ānubhāvaṃ dassaintau panthai disvāna kāsāvantiādimāha| tattha mīḷhamakkhitaṃ gūthasammissaṃ kāsāvaṃ kasāvaina rajitaṃ cīvaraṃ isiddhajaṃ ariyānaṃ dhajaṃ parikkhāraṃ, panthai maggai chaḍḍitaṃ disvāna passitvā añ‍jaliṃ katvā dasaṅgulisamaudhānaṃ añ‍jalipuṭaṃ sirasi katvā  sirasā siraina vanditabbaṃ isiddhajaṃ arahattaddhajaṃ buddhapac‍caikabuddhasāvakadīpakaṃ cīvaraṃ namassitabbaṃ mānaitabbaṃ pūjaitabbanti atthau|

588. abbhatītāti abhi atthaṅgatā nibbutā| yai ca buddhā vattamānā idāni jātā ca yai buddhā anāgatā ajātā abhūtā anibbattā apātubhūtā ca yai buddhā| dhajainānaina sujjhantīti anaina isiddhajaina cīvaraina aitai buddhā sujjhanti visuddhā bhavanti saubhanti| tasmā taina kāraṇaina aitai buddhā namassiyā namassitabbā vanditabbāti atthau| ‘‘aitaṃ namassiya’’ntipi pāṭhau, tassa aitaṃ isiddhajaṃ namassitabbanti atthau|

589. tatau  paraṃ attanau guṇaṃ dassaintau satthukappantiādimāha| tattha satthukappaṃ buddhasadisaṃ  suvinayaṃ sundaravinayaṃ sundarākāraina dvārattayadamanaṃ hadayaina cittaina ahaṃ dhāraimi savanadhāraṇādinā pac‍cavaikkhāmīti atthau| vinayaṃ vinayapiṭakaṃ namassamānau vandamānau vinayai ādaraṃ kurumānau viharissāmi sabbadā sabbasmiṃ kālai vāsaṃ kappaimīti atthau|

590. vinayau āsayau mayhanti vinayapiṭakaṃ mayhaṃ aukāsabhūtaṃ savanadhāraṇamanasikaraṇauggahaparipucchāpavattanavasaina aukāsabhūtaṃ gaihabhūtanti atthau| vinayau ṭhānacaṅkamanti vinayau mayhaṃ savanādikic‍cakaraṇaina ṭhitaṭṭhānañ‍ca caṅkamanaṭṭhānañ‍ca| kappaimi vinayai vāsanti vinayapiṭakai vinayatantiyā savanadhāraṇapavattanavasaina vāsaṃ sayanaṃ kappaimi karaumi| vinayau mama gaucarauti vinayapiṭakaṃ mayhaṃ gaucarau āhārau bhaujanaṃ nic‍caṃ dhāraṇamanasikaraṇavasaināti atthau|

591. vinayai pāramippattauti sakalai vinayapiṭakai pāramiṃ pariyausānaṃ pattau| samathai cāpi kauvidauti pārājikādisattāpattikkhandhānaṃ samathai vūpasamai ca vuṭṭhānai ca kauvidau chaikau, adhikaraṇasamathai vā –

‘‘vivādaṃ anuvādañ‍ca, āpattādhikaraṇaṃ tathā|

kic‍cādhikaraṇañ‍caiva, caturādhikaraṇā matā’’ti|| –

vuttādhikaraṇaisu ca –

‘‘sammukhā  sativinayau, amūḷhapaṭiñ‍ñākaraṇaṃ|

yaibhuyya tassapāpiyya, tiṇavatthārakau tathā’’ti|| –

aivaṃ vuttaisu ca sattasu adhikaraṇasamathaisu atikauvidau chaikauti atthau| upāli taṃ mahāvīrāti bhantai mahāvīra, catūsu asaṅkhyaiyyaisu kappasatasahassaisu sabbañ‍ñutañ‍ñāṇādhigamāya vīriyavanta satthunau daivamanussānaṃ anusāsakassa taṃ tava pādai pādayugai upāli bhikkhu vandati paṇāmaṃ karautīti atthau|

592. sau ahaṃ pabbajitvā sambuddhaṃ namassamānau paṇāmaṃ kurumānau dhammassa ca taina bhagavatā daisitassa navalaukuttaradhammassa sudhammataṃ sundaradhammabhāvaṃ jānitvā dhammañ‍ca namassamānau gāmatau gāmaṃ puratau punaṃ nagaratau nagaraṃ vicarissāmīti sambandhau|

593. kilaisā  jhāpitā mayhanti mayā paṭividdhaarahattamaggañāṇaina mayhaṃ cittasantānagatā sabbai diyaḍḍhasahassasaṅkhā kilaisā  jhāpitā sausitā visausitā viddhaṃsitā| bhavā sabbai samūhatāti kāmabhavādayau sabbai nava bhavā mayā samūhatā saṃ suṭṭhu ūhatā khaipitā viddhaṃsitā| sabbāsavā parikkhīṇāti kāmāsavau, bhavāsavau, diṭṭhāsavau, avij‍jāsavauti sabbai cattārau āsavā parikkhīṇā parisamantatau khayaṃ pāpitā| idāni imasmiṃ arahattappattakālai punabbhavau punuppattisaṅkhātau bhavau bhavanaṃ jāti natthīti atthau|

594. uttari saumanassavasaina udānaṃ udānaintau svāgatantiādimāha| tattha buddhasaiṭṭhassa uttamabuddhassa santikai samīpai aikanagarai vā mama āgamanaṃ svāgataṃ suṭṭhu āgamanaṃ sundarāgamanaṃ vata aikantaina āsi ahausīti sambandhau| tissau vij‍jāti pubbainivāsadibbacakkhuāsavakkhayavij‍jā anuppattā sampattā, pac‍cakkhaṃ katāti atthau| kataṃ buddhassa sāsananti buddhaina bhagavatā daisitaṃ anusiṭṭhi sāsanaṃ kataṃ nipphāditaṃ vattapaṭipattiṃ pūraitvā kammaṭṭhānaṃ manasi karitvā arahattamaggañāṇādhigamaina sampāditanti atthau|

595. paṭisambhidā catassauti atthapaṭisambhidādayau catassau pañ‍ñāyau sacchikatā pac‍cakkhaṃ katā| vimaukkhāpi ca aṭṭhimaiti cattāri  maggañāṇāni cattāri phalañāṇānīti imai aṭṭha vimaukkhā saṃsāratau muc‍canūpāyā sacchikatāti sambandhau| chaḷabhiñ‍ñā sacchikatāti –

‘‘iddhividhaṃ dibbasautaṃ, caitaupariyañāṇakaṃ|

pubbainivāsañāṇañ‍ca, dibbacakkhāsavakkhaya’’nti|| –

imā cha abhiñ‍ñā sacchikatā pac‍cakkhaṃ katā| imaisaṃ ñāṇānaṃ sacchikaraṇaina buddhassa sāsanaṃ katanti atthau|

itthanti iminā haiṭṭhā vuttappakāraina| sudanti padapūraṇamattai nipātau| āyasmā upāli thairauti thirasīlādiguṇayuttau sāvakau imā pubbacaritāpadānadīpikā gāthāyau abhāsittha kathayitthāti atthau|

upālitthairaapadānavaṇṇanā samattā|

3-7. añ‍ñāsikauṇḍañ‍ñatthairaapadānavaṇṇanā

padumuttarasambuddhantiādikaṃ  āyasmatau añ‍ñāsikauṇḍañ‍ñatthairassa apadānaṃ| ayaṃ kira purimabuddhaisu katādhikārau tattha tattha bhavai vivaṭṭūpanissayāni puñ‍ñāni upacinantau padumuttarassa bhagavatau kālai haṃsavatīnagarai gahapatimahāsālakulai nibbattitvā viñ‍ñutaṃ patvā aikadivasaṃ satthu santikai dhammaṃ suṇantau satthāraṃ aikaṃ bhikkhuṃ attanau sāsanai paṭhamaṃ  paṭividdhadhammarattañ‍ñūnaṃ aggaṭṭhānai ṭhapaintaṃ disvā sayampi taṃ ṭhānantaraṃ patthaintau satasahassabhikkhuparivārassa bhagavatau sattāhaṃ mahādānaṃ pavattaitvā paṇidhānaṃ akāsi| satthāpissa anantarāyataṃ disvā bhāviniṃ sampattiṃ byākāsi| sau yāvajīvaṃ puñ‍ñāni karauntau satthari parinibbutai caitiyai patiṭṭhāpiyamānai antaucaitiyai ratanagharaṃ kārāpaisi, caitiyaṃ parivāraitvā sahassaratanagghikāni ca kāraisi|

sau aivaṃ puñ‍ñāni katvā tatau cavitvā daivamanussaisu saṃsarantau vipassissa bhagavatau kālai mahākālau nāma kuṭumbikau hutvā aṭṭhakarīsamattai khaittai sāligabbhaṃ phālaitvā gahitasālitaṇḍulaihi asambhin‍nakhīrapāyāsaṃ sampādaitvā tattha madhusappisak‍karādayau pakkhipitvā buddhappamukhassa saṅghassa adāsi| sāligabbhaṃ phālaitvā gahitagahitaṭṭhānaṃ  puna pūrati| puthukakālai puthukaggaṃ nāma adāsi| lāyanai lāyanaggaṃ, vaiṇikaraṇai vaiṇaggaṃ, kalāpādikaraṇai kalāpaggaṃ, khalaggaṃ, bhaṇḍaggaṃ, minaggaṃ kauṭṭhagganti aivaṃ aikasassai nava vārai aggadānaṃ adāsi, tampi sassaṃ atiraikataraṃ sampan‍naṃ ahausi|

aivaṃ yāvajīvaṃ puñ‍ñāni katvā tatau cutau daivalaukai nibbattitvā daivaisu ca manussaisu ca saṃsarantau amhākaṃ bhagavatau uppattitau puraitaramaiva kapilavatthunagarassa avidūrai dauṇavatthunāmakai brāhmaṇagāmai brāhmaṇamahāsālakulai nibbatti| tassa kauṇḍañ‍ñauti gauttatau āgataṃ nāmaṃ ahausi| sau vayappattau tayau vaidai uggahaitvā lakkhaṇamantaisu ca pāraṃ agamāsi| taina samayaina amhākaṃ baudhisattau tusitapuratau cavitvā kapilavatthupurai suddhaudanamahārājassa gaihai nibbatti| tassa nāmaggahaṇadivasai aṭṭhuttarasataisu brāhmaṇaisu upanītaisu yai aṭṭha brāhmaṇā lakkhaṇapariggahaṇatthaṃ mahātalaṃ upanītā| sau taisu sabbanavakau hutvā mahāpurisassa lakkhaṇanipphattiṃ disvā ‘‘aikaṃsaina ayaṃ buddhau bhavissatī’’ti niṭṭhaṃ gantvā mahāsattassa abhinikkhamanaṃ udikkhantau vicarati|

baudhisattaupi  khau mahatā parivāraina vaḍḍhamānau anuk‍kamaina vuddhippattau ñāṇaparipākaṃ gantvā aikūnatiṃsatimai vassai mahābhinikkhamanaṃ nikkhamantau anaumānadītīrai pabbajitvā anuk‍kamaina uruvailaṃ gantvā padhānaṃ padahi| tadā kauṇḍañ‍ñau māṇavau mahāsattassa pabbajitabhāvaṃ sutvā lakkhaṇapariggāhakabrāhmaṇānaṃ puttaihi vappamāṇavādīhi saddhiṃ attapañ‍camau  pabbajitvā anuk‍kamaina baudhisattassa santikaṃ upasaṅkamitvā chabbassāni taṃ upaṭṭhahantau tassa auḷārikāhāraparibhaugaina nibbin‍nau apak‍kamitvā isipatanaṃ agamāsi| atha khau baudhisattau auḷārikāhāraparibhaugaina laddhakāyabalau vaisākhapuṇṇamāyaṃ baudhirukkhamūlai aparājitapal‍laṅkai nisin‍nau tiṇṇaṃ mārānaṃ matthakaṃ madditvā abhisambuddhau hutvā sattasattāhaṃ baudhimaṇḍaiyaiva vītināmaitvā pañ‍cavaggiyānaṃ ñāṇaparipākaṃ ñatvā āsāḷhīpuṇṇamāyaṃ isipatanaṃ gantvā taisaṃ dhammacak‍kapavattanasuttantaṃ (mahāva॰ 13 ādayau; saṃ॰ ni॰ 5.1081) kathaisi| daisanāpariyausānai kauṇḍañ‍ñatthairau  aṭṭhārasahi brahmakauṭīhi saddhiṃ sautāpattiphalai patiṭṭhāsi| atha pañ‍camiyaṃ pakkhassa anattalakkhaṇasuttantadaisanāya (mahāva॰ 20 ādayau; saṃ॰ ni॰ 3.59) arahattaṃ sacchākāsi|

596. aivaṃ sau arahattaṃ patvā ‘‘kiṃ kammaṃ katvā ahaṃ laukuttarasukhaṃ adhigataumhī’’ti upadhāraintau attanau pubbakammaṃ pac‍cakkhatau ñatvā saumanassavasaina pubbacaritāpadānaṃ udānavasaina dassaintau padumuttarasambuddhantiādimāha| tassatthau haiṭṭhā vuttauyaiva| laukajaiṭṭhaṃ vināyakanti sakalassa sattalaukassa jaiṭṭhaṃ padhānanti atthau| visaisaina vainaiyyasattai saṃsārasāgarassa paratīraṃ amatamahānibbānaṃ naiti sampāpaitīti vināyakau, taṃ vināyakaṃ| buddhabhūmimanuppattanti buddhassa bhūmi patiṭṭhānaṭṭhānanti buddhabhūmi, sabbañ‍ñutañ‍ñāṇaṃ, taṃ anuppattau paṭividdhauti buddhabhūmimanuppattau, taṃ buddhabhūmimanuppattaṃ, sabbañ‍ñutappattaṃ buddhabhūtanti atthau| paṭhamaṃ addasaṃ ahanti paṭhamaṃ vaisākhapuṇṇamiyā rattiyā pac‍cūsasamayai buddhabhūtaṃ padumuttarasambuddhaṃ ahaṃ addakkhinti atthau|

597. yāvatā baudhiyā mūlaiti yattakā baudhirukkhasamīpai yakkhā samāgatā rāsibhūtā sambuddhaṃ buddhabhūtaṃ taṃ buddhaṃ pañ‍jalīkatā dasaṅgulisamaudhānaṃ añ‍jalipuṭaṃ sirasi ṭhapaitvā vandanti namassantīti sambandhau|

598. sabbai daivā tuṭṭhamanāti buddhabhūtaṭṭhānaṃ āgatā tai sabbai daivā tuṭṭhacittā ākāsai sañ‍carantīti  sambandhau| andhakāratamaunudauti ativiya andhakāraṃ mauhaṃ nudau khaipanau ayaṃ buddhau anuppattauti atthau|

599. taisaṃ hāsaparaitānanti hāsaihi pītisaumanassaihi saman‍nāgatānaṃ taisaṃ daivānaṃ mahānādau mahāghausau avattatha pavattati, sammāsambuddhasāsanai  kilaisai saṃkilaisai dhammai jhāpayissāmāti sambandhau|

600. daivānaṃ giramañ‍ñāyāti vācāya thutivacanaina saha udīritaṃ daivānaṃ saddaṃ jānitvā haṭṭhau haṭṭhaina cittaina saumanassasahagataina cittaina ādibhikkhaṃ paṭhamaṃ āhāraṃ buddhabhūtassa ahaṃ adāsinti sambandhau|

602. sattāhaṃ  abhinikkhammāti mahābhinikkhamanaṃ nikkhamitvā sattāhaṃ padhānaṃ katvā sabbañ‍ñutañ‍ñāṇapadaṭṭhānaṃ arahattamaggañāṇasaṅkhātaṃ baudhiṃ ajjhagamaṃ adhigañchiṃ ahanti atthau| idaṃ mai paṭhamaṃ bhattanti idaṃ bhattaṃ sarīrayāpanaṃ brahmacārissa uttamacārissa mai mayhaṃ iminā daivaputtaina paṭhamaṃ din‍naṃ ahausīti atthau|

603. tusitā hi idhāgantvāti tusitabhavanatau idha manussalaukai āgantvā yau daivaputtau mai mama bhikkhaṃ upānayi adāsi, taṃ daivaputtaṃ kittayissāmi kathaissāmi pākaṭaṃ karissāmi| bhāsatau bhāsantassa mama vacanaṃ suṇāthāti sambandhau| itau paraṃ anuttānapadamaiva vaṇṇayissāma|

607. tidasāti tāvatiṃsabhavanā| agārāti attanau uppan‍nabrāhmaṇagaihatau nikkhamitvā pabbajitvā cha saṃvaccharāni duk‍karakārikaṃ karauntaina baudhisattaina saha vasissatīti sambandhau|

608. tatau sattamakai vassaiti tatau pabbajitakālatau paṭṭhāya sattamai saṃvaccharai| buddhau sac‍caṃ kathaissatīti chabbassāni duk‍karakārikaṃ katvā sattamasaṃvaccharai buddhau hutvā bārāṇasiyaṃ isipatanai migadāyai dhammacak‍kapavattanasuttantadaisanāya dukkhasamudayaniraudhamaggasac‍casaṅkhātaṃ catusac‍caṃ kathaissatīti atthau| kauṇḍañ‍ñau nāma nāmaināti nāmaina gauttanāmavasaina kauṇḍañ‍ñau nāma| paṭhamaṃ sacchikāhitīti pañ‍cavaggiyānamantarai paṭhamaṃ āditau aiva sautāpattimaggañāṇaṃ sacchikāhiti pac‍cakkhaṃ karissatīti atthau|

609. nikkhantainānupabbajinti  nikkhantaina baudhisattaina saha nikkhamitvā anupabbajinti atthau| tathā anupabbajitvā mayā padhānaṃ vīriyaṃ sukataṃ suṭṭhu kataṃ daḷhaṃ katvā katanti atthau| kilaisai jhāpanatthāyāti kilaisai sausanatthāya viddhaṃsanatthāya anagāriyaṃ agārassa ahitaṃ kasivaṇij‍jādikammavirahitaṃ sāsanaṃ pabbajiṃ paṭipaj‍jinti atthau|

610. abhigantvāna  sabbañ‍ñūti sabbaṃ atītānāgatapac‍cuppan‍naṃ vā saṅkhāravikāralakkhaṇanibbānapañ‍ñattisaṅkhātaṃ ñaiyyaṃ vā jānantau daivaihi saha vattamānai satta laukai buddhau migārañ‍ñaṃ migadāya vihāraṃ abhigantvā upasaṅkamitvā mai mayā sacchikataina iminā sautāpattimaggañāṇaina amatabhairiṃ amatamahānibbānabhairiṃ ahari pahari dassaisīti atthau|

611. sau dānīti sau ahaṃ paṭhamaṃ sautāpan‍nau idāni arahattamaggañāṇaina amataṃ santaṃ vūpasantasabhāvaṃ padaṃ paj‍jitabbaṃ pāpuṇitabbaṃ, anuttaraṃ uttaravirahitaṃ nibbānaṃ pattau adhigatauti atthau| sabbāsavai pariñ‍ñāyāti kāmāsavādayau sabbai āsavai pariñ‍ñāya pahānapariñ‍ñāya pajahitvā anāsavau nik‍kilaisau viharāmi iriyāpathavihāraina vāsaṃ kappaimi| paṭisambhidā catassautyādayau gāthāyau vuttatthāyaiva|

atha naṃ satthā aparabhāgai jaitavanamahāvihārai bhikkhusaṅghamajjhai pañ‍ñattavarabuddhāsanai nisin‍nau paṭhamaṃ paṭividdhadhammabhāvaṃ dīpaintau ‘‘aitadaggaṃ, bhikkhavai, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ rattañ‍ñūnaṃ yadidaṃ añ‍ñāsikauṇḍañ‍ñau’’ti (a॰ ni॰ 1.188) aitadaggai ṭhapaisi| sau dvīhi aggasāvakaihi attani kariyamānaṃ paramanipac‍cakāraṃ, gāmantasaināsanai ākiṇṇavihārañ‍ca pariharitukāmau, vivaikābhiratiyā viharitukāmau ca attanau santikaṃ upagatānaṃ gahaṭṭhapabbajitānaṃ paṭisanthārakaraṇampi papañ‍caṃ mañ‍ñamānau satthāraṃ āpucchitvā himavantaṃ pavisitvā chaddantaihi nāgaihi upaṭṭhiyamānau chaddantadahatīrai dvādasa vassāni vasi| aivaṃ tattha vasantaṃ thairaṃ aikadivasaṃ sak‍kau daivarājā upasaṅkamitvā vanditvā ṭhitau aivamāha ‘‘sādhu mai, bhantai, ayyau dhammaṃ daisaitū’’ti| thairau tassa catusac‍cagabbhaṃ tilakkhaṇāhataṃ suñ‍ñatāpaṭisaṃyuttaṃ nānānayavicittaṃ amataugadhaṃ buddhalīlāya dhammaṃ daisaisi| taṃ sutvā sak‍kau attanau pasādaṃ pavaidaintau –

‘‘aisa  bhiyyau pasīdāmi, sutvā dhammaṃ mahārasaṃ|

virāgau daisitau dhammau, anupādāya sabbasau’’ti|| (thairagā॰ 673) –

thutiṃ  akāsi| thairau chaddantadahatīrai dvādasa vassāni vasitvā upakaṭṭhai parinibbānai satthāraṃ upasaṅkamitvā parinibbānaṃ anujānāpaitvā tatthaiva gantvā parinibbāyīti|

añ‍ñāsikauṇḍañ‍ñatthairaapadānavaṇṇanā samattā|

3-8. piṇḍaulabhāradvājatthairaapadānavaṇṇanā

padumuttarau  nāma jinautiādikaṃ āyasmatau piṇḍaulabhāradvājassa apadānaṃ| ayampi purimabuddhaisu katādhikārau tattha tattha bhavai vivaṭṭūpanissayāni puñ‍ñāni upacinantau padumuttarassa bhagavatau kālai sīhayauniyaṃ nibbattitvā pabbatapādai guhāyaṃ vihāsi| bhagavā tassa anuggahaṃ kātuṃ gaucarāya pak‍kantakālai tassa sayanaguhaṃ pavisitvā niraudhaṃ samāpaj‍jitvā nisīdi| sīhau gaucaraṃ gahaitvā nivattau guhadvārai ṭhatvā bhagavantaṃ disvā haṭṭhatuṭṭhau jalajathalajapupphaihi pūjaṃ katvā cittaṃ pasādaintau bhagavatau ārakkhaṇatthāya añ‍ñai vāḷamigai apanaituṃ tīsu vailāsu sīhanādaṃ nadantau buddhagatāya satiyā aṭṭhāsi| yathā paṭhamadivasai, aivaṃ sattāhaṃ pūjaisi| bhagavā ‘‘sattāhac‍cayaina niraudhā vuṭṭhahitvā vaṭṭissati imassa aittakau upanissayau’’ti tassa passantassaiva ākāsaṃ pakkhanditvā vihāramaiva gatau|

sīhau buddhaviyaugadukkhaṃ adhivāsaituṃ asak‍kauntau kālaṃ katvā haṃsavatīnagarai mahābhaugakulai nibbattitvā vayappattau nagaravāsīhi saddhiṃ vihāraṃ gantvā satthu dhammadaisanaṃ sutvā pasan‍nau sattāhaṃ buddhappamukhassa bhikkhusaṅghassa mahādānaṃ pavattaitvā yāvajīvaṃ puñ‍ñāni katvā aparāparaṃ daivamanussaisu saṃsarantau amhākaṃ bhagavatau kālai kausambiyaṃ rañ‍ñau udainassa purauhitassa puttau hutvā nibbatti| bhāradvājautissa nāmaṃ ahausi| sau vayappatau tayau vaidai uggahaitvā pañ‍ca māṇavakasatāni mantai vācaintau mahagghasabhāvaina ananurūpācārattā  taihi paric‍cattau rājagahaṃ gantvā bhagavatau bhikkhusaṅghassa ca lābhasak‍kāraṃ disvā sāsanai pabbajitvā bhaujanai amattañ‍ñū hutvā viharati| satthārā upāyaina mattañ‍ñutāya patiṭṭhāpaintau vipassanaṃ paṭṭhapaitvā nacirassaiva chaḷabhiñ‍ñau ahausi| chaḷabhiñ‍ñau pana hutvā bhagavatau sammukhā  ‘‘yaṃ sāvakaihi pattabbaṃ, taṃ mayā anuppatta’’nti, bhikkhusaṅghai ca ‘‘yassa maggai vā phalai vā kaṅkhā atthi, sau maṃ pucchatū’’ti sīhanādaṃ nadi| taina taṃ bhagavā – ‘‘aitadaggaṃ, bhikkhavai, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ sīhanādikānaṃ yadidaṃ piṇḍaulabhāradvājau’’ti (a॰ ni॰ 1.188, 195) aitadaggai ṭhapaisi|

613. aivaṃ aitadaggaṃ ṭhānaṃ patvā pubbai katapuñ‍ñasambhāraṃ saritvā saumanassavasaina attanau puñ‍ñakammāpadānaṃ vibhāvaintau padumuttarautiādimāha| tassatthau haiṭṭhā vuttauva| puratau himavantassāti himālayapabbatatau pubbadisābhāgaiti atthau| cittakūṭai  vasī tadāti yadā ahaṃ sīhau migarājā hutvā himavantapabbatasamīpai vasāmi, tadā padumuttarau nāma satthā anaikaihi ca ausadhaihi, anaikaihi ca ratanaihi cittavicittatāya cittakūṭai cittapabbatasikharai vasīti sambandhau|

614. abhītarūpau tatthāsinti abhītasabhāvau nibbhayasabhāvau migarājā tattha āsiṃ ahausinti atthau| catuk‍kamauti catūhi disāhi kamau gantuṃ samatthau| yassa saddaṃ suṇitvānāti yassa migarañ‍ñau sīhanādaṃ sutvā bahuj‍janā bahusattā vikkhambhanti visaisaina khambhanti bhāyanti|

615. suphul‍laṃ padumaṃ gayhāti bhagavati pasādaina supupphitapadumapupphaṃ ḍaṃsitvā| narāsabhaṃ narānaṃ āsabhaṃ uttamaṃ saiṭṭhaṃ sambuddhaṃ upagacchiṃ, samīpaṃ agaminti atthau| vuṭṭhitassa samādhimhāti niraudhasamāpattitau vuṭṭhitassa buddhassa taṃ pupphaṃ abhiraupayiṃ pūjaisinti atthau|

616. catuddisaṃ namassitvāti catūsu disāsu namassitvā sakaṃ cittaṃ attanau cittaṃ pasādaitvā ādaraina patiṭṭhapaitvā sīhanādaṃ abhītanādaṃ anadiṃ ghausaisinti atthau|

617. tatau  buddhaina din‍nabyākaraṇaṃ pakāsaintau padumuttarautiādimāha| taṃ uttānatthamaiva|

618. vadataṃ saiṭṭhauti ‘‘mayaṃ buddhā, mayaṃ buddhā’’ti vadantānaṃ añ‍ñatitthiyānaṃ saiṭṭhau uttamau buddhau āgatauti sambandhau| tassa āgatassa bhagavatau taṃ dhammaṃ saussāma suṇissāmāti atthau|

619. taisaṃ  hāsaparaitānanti hāsaihi saumanassaihi paraitānaṃ abhibhūtānaṃ saman‍nāgatānaṃ taisaṃ daivamanussānaṃ| laukanāyakauti laukassa nāyakau saggamaukkhasampāpakau mama saddaṃ mayhaṃ sīhanādaṃ pakittaisi pakāsaisi kathaisi, dīghadassī anāgatakāladassī mahāmuni munīnamantarai mahantau muni| saisagāthā suviñ‍ñaiyyamaiva|

622. nāmaina padumau nāma cak‍kavattī hutvā catusaṭṭhiyā jātiyā issariyaṃ issarabhāvaṃ raj‍jaṃ kārayissatīti atthau|

623. kappasatasahassamhīti sāmyatthai bhummavacanaṃ, kappasatasahassānaṃ pariyausānaiti atthau|

624. pakāsitai pāvacanaiti taina gautamaina bhagavatā piṭakattayai pakāsitai daisitaiti atthau| brahmabandhu bhavissatīti tadā gautamassa bhagavatau kālai ayaṃ sīhau migarājā brāhmaṇakulai nibbattissatīti atthau| brahmañ‍ñā abhinikkhammāti brāhmaṇakulatau nikkhamitvā tassa bhagavatau sāsanai pabbajissatīti sambandhau|

625. padhānapahitattauti vīriyakaraṇatthaṃ paisitacittau| upadhisaṅkhātānaṃ  kilaisānaṃ abhāvaina nirupadhi| kilaisadarathānaṃ abhāvaina upasantau| sabbāsavai sakalāsavai pariñ‍ñāya pahāya anāsavau nik‍kilaisau nibbāyissati khandhaparinibbānaina nibbutau bhavissatīti atthau|

626. vijanai pantasaiyyamhīti janasambādharahitai dūrārañ‍ñasaināsanaiti atthau| vāḷamigasamākulaiti kāḷasīhādīhi caṇḍamigasaṅgaihi ākulai saṃkiṇṇaiti atthau| saisaṃ vuttatthamaivāti|

piṇḍaulabhāradvājatthairaapadānavaṇṇanā samattā|

3-9. khadiravaniyatthairaapadānavaṇṇanā

gaṅgā  bhāgīrathī nāmātiādikaṃ āyasmatau khadiravaniyatthairassa apadānaṃ| ayampi purimabuddhaisu katādhikārau tattha tattha bhavai vivaṭṭūpanissayāni puñ‍ñāni upacinantau padumuttarassa bhagavatau kālai haṃsavatīnagarai titthanāvikakulai nibbattitvā mahāgaṅgāya payāgatitthai titthanāvāya kammaṃ karauntau aikadivasaṃ sasāvakasaṅghaṃ bhagavantaṃ gaṅgātīraṃ upagataṃ disvā pasan‍namānasau nāvāsaṅghāṭaṃ yaujaitvā mahantaina pūjāsak‍kāraina paratīraṃ pāpaitvā añ‍ñataraṃ bhikkhuṃ satthārā ārañ‍ñakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ aggaṭṭhānai ṭhapiyamānaṃ disvā taṃ ṭhānantaraṃ patthaitvā bhagavatau bhikkhusaṅghassa ca mahādānaṃ pavattaitvā paṇidhānaṃ akāsi| bhagavā tassa patthanāya avañjhabhāvaṃ byākāsi|

sau tatau paṭṭhāya puñ‍ñāni upacinantau daivamanussaisu saṃsarantau ubhayasampattiyau anubhavitvā imasmiṃ buddhuppādai magadharaṭṭhai nālakagāmai rūpasāriyā nāma brāhmaṇiyā kucchimhi nibbatti| taṃ vayappattaṃ mātāpitarau gharabandhanaina bandhitukāmā hutvā tassa āraucaisuṃ| sau sāriputtatthairassa pabbajitabhāvaṃ sutvā ‘‘mayhaṃ jaiṭṭhabhātā ayyau upatissau imaṃ vibhavaṃ chaḍḍaitvā pabbajitau, taina vantaṃ khaiḷapiṇḍaṃ kathāhaṃ anubhavissāmī’’ti jātasaṃvaigau pāsaṃ anupagacchamānamigau viya ñātakai vañ‍caitvā haitusampattiyā caudiyamānau bhikkhūnaṃ santikaṃ gantvā dhammasaināpatinau kaniṭṭhabhāvaṃ nivaidaitvā attanau pabbaj‍jāya chandaṃ āraucaisi| bhikkhū taṃ pabbājaitvā paripuṇṇavīsativassaṃ upasampādaitvā kammaṭṭhānai niyaujaisuṃ| sau kammaṭṭhānaṃ gahaitvā khadiravanaṃ pavisitvā vissamantau ghaṭaintau vāyamantau ñāṇassa paripākaṃ gatattā nacirassaiva chaḷabhiñ‍ñau arahā ahausi| sau arahā hutvā satthāraṃ dhammasaināpatiñ‍ca vandituṃ saināsanaṃ saṃsāmaitvā pattacīvaramādāya nikkhamitvā anupubbaina sāvatthiṃ patvā jaitavanaṃ pavisitvā satthāraṃ dhammasaināpatiñ‍ca vanditvā katipāhaṃ jaitavanai vihāsi| atha naṃ satthā ariyagaṇamajjhai  nisin‍nau ārañ‍ñakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ aggaṭṭhānai ṭhapaisi – ‘‘aitadaggaṃ, bhikkhavai, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ ārañ‍ñakānaṃ yadidaṃ raivatau’’ti (a॰ ni॰ 1.198, 203)|

628. aivaṃ  aitadaggaṭṭhānaṃ patvā attanau pubbakammaṃ saritvā pītisaumanassavasaina pubbacaritāpadānaṃ pakāsaintau gaṅgā bhāgīrathītiādimāha| tattha gaṅgāti gāyamānā ghausaṃ kurumānā gacchatīti gaṅgā| atha vā gau vuc‍cati pathavī, tasmiṃ gatā pavattāti gaṅgā| anautattadahaṃ  tikkhattuṃ padakkhiṇaṃ katvā gataṭṭhānai āvaṭṭagaṅgāti ca pabbatamatthakaina gataṭṭhānai bahalagaṅgāti ca tiracchānapabbataṃ vijjhitvā gataṭṭhānai umaṅgagaṅgāti ca tatau bahalapabbataṃ paharitvā pañ‍cayaujanaṃ ākāsaina gataṭṭhānai ākāsagaṅgāti ca tassā patitaṭṭhānaṃ bhinditvā jātaṃ pañ‍ca yaujanaṃ paukkharaṇīkūlaṃ bhinditvā tattha pana pañ‍caṅguli viya pañ‍ca dhārā hutvā gaṅgā yamunā sarabhū mahī aciravatīti pañ‍ca nāmā hutvā jambudīpaṃ pañ‍ca bhāgaṃ pañ‍ca kauṭṭhāsaṃ katvā pañ‍ca bhāgai pañ‍ca kauṭṭhāsai itā gatā pavattāti bhāgīrathī| gaṅgā ca sā bhāgīrathī caiti gaṅgābhāgīrathī| ‘‘bhāgīrathī gaṅgā’’ti vattabbai gāthābandhasukhatthaṃ pubbacariyavasaina vuttanti daṭṭhabbaṃ| himavantā pabhāvitāti sattai hiṃsati sītaina hanati mathaiti ālauḷaitīti himau, himau assa atthīti himavā, tatau himavantatau paṭṭhāya pabhāvitā pavattā sandamānāti himavantapabhāvitā| kutitthai nāvikau āsinti tassā gaṅgāya caṇḍasautasamāpan‍nai visamatitthai kaivaṭṭakulai uppan‍nau nāvikau āsiṃ ahausinti atthau| aurimai ca tariṃ ahanti sampattasampattamanussai pārimā tīrā aurimaṃ tīraṃ ahaṃ tariṃ tāraisinti atthau|

629. padumuttarau nāyakauti dvipadānaṃ uttamau sattai nibbānaṃ nāyakau pāpanakau padumuttarabuddhau mama puñ‍ñasampattiṃ nipphādaintau| vasīsatasahassaihi khīṇāsavasatasahassaihi gaṅgāsautaṃ tarituṃ titthaṃ pattauti sambandhau|

630. bahū nāvā samānaitvāti sampattaṃ taṃ sammāsambuddhaṃ disvā vaḍḍhakīhi suṭṭhu saṅkhataṃ kataṃ nipphāditaṃ bahū nāvāyau samānaitvā dvai dvai nāvāyau aikatau katvā tassā nāvāya upari maṇḍapachadanaṃ katvā narāsabhaṃ padumuttarasambuddhaṃ paṭimāniṃ pūjaisinti atthau|

631. āgantvāna  ca sambuddhauti aivaṃ saṅghaṭitāya nāvāya tattha āgantvāna  tañ‍ca nāvakaṃ nāvamuttamaṃ āruhīti sambandhau| vārimajjhai ṭhitau satthāti nāvamārūḷhau satthā gaṅgājalamajjhai ṭhitau samānau imā saumanassapaṭisaṃyuttagāthā abhāsatha kathaisīti sambandhau|

632. yau sau tāraisi sambuddhanti yau sau nāvikau gaṅgāsautāya sambuddhaṃ atāraisi| saṅghañ‍cāpi anāsavanti na kaivalamaiva sambuddhaṃ tāraisi, anāsavaṃ nik‍kilaisaṃ saṅghañ‍cāpi tāraisīti atthau| taina cittapasādaināti taina nāvāpājanakālai uppan‍naina saumanassasahagatacittapasādaina daivalaukai chasu kāmasaggaisu ramissati dibbasampattiṃ anubhavissatīti atthau|

633. nibbattissati  tai byamhanti daivalaukai uppan‍nassa tai tuyhaṃ byamhaṃ vimānaṃ sukataṃ suṭṭhu nibbattaṃ nāvasaṇṭhitaṃ nāvāsaṇṭhānaṃ nibbattissati pātubhavissatīti atthau| ākāsai pupphachadananti nāvāya uparimaṇḍapakatakammassa nissandaina sabbadā gatagataṭṭhānai ākāsai pupphachadanaṃ dhārayissatīti sambandhau|

634. aṭṭhapañ‍ñāsakappamhīti itau puñ‍ñakaraṇakālatau paṭṭhāya aṭṭhapaṇṇāsakappaṃ atik‍kamitvā nāmaina tārakau nāma cak‍kavattī khattiyau cāturantau catūsu dīpaisu issarau vijitāvī jitavantau bhavissatīti sambandhau| saisagāthā uttānatthāva|

637. raivatau nāma nāmaināti raivatīnakkhattaina jātattā ‘‘raivatau’’ti laddhanāmau brahmabandhu brāhmaṇaputtabhūtau bhavissati brāhmaṇakulai uppaj‍jissatīti atthau|

639. nibbāyissatināsavauti nik‍kilaisau khandhaparinibbānaina nibbāyissati|

640. vīriyaṃ mai dhuradhaurayhanti aivaṃ padumuttaraina bhagavatā byākatau ahaṃ kamaina pāramitākauṭiṃ patvā mai mayhaṃ vīriyaṃ asithilavīriyaṃ dhuradhaurayhaṃ dhuravāhaṃ dhurādhāraṃ yaugaihi khaimassa nibbhayassa nibbānassa adhivāhanaṃ  āvahanaṃ ahausīti atthau| dhāraimi antimaṃ daihanti idānāhaṃ sammāsambuddhasāsanai pariyausānasarīraṃ dhāraimīti sambandhau|

sau aparabhāgai attanau jātagāmaṃ gantvā ‘‘cālā, upacālā, sīsūpacālā’’ti tissan‍naṃ bhaginīnaṃ puttai ‘‘cālā, upacālā, sīsūpacālā’’ti tayau bhāginaiyyai ānaitvā pabbājaitvā kammaṭṭhānai niyaujaisi| tai kammaṭṭhānaṃ anuyuttā vihariṃsu|

tasmiñ‍ca samayai thairassa kaucidaiva ābādhau uppan‍nau, taṃ sutvā sāriputtatthairau – ‘‘raivatassa gilānapucchanaṃ  adhigamapucchanañ‍ca karissāmī’’ti upagañchi| raivatatthairau dhammasaināpatiṃ dūratauva āgacchantaṃ disvā taisaṃ sāmaṇairānaṃ satuppādavasaina auvadiyamānau cālaitigāthaṃ abhāsittha| tattha cālai upacālai sīsūpacālaiti taisaṃ ālapanaṃ| cālā, upacālā, sīsūpacālāti hi itthiliṅgavasaina laddhanāmā tayau dārakā pabbajitāpi tathā vauhariyyanti| ‘‘cālī, upacālī, sīsūpacālīti taisaṃ nāmānī’’ti ca vadanti| yadatthaṃ ‘‘cālai’’tiādinā āmantanaṃ kataṃ, taṃ dassaintau ‘‘patissatā nu khau viharathā’’ti vatvā tattha kāraṇaṃ āha – ‘‘āgatau vau vālaṃ viya vaidhī’’ti| patissatāti patissatikā| khauti avadhāraṇai| āgatauti āgañchi| vauti tumhākaṃ| vālaṃ viya vaidhīti vālavaidhi viya| ayañhaittha saṅkhaipatthau – tikkhajavananibbaidhikapañ‍ñatāya vālavaidhirūpau satthukappau tumhākaṃ mātulatthairau āgatau, tasmā samaṇasañ‍ñaṃ upaṭṭhapaitvā satisampajañ‍ñayuttā aiva hutvā viharatha, yathādhigatai vihārai appamattā bhavathāti|

taṃ sutvā tai sāmaṇairā dhammasaināpatissa pac‍cuggamanādivattaṃ katvā ubhin‍naṃ mātulatthairānaṃ paṭisanthāravailāyaṃ nātidūrai samādhiṃ samāpaj‍jitvā nisīdiṃsu| dhammasaināpati raivatatthairaina saddhiṃ paṭisanthāraṃ katvā uṭṭhāyāsanā tai sāmaṇairai upasaṅkami| tai tathā kālaparicchaidassa katattā thairai upasaṅkamantai uṭṭhahitvā vanditvā aṭṭhaṃsu| thairau – ‘‘katarakataravihāraina viharathā’’ti pucchitvā taihi ‘‘imāya imāyā’’ti vuttai dārakaipi aivaṃ vinaintau – ‘‘mayhaṃ bhātikau sac‍cavādī vata  dhammassa anudhammacāri’’nti thairaṃ pasaṃsantau pak‍kāmi| saisamaittha uttānatthamaivāti|

khadiravaniyatthairaapadānavaṇṇanā samattā|

3-10. ānandatthairaapadānavaṇṇanā

ārāmadvārā nikkhammātiādikaṃ āyasmatau ānandatthairassa apadānaṃ| ayampi purimabuddhaisu katādhikārau tattha tattha bhavai vivaṭṭūpanissayāni puñ‍ñāni upacinantau padumuttarassa bhagavatau kālai haṃsavatīnagarai satthu vaimātikabhātā hutvā nibbatti| sumanautissa nāmaṃ ahausi| pitā panassa nandarājā nāma| sau attanau puttassa sumanakumārassa vayappattassa haṃsavatīnagaratau vīsayaujanasatai ṭhānai bhauganagaraṃ adāsi| sau kadāci  kadāci āgantvā satthārañ‍ca pitarañ‍ca passati| tadā rājā satthārañ‍ca satasahassaparimāṇaṃ bhikkhusaṅghañ‍ca sayamaiva sak‍kac‍caṃ upaṭṭhahi, añ‍ñaisaṃ upaṭṭhātuṃ na daiti|

taina samayaina pac‍cantau kupitau ahausi| kumārau tassa kupitabhāvaṃ rañ‍ñau anāraucaitvā sayamaiva taṃ vūpasamaisi| taṃ sutvā rājā tuṭṭhamānasau ‘‘varaṃ tai tāva dammi, gaṇhāhī’’ti āha| kumārau ‘‘satthāraṃ bhikkhusaṅghañ‍ca taimāsaṃ upaṭṭhahantau jīvitaṃ avañjhaṃ kātuṃ icchāmī’’ti āha| ‘‘aitaṃ na sak‍kā, añ‍ñaṃ vadaihī’’ti| ‘‘daiva, khattiyānaṃ dvai kathā nāma natthi, aitaṃ mai daihi, na mayhaṃ añ‍ñainatthau, sacai satthā anujānāti, din‍namaivā’’ti| sau  ‘‘satthu cittaṃ jānissāmī’’ti vihāraṃ gatau| taina ca samayaina bhagavā gandhakuṭiṃ paviṭṭhau hauti| sau bhikkhū upasaṅkamitvā ‘‘ahaṃ, bhantai, bhagavantaṃ dassanāya āgatau, dassaitha ma’’nti| bhikkhū ‘‘sumanau nāma thairau satthu upaṭṭhākau, tassa santikaṃ gacchāhī’’ti āhaṃsu| sau thairassa santikaṃ gantvā ‘‘satthāraṃ, bhantai, dassaithā’’ti āha| atha thairau tassa passantassaiva pathaviyaṃ nimuj‍jitvā bhagavantaṃ upasaṅkamitvā ‘‘rājaputtau, bhantai, tumhākaṃ dassanāya āgatau’’ti āha| ‘‘taina hi bhikkhu bahi āsanaṃ  pañ‍ñapaihī’’ti| thairau punapi buddhāsanaṃ gahaitvā antaugandhakuṭiyaṃ nimuj‍jitvā tassa passantassa bahiparivaiṇai pātubhavitvā gandhakuṭiparivaiṇai āsanaṃ pañ‍ñāpaisi| kumārau taṃ disvā ‘‘mahantau vatāyaṃ bhikkhū’’ti cittaṃ uppādaisi|

bhagavāpi gandhakuṭitau nikkhamitvā pañ‍ñattāsanai nisīdi| rājaputtau satthāraṃ vanditvā paṭisanthāraṃ katvā ‘‘ayaṃ, bhantai, thairau tumhākaṃ sāsanai val‍labhau mañ‍ñai’’ti? ‘‘āma, kumāra, val‍labhau’’ti| ‘‘kiṃ katvā, bhantai, aisa val‍labhau’’ti? ‘‘dānādīni puñ‍ñāni katvā’’ti| ‘‘bhagavā, ahampi ayaṃ thairau viya anāgatai buddhasāsanai val‍labhau hautukāmau’’ti sau buddhappamukhassa saṅghassa sattāhaṃ khandhāvārai bhattaṃ datvā sattamai divasai, ‘‘bhantai, mayā pitu santikā tumhākaṃ taimāsaṃ paṭijagganavarau laddhau, taimāsaṃ mai vassāvāsaṃ adhivāsaithā’’ti vatvā satthu adhivāsanaṃ viditvā saparivāraṃ bhagavantaṃ gahaitvā yaujanai yaujanai satthu bhikkhusaṅghassa ca vasanānucchavikai vihārai kāraitvā tattha tattha vasāpaintau attanau vasanaṭṭhānasamīpai satasahassaina kītai saubhananāmakai uyyānai satasahassaina kāritaṃ vihāraṃ pavaisāpaitvā –

‘‘satasahassaina mai kītaṃ, satasahassaina kāritaṃ|

saubhanaṃ nāma uyyānaṃ, paṭiggaṇha mahāmunī’’ti|| –
