sattamāpadānai padumuttarau nāma jinautiādikaṃ āyasmatau abhayatthairassa apadānaṃ| ayampi purimajinavaraisu katādhikārau tattha tattha bhavai vipaṭṭūpanissayāni puñ‍ñāni upacinantau padumuttarassa bhagavatau kālai haṃsavatīnagarai brāhmaṇakulai nibbattau| sau vuddhimanvāya vaidaṅgapāragau sakaparasamayakusalau aikadivasaṃ satthu dhammadaisanaṃ sutvā pasan‍namānasau bhagavantaṃ gāthāhi thaumaisi| sau tattha yāvatāyukaṃ ṭhatvā puñ‍ñāni katvā tatau cutau daivalaukai nibbattau aparāparaṃ sugatīsuyaivaṃ  saṃsarantau imasmiṃ buddhuppādai rājagahai bimbisārarañ‍ñau puttau hutvā nibbatti, abhayautvaivassa nāmaṃ kariṃsu| sau vayappattau nigaṇṭhaihi saddhiṃ  vissāsikau hutvā carantau aikadivasaṃ nigaṇṭhaina nāṭaputtaina satthu vādāraupanatthāya paisitau nipuṇapañhaṃ pucchitvā nipuṇabyākaraṇaṃ sutvā pasan‍nau satthu santikai pabbajitvā kammaṭṭhānānurūpaṃ ñāṇaṃ paisaitvā nacirassaiva arahattaṃ pāpuṇi|

195. sau arahattaṃ patvā attanau pubbakammaṃ saritvā saumanassajātau pubbacaritāpadānaṃ pakāsaintau padumuttarau nāma jinautiādimāha| taṃ sabbaṃ suviñ‍ñaiyyamaivāti|

abhayatthairaapadānavaṇṇanā samattā|

8. laumasakaṅgiyatthairaapadānavaṇṇanā

aṭṭhamāpadānai  imamhi bhaddakai kappaitiādikaṃ āyasmatau laumasakaṅgiyatthairassa apadānaṃ| ayampi purimabuddhaisu katādhikārau tattha tattha bhavai vivaṭṭūpanissayāni puñ‍ñāni upacinantau kassapassa bhagavatau kālai brāhmaṇakulai nibbattau saddhau pasan‍nau ahausi| aparau candanau nāma tassa sahāyau cāsi| tai dvaipi satthu santikai dhammaṃ sutvā pasan‍namānasā pabbajitvā yāvajīvaṃ sīlaṃ rakkhitvā suparisuddhasīlā tatau cutā daivalaukai nibbattitvā aikaṃ buddhantaraṃ dibbasukhaṃ anubhaviṃsu| taisu ayaṃ imasmiṃ buddhuppādai sākiyakulai nibbattitvā aparau candanau daivaputtau hutvā tāvatiṃsabhavanai nibbatti| atha sau sakyakulappasādakaina kāḷudāyinā ārādhitaina bhagavatā sakyarājūnaṃ mānamaddanāya kataṃ vaissantaradhammadaisanāyaṃ (jā॰ 2.22.1655 ādayau) paukkharavassaiddhipāṭihāriyaṃ disvā pasan‍namānasau pabbajitvā majjhimanikāyai vuttaṃ bhaddaikarattasuttantadaisanaṃ sutvā arañ‍ñavāsaṃ vasantau bhaddaikarattasuttantadaisanānusāsanaṃ (ma॰ ni॰ 3.286 ādayau) saritvā tadanusāraina ñāṇaṃ paisaitvā kammaṭṭhānaṃ manasi karitvā arahattaṃ pāpuṇi|

225. arahattaṃ  patvā attanau pubbakammaṃ saritvā sañ‍jātasaumanassau pubbacaritāpadānaṃ pakāsaintau imamhi bhaddakai kappaitiādimāha| tattha kappau tāva catubbidhau – sārakappau, varakappau, maṇḍakappau, bhaddakappauti| taisu yasmiṃ kappai aikau buddhau uppaj‍jati, ayaṃ sārakappau nāma| yasmiṃ dvai vā tayau vā buddhā uppaj‍janti, ayaṃ varakappau nāma| yasmiṃ cattārau buddhā uppaj‍janti, ayaṃ maṇḍakappau nāma| yasmiṃ pañ‍ca buddhā uppaj‍janti, ayaṃ bhaddakappau nāma| añ‍ñattha pana –

‘‘sārakappau  maṇḍakappau, sāramaṇḍakappau tathā|

varakappau bhaddakappau, kappā pañ‍cavidhā siyuṃ||

‘‘aikau dvai tayau cattārau, pañ‍ca buddhā yathāk‍kamaṃ|

aitaisu pañ‍cakappaisu, uppaj‍janti vināyakā’’ti|| –

aivaṃ  pañ‍ca kappā vuttā| taisu ayaṃ kappau ‘‘kakusandhau kauṇāgamanau kassapau gautamau maittaiyyau’’ti pañ‍cabuddhapaṭimaṇḍitattā bhaddakappau nāma jātau|

tasmā imasmiṃ bhaddakappamhi kassapau nāyakau uppaj‍jīti sambandhau| saisaṃ uttānatthamaivāti|

laumasakaṅgiyatthairaapadānavaṇṇanā samattā|

9. vanavacchatthairaapadānavaṇṇanā

navamāpadānai imamhi bhaddakai kappaitiādikaṃ āyasmatau vanavacchatthairassa apadānaṃ| ayampi purimabuddhaisu katādhikārau tattha tattha bhavai vivaṭṭūpanissayāni puñ‍ñāni upacinantau kassapassa bhagavatau kālai kulagaihai nibbattau viñ‍ñutaṃ patvā satthu dhammadaisanaṃ sutvā saddhājātau pabbajitvā parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ caritvā tatau cutau daivalaukai nibbattau, tatau cutau arañ‍ñāyatanai bhikkhūnaṃ samīpai kapautayauniyaṃ nibbattau| taisu maittacittau dhammaṃ sutvā tatau cutau daivamanussaisu saṃsarantau imasmiṃ buddhuppādai kapilavatthusmiṃ brāhmaṇakulai nibbatti| tassa mātukucchigatakālaiyaiva mātu dauhaḷau udapādi vanai vasituṃ vanai vijāyituṃ| tatau icchānurūpavasaina vanai vasantiyā gabbhavuṭṭhānaṃ ahausi| gabbhatau nikkhantañ‍ca naṃ kāsāvakhaṇḍaina paṭiggahaisuṃ| tadā baudhisattassa uppan‍nakālau, rājā taṃ kumāraṃ āharāpaitvā sahaiva pausaisi| atha baudhisattau mahābhinikkhamanaṃ nikkhamitvā pabbajitvā chabbasāni duk‍karakārikaṃ katvā buddhai jātai sau mahākassapassa santikaṃ gantvā tassauvādai pasan‍nau tassa santikā buddhuppādabhāvaṃ sutvā satthu santikaṃ gantvā dhammaṃ sutvā pabbajitvā nacirassaiva chaḷabhiñ‍ñau arahā ahausi|

251. sau arahattaṃ patvā attanau pubbakammaṃ saritvā saumanassajātau pubbacaritāpadānaṃ pakāsaintau imamhi bhaddakai kappaitiādimāha| tattha brahmabandhu mahāyasauti aittha brāhmaṇānaṃ bandhu ñātakauti brāhmaṇabandhūti vattabbai gāthābandhasukhatthaṃ ‘‘brahmabandhū’’ti  vuttanti vaiditabbaṃ| laukattayabyāpakayasattā mahāyasau| saisaṃ sabbaṃ suviñ‍ñaiyyamaivāti|

vanavacchatthairaapadānavaṇṇanā samattā|

10. cūḷasugandhatthairaapadānavaṇṇanā

dasamāpadānai  imamhi bhaddakai kappaitiādikaṃ āyasmatau sugandhatthairassa apadānaṃ| ayampi purimabuddhaisu katādhikārau tattha tattha bhavai vivaṭṭūpanissayāni puñ‍ñāni upacinantau kassapasammāsambuddhakālai bārāṇasiyaṃ vibhavasampan‍nai kulai nibbattau viñ‍ñutaṃ patvā satthu santikai dhammaṃ sutvā sabbadā namassamānau mahādānaṃ dadamānau māsassa sattakkhattuṃ bhagavatau gandhakuṭiyā catuj‍jātigandhaina vilimpaisi| ‘‘mama nibbattanibbattaṭṭhānai sarīratau sugandhagandhau nibbattatū’’ti patthanaṃ akāsi| bhagavā taṃ byākāsi| sau yāvatāyukaṃ ṭhatvā puñ‍ñāni karauntau tatau cutau daivalaukai nibbattau kāmāvacaralaukaṃ sarīragandhaina sugandhaṃ kurumānau sugandhadaivaputtauti pākaṭau ahausi| sau daivalaukasampattiyau anubhavitvā tatau cutau imasmiṃ buddhuppādai mahābhaugakulai  nibbatti, tassa mātukucchigatassaiva mātuyā sarīragandhaina sakalagaihaṃ sakalanagarañ‍ca sugandhaina aikagandhaṃ ahausi, jātakkhaṇai sakalaṃ sāvatthinagaraṃ sugandhakaraṇḍakau viya ahausi, tainassa sugandhauti nāmaṃ kariṃsu| sau vuddhiṃ agamāsi| tadā satthā sāvatthiyaṃ patvā jaitavanamahāvihāraṃ paṭiggahaisi, taṃ disvā pasan‍namānasau bhagavatau santikai pabbajitvā nacirassaiva saha paṭisambhidāhi arahattaṃ pāpuṇi| tassa uppan‍nadivasatau paṭṭhāya yāva parinibbānā aitthantarai nipan‍naṭṭhānādīsu sugandhamaiva vāyi| daivāpi dibbacuṇṇadibbagandhapupphāni aukiranti|

272. saupi thairau arahattaṃ patvā attanau pubbakammaṃ saritvā saumanassajātau pubbacaritāpadānaṃ pakāsaintau imamhi bhaddakai kappaitiādimāha| taṃ sabbaṃ haiṭṭhā vuttanayattā uttānatthattā ca suviñ‍ñaiyyamaiva, kaivalaṃ puñ‍ñanānattaṃ nāmanānattañ‍ca visaisau|

cūḷasugandhatthairaapadānavaṇṇanā samattā|

pañ‍capañ‍ñāsamavaggavaṇṇanā samattā|

56. yasavaggau

1. yasatthairaapadānavaṇṇanā

chappañ‍ñāsamai  vaggai paṭhamāpadānai mahāsamuddaṃ auggayhātiādikaṃ āyasmatau yasatthairassa apadānaṃ| ayampi purimabuddhaisu katādhikārau tattha tattha bhavai vivaṭṭūpanissayāni puñ‍ñāni upacinantau sumaidhassa bhagavatau kālai mahānubhāvau nāgarājā hutvā buddhappamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ attanau bhavanaṃ naitvā mahādānaṃ pavattaisi, bhagavantaṃ mahagghaina ticīvaraina acchādaisi, aikaikañ‍ca bhikkhuṃ mahagghainaiva pac‍caikadussayugaina sabbaina ca samaṇaparikkhāraina| sau taina puñ‍ñakammaina daivamanussaisu saṃsarantau siddhatthassa bhagavatau kālai saiṭṭhiputtau hutvā mahābaudhimaṇḍalaṃ sattahi ratanaihi pūjaisi| kassapassa bhagavatau kālai sāsanai pabbajitvā samaṇadhammaṃ akāsi| aivaṃ sau sugatīsuyaiva saṃsarantau amhākaṃ bhagavatau kālai bārāṇasiyaṃ mahāvibhavassa saiṭṭhinau puttau  hutvā sujātāya bhagavatau khīrapāyāsaṃ din‍nāya saiṭṭhidhītāya kucchimhi nibbatti, yasau nāma nāmaina paramasukhumālau| tassa tayau pāsādā haunti – aikau haimantikau, aikau gimhikau, aikau vassikauti| sau vassikai pāsādai vassikai cattārau māsai nippurisaihi tūriyaihi paricārayamānau vasati, haiṭṭhāpāsādaṃ na autarati| haimantikai pāsādai cattārau māsai suphusitavātapānakavāṭai tatthaiva paṭivasati| gimhikai pāsādai bahukavāṭavātapānajālāhi sampan‍nai tatthaiva vasati| hatthapādānaṃ sukhumālatāya bhūmiyaṃ nisaj‍jādikic‍caṃ natthi| simbalitulādipuṇṇasabhāvai attharitvā tattha upadhānāni kic‍cāni karauti| aivaṃ daivalaukai daivakumārau viya pañ‍cahi kāmaguṇaihi samappitassa samaṅgībhūtassa paricārayamānassa paṭikac‍caiva niddā auk‍kami, parijanassāpi niddā auk‍kami, sabbarattiyau ca tailapadīpau jhāyati| atha khau yasau kulaputtau paṭikac‍caiva pabujjhitvā addasa sakaṃ parijanaṃ supantaṃ añ‍ñissā kacchai vīṇaṃ, añ‍ñissā kaṇṭhai mudiṅgaṃ, añ‍ñissā kacchai āḷambaraṃ, añ‍ñaṃ vikaisikaṃ, vikkhaiḷikaṃ, añ‍ñā vippalapantiyau hatthapattaṃ susānaṃ mañ‍ñai, disvānassa ādīnavau pāturahausi, nibbidāya cittaṃ saṇṭhāsi| atha khau yasau kulaputtau udānaṃ udānaisi – ‘‘upaddutaṃ vata bhau, upassaṭṭhaṃ vata bhau’’ti|

atha  khau yasau kulaputtau suvaṇṇapādukāyau ārauhitvā yaina nivaisanadvāraṃ tainupasaṅkami, amanussā dvāraṃ vivariṃsu – ‘‘mā yasassa kulaputtassa  kauci antarāyamakāsi agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbaj‍jāyā’’ti| atha khau yasau kulaputtau yaina nagaradvāraṃ tainupasaṅkami, amanussā dvāraṃ vivariṃsu – ‘‘mā yasassa kulaputtassa kauci antarāyamakāsi agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbaj‍jāyā’’ti| atha khau yasau kulaputtau yaina isipatanaṃ migadāyau tainupasaṅkami|

taina khau pana samayaina bhagavā rattiyā pac‍cūsasamayaṃ pac‍cuṭṭhāya ajjhaukāsai caṅkamati, addasā khau bhagavā yasaṃ kulaputtaṃ dūratauva āgacchantaṃ, disvāna caṅkamā aurauhitvā pañ‍ñattai āsanai nisīdi| atha khau yasau kulaputtau bhagavatau avidūrai udānaṃ udānaisi – ‘‘upaddutaṃ vata bhau, upassaṭṭhaṃ vata bhau’’ti| atha khau bhagavā yasaṃ kulaputtaṃ  aitadavauca – ‘‘idaṃ khau, yasa, anupaddutaṃ, idaṃ anupassaṭṭhaṃ, aihi, yasa, nisīda, dhammaṃ tai daisaissāmī’’ti| atha khau yasau kulaputtau, ‘‘idaṃ kira anupaddutaṃ, idaṃ anupassaṭṭha’’nti haṭṭhau udaggau suvaṇṇapādukāhi aurauhitvā yaina bhagavā tainupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādaitvā aikamantaṃ nisīdi, aikamantaṃ nisin‍nassa khau yasassa kulaputtassa bhagavā anupubbiṃ kathaṃ kathaisi, saiyyathidaṃ, dānakathaṃ sīlakathaṃ saggakathaṃ kāmānaṃ ādīnavaṃ aukāraṃ saṃkilaisaṃ naikkhammai ānisaṃsaṃ pakāsaisi| yadā bhagavā añ‍ñāsi yasaṃ kulaputtaṃ kal‍lacittaṃ muducittaṃ vinīvaraṇacittaṃ udaggacittaṃ pasan‍nacittaṃ, atha yā buddhānaṃ sāmuk‍kaṃsikā dhammadaisanā, taṃ pakāsaisi dukkhaṃ samudayaṃ niraudhaṃ maggaṃ| saiyyathāpi nāma suddhaṃ vatthaṃ apagatakāḷakaṃ sammadaiva rajanaṃ paṭiggaṇhaiyya, aivamaiva yasassa kulaputtassa tasmiṃyaiva āsanai virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ udapādi – ‘‘yaṃ kiñ‍ci samudayadhammaṃ, sabbaṃ taṃ niraudhadhamma’’nti|

atha khau yasassa kulaputtassa mātā pāsādaṃ abhiruhitvā yasaṃ kulaputtaṃ apassantī yaina saiṭṭhi gahapati tainupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā saiṭṭhiṃ gahapatiṃ aitadavauca – ‘‘puttau tai gahapati yasau na dissatī’’ti| atha khau, saiṭṭhi gahapati, catuddisā assadūtai uyyaujaitvā sāmaṃyaiva yaina isipatanaṃ migadāyau tainupasaṅkami| addasā khau, saiṭṭhi gahapati, suvaṇṇapādukānaṃ nikkhaipaṃ, disvāna taṃyaiva anugamāsi| addasā khau bhagavā saiṭṭhiṃ gahapatiṃ dūratauva āgacchantaṃ, disvāna bhagavatau aitadahausi – ‘‘yaṃnūnāhaṃ tathārūpaṃ iddhābhisaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharaiyyaṃ, yathā saiṭṭhi gahapati idha nisin‍nau idha nisin‍naṃ yasaṃ kulaputtaṃ na passaiyyā’’ti| atha khau bhagavā tathārūpaṃ iddhābhisaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharaisi| atha khau saiṭṭhi gahapati yaina bhagavā tainupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ aitadavauca – ‘‘api, bhantai, bhagavā yasaṃ kulaputtaṃ passaiyyā’’ti| taina hi gahapati nisīda, appaiva nāma idha nisin‍nau idha nisin‍naṃ yasaṃ kulaputtaṃ passaiyyāsīti| atha khau saiṭṭhi gahapati ‘‘idhaiva kirāhaṃ nisin‍nau idha nisin‍naṃ yasaṃ kulaputtaṃ passissāmī’’ti haṭṭhau udaggau bhagavantaṃ abhivādaitvā aikamantaṃ nisīdi, aikamantaṃ nisin‍nassa khau saiṭṭhissa gahapatissa bhagavā anupubbiṃ kathaṃ kathaisi…pai॰… aparappac‍cayau atthu sāsanai bhagavantaṃ aitadavauca – ‘‘abhik‍kantaṃ bhantai, abhik‍kantaṃ bhantai, saiyyathāpi, bhantai, nik‍kuj‍jitaṃ vā uk‍kuj‍jaiyya, paṭicchan‍naṃ vā vivaraiyya mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkhaiyya, andhakārai vā tailapaj‍jautaṃ dhāraiyya ‘cakkhumantau rūpāni dakkhantī’ti, aivamaivaṃ bhagavatā anaikapariyāyaina dhammau pakāsitau| aisāhaṃ, bhantai, bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañ‍ca bhikkhusaṅghañ‍ca, upāsakaṃ maṃ bhagavā dhāraitu aj‍jataggai pāṇupaitaṃ saraṇaṃ gata’’nti| sauva laukai paṭhamaṃ upāsakau ahausi taivācikau|

atha khau yasassa kulaputtassa pitunau dhammai daisiyamānai yathādiṭṭhaṃ yathāviditaṃ bhūmiṃ pac‍cavaikkhantassa anupādāya āyavaihi cittaṃ vimuc‍ci| atha khau bhagavatau aitadahausi – ‘‘yasassa khau kulaputtassa pitunau dhammai daisiyamānai yathādiṭṭhaṃ yathāviditaṃ bhūmiṃ pac‍cavaikkhantassa anupādāya āsavaihi cittaṃ vimuttaṃ, abhabbau khau yasau kulaputtau hīnāyāvattitvā kāmai paribhuñ‍jituṃ, saiyyathāpi pubbai agārikabhūtau, yaṃnūnāhaṃ taṃ iddhābhisaṅkhāraṃ paṭippassambhaiyya’’nti| atha khau bhagavā taṃ iddhābhisaṅkhāraṃ paṭippassambhaisi| addasā khau saiṭṭhi gahapati yasaṃ kulaputtaṃ nisin‍naṃ, disvāna yasaṃ kulaputtaṃ aitadavauca – ‘‘mātā tai tāta, yasa, paridaivasaukasamāpan‍nā, daihi mātuyā jīvita’’nti| atha khau yasau kulaputtau bhagavantaṃ ul‍laukaisi| atha khau bhagavā saiṭṭhiṃ gahapatiṃ aitadavauca – ‘‘taṃ kiṃ mañ‍ñasi, gahapati, yassa saikkhaina ñāṇaina saikkhaina dassanaina dhammau diṭṭhau viditau saiyyathāpi tayā, tassa yathādiṭṭhaṃ yathāviditaṃ bhūmiṃ pac‍cavaikkhantassa anupādāya āsavaihi cittaṃ vimuttaṃ, bhabbau nu khau sau, gahapati, hīnāyāvattitvā kāmai paribhuñ‍jituṃ saiyyathāpi pubbai agārikabhūtau’’ti? ‘‘nau haitaṃ, bhantai’’| ‘‘yasassa khau, gahapati, kulaputtassa saikkhaina ñāṇaina saikkhaina dassanaina dhammau diṭṭhau viditau saiyyathāpi tayā, tassa yathādiṭṭhaṃ yathāviditaṃ bhūmiṃ pac‍cavaikkhantassa anupādāya āsavaihi cittaṃ vimuttaṃ, abhabbau khau, gahapati, yasau kulaputtau hīnāyāvattitvā kāmai paribhuñ‍jituṃ saiyyathāpi pubbai agārikabhūtau’’ti| ‘‘lābhā, bhantai, yasassa kulaputtassa, suladdhaṃ, bhantai, yasassa kulaputtassa, yathā yasassa kulaputtassa anupādāya āsavaihi cittaṃ vimuttaṃ, adhivāsaitu mai, bhantai bhagavā, aj‍jatanāya bhattaṃ yasaina kulaputtaina pacchāsamaṇainā’’ti| ‘‘adhivāsaisi bhagavā tuṇhībhāvaina’’| atha khau saiṭṭhi gahapati, bhagavatau adhivāsanaṃ viditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādaitvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pak‍kāmi| atha khau yasau kulaputtau acirapak‍kantai saiṭṭhimhi gahapatimhi bhagavantaṃ aitadavauca – ‘‘labhaiyyāhaṃ, bhantai, bhagavatau santikai pabbaj‍jaṃ, labhaiyyaṃ upasampada’’nti| ‘‘aihi bhikkhū’’ti bhagavā avauca – ‘‘svākkhātau dhammau, cara brahmacariyaṃ sammā dukkhassa antakiriyāyā’’ti, sāva tassa āyasmatau upasampadā ahausi|

1. arahā pana hutvā saumanassajātau attanau pubbacaritāpadānaṃ pakāsaintau mahāsamuddaṃ auggayhātiādimāha| tattha samuddanti aṅgulimuddāya saṃ suṭṭhu dassaitabbatau samuddau, atha vā saṃ suṭṭhu udiyati khaubhiyati pasaudhiyati ghausanaṃ karauntau āluḷiyatīti samuddau, mahantau ca sau samuddau cāti mahāsamuddau, taṃ mahāsamuddaṃ| auggayhāti ajjhaugāhaitvā abbhantaraṃ pavisitvā tassa mahāsamuddassa antau pavisitvā, sāmyatthai caitaṃ upayaugavacananti daṭṭhabbaṃ| bhavanaṃ mai sumāpitanti aittha bhavanti nibbattanti nivasanti catūhi iriyāpathaihi vāsaṃ kappainti aitthāti bhavanaṃ, mayhaṃ taṃ bhavanaṃ taṃ vimānaṃ taṃ pāsādaṃ pañ‍capākārakūṭāgāraihi saṃ suṭṭhu māpitaṃ nagaraṃ, attanau balaina suṭṭhu nimmitanti atthau| sunimmitā paukkharaṇīti sumahantā hutvā bhūtā itā gatā pavattā khaṇitā katāti paukkharaṇī, macchakacchapapupphapulinatitthamadhuraudakādīhi suṭṭhu nibbattā nimmitāti atthau| cak‍kavākūpakūjitāti cak‍kavākakuk‍kuṭahaṃsādīhi kūjitā ghausitā nāditā sā paukkharaṇīti sambandhau| itau paraṃ nadīvanadvipadacatuppadapādapapakkhīnaṃ vaṇṇañ‍ca sumaidhassa bhagavatau dassanañ‍ca nimantaitvā sumaidhassa bhagavatau dānak‍kamañ‍ca suviñ‍ñaiyyamaiva|

laukāhutipaṭiggahanti aittha laukai āhuti laukāhuti, kāmarūpārūpasaṅkhātassa laukassa āhutiṃ pūjāsak‍kāraṃ paṭiggaṇhātīti laukāhutipaṭiggahaṃ, sumaidhaṃ bhagavantanti atthau| saisaṃ byākaraṇadānañ‍ca arahattappattaphalañ‍ca suviñ‍ñaiyyamaivāti|

yasatthairaapadānavaṇṇanā samattā|

2. nadīkassapatthairaapadānavaṇṇanā

dutiyāpadānai  padumuttarassa bhagavatautiādikaṃ āyasmatau nadīkassapatthairassa apadānaṃ| ayampi purimabuddhaisu katādhikārau tattha tattha bhavai vivaṭṭūpanissayāni puñ‍ñāni upacinantau padumuttarassa bhagavatau kālai kulagaihai nibbattitvā viñ‍ñutaṃ pattau aikadivasaṃ satthāraṃ piṇḍāya carantaṃ disvā pasan‍namānasau attanā raupitassa ambarukkhassa paṭhamuppan‍naṃ manausilāvaṇṇaṃ aikaṃ ambaphalaṃ adāsi| sau taina puñ‍ñakammaina daivamanussaisu saṃsarantau imasmiṃ buddhuppādai magadharaṭṭhai brāhmaṇakulai uruvailakassapassa bhātā hutvā nibbattau vayappattau nissaraṇajjhāsayatāya gharāvāsaṃ anicchantau tāpasapabbaj‍jaṃ pabbajitvā tīhi tāpasasataihi saddhiṃ nairañ‍jarāya nadiyā tīrai assamaṃ māpaitvā viharati| nadītīrai vasanatau kassapagauttatāya ca nadīkassapauti samañ‍ñā ahausi| tassa bhagavā saparisassa aihibhikkhubhāvaina upasampadaṃ adāsi| sau bhagavatau gayāsīsai ādittapariyāya daisanāya (mahāva॰ 54; saṃ॰ ni॰ 4.28) arahattai patiṭṭhāsi|

tatrāyaṃ anupubbikathā – satthā yasaṃ kulaputtaṃ pabbājaitvā uruvailāyaṃ tayau bhātikajaṭilai damaituṃ yaina uruvailā tadavasari| taina khau pana samayaina uruvailāyaṃ tayau jaṭilā paṭivasanti uruvailakassapau nadīkassapau gayākassapauti, taisu uruvailakassapau jaṭilau pañ‍can‍naṃ jaṭilasatānaṃ nāyakau hauti vināyakau aggau pamukhau pāmaukkhau, nadīkassapau jaṭilau tiṇṇaṃ jaṭilasatānaṃ nāyakau hauti vināyakau aggau pamukhau pāmaukkhau, gayākassapau jaṭilau dvin‍naṃ jaṭilasatānaṃ nāyakau hauti vināyakau aggau pamukhau pāmaukkhau| atha khau bhagavā yaina uruvailakassapassa jaṭilassa assamau tainupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā uruvailakassapaṃ jaṭilaṃ aitadavauca – ‘‘sacai tai, kassapa, agaru, vasaiyyāma aikarattaṃ agyāgārai’’ti| na khau mai, mahāsamaṇa, garu, caṇḍaittha nāgarājā iddhimā āsivisau ghauravisau, sau taṃ mā vihaiṭhaisīti| dutiyampi khau bhagavā uruvailakassapaṃ jaṭilaṃ aitadavauca…pai॰… tatiyampi…pai॰… sau taṃ mā vihaiṭhaisīti| appaiva maṃ na vihaiṭhaiyya, iṅgha tvaṃ, kassapa, anujānāhi agyāgāranti| vihara, mahāsamaṇa, yathāsukhanti| atha khau bhagavā agyāgāraṃ pavisitvā tiṇasanthārakaṃ pañ‍ñapaitvā nisīdi pal‍laṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapaitvā|

addasā khau sau nāgau bhagavantaṃ paviṭṭhaṃ, disvā dummanau padhūpāyi| atha khau bhagavatau aitadahausi  – ‘‘yaṃnūnāhaṃ imassa nāgassa anupahac‍ca chaviñ‍ca cammañ‍ca  maṃsañ‍ca nhāruñ‍ca aṭṭhiñ‍ca aṭṭhimiñ‍jañ‍ca taijasā taijaṃ pariyādiyaiyya’’nti| atha khau bhagavā tathārūpaṃ iddhābhisaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharitvā padhūpāyi| atha khau sau nāgau makkhaṃ asahamānau paj‍jali| bhagavāpi taijaudhātuṃ samāpaj‍jitvā paj‍jali| ubhin‍naṃ sajautibhūtānaṃ agyāgāraṃ ādittaṃ viya hauti sampaj‍jalitaṃ sajautibhūtaṃ| atha khau tai jaṭilā agyāgāraṃ parivāraitvā aivamāhaṃsu – ‘‘abhirūpau vata, bhau, mahāsamaṇau nāgaina vihaiṭhiyatī’’ti| atha khau bhagavā tassā rattiyā ac‍cayaina tassa nāgassa anupahac‍ca chaviñ‍ca cammañ‍ca maṃsañ‍ca nhāruñ‍ca aṭṭhiñ‍ca aṭṭhimiñ‍jañ‍ca taijasā taijaṃ pariyādiyitvā pattai pakkhipitvā uruvailakassapassa jaṭilassa dassaisi – ‘‘ayaṃ tai, kassapa, nāgau pariyādin‍nau assa taijasā taijau’’ti| atha khau uruvailakassapassa jaṭilassa aitadahausi – ‘‘mahiddhikau khau mahāsamaṇau mahānubhāvau, yatra hi nāma caṇḍassa nāgarājassa iddhimatau āsivisassa ghauravisassa taijasā taijaṃ pariyādiyissati, na tvaiva khau arahā yathā aha’’nti|

‘‘nairañ‍jarāyaṃ bhagavā, uruvailakassapaṃ jaṭilaṃ avauca|

sacai tai kassapa agaru, viharaimu aj‍jaṇhau aggisālamhī’’ti||

‘‘na khau mai mahāsamaṇa garu, phāsukāmauva taṃ nivāraimi|

caṇḍaittha nāgarājā, iddhimā āsivisau ghauravisau|

sau taṃ mā vihaiṭhaisī’’ti||

‘‘appaiva  maṃ na vihaiṭhaiyya, iṅgha tvaṃ kassapa anujānāhi agyāgāranti|

din‍nanti naṃ viditvā, abhītau pāvisi bhayamatītau||

‘‘disvā isiṃ paviṭṭhaṃ, ahināgau dummanau padhūpāyi|

sumanamanasau adhimanau, manussanāgaupi tattha padhūpāyi||

‘‘makkhañ‍ca asahamānau, ahināgau pāvakauva paj‍jali|

taijaudhātusukusalau, manussanāgaupi tattha paj‍jali||

‘‘ubhin‍naṃ  sajautibhūtānaṃ,

agyāgāraṃ ādittaṃ hauti sampaj‍jalitaṃ sajautibhūtaṃ|

udiccharai jaṭilā, abhirūpau vata bhau mahāsamaṇau|

nāgaina vihaiṭhiyatīti bhaṇanti||

‘‘atha tassā rattiyā ac‍cayaina, hatā nāgassa ac‍ciyau haunti|

iddhimatau pana ṭhitā, anaikavaṇṇā ac‍ciyau haunti||

‘‘nīlā atha lauhitikā, mañ‍jiṭṭhā pītakā phalikavaṇṇāyau|

aṅgīrasassa kāyai, anaikavaṇṇā ac‍ciyau haunti||

‘‘pattamhi audahitvā, ahināgaṃ brāhmaṇassa dassaisi|

ayaṃ tai kassapa nāgau, pariyādin‍nau assa taijasā taijau’’ti||

atha  khau uruvailakassapau jaṭilau bhagavatau iminā iddhipāṭihāriyaina abhippasan‍nau bhagavantaṃ aitadavauca – ‘‘idhaiva, mahāsamaṇa, vihara, ahaṃ tai dhuvabhattainā’’ti|

paṭhamaṃ pāṭihāriyaṃ|

atha  khau bhagavā uruvailakassapassa jaṭilassa assamassa avidūrai añ‍ñatarasmiṃ vanasaṇḍai vihāsi| atha khau cattārau mahārājānau abhik‍kantāya rattiyā abhik‍kantavaṇṇā kaivalakappaṃ vanasaṇḍaṃ aubhāsaitvā yaina bhagavā tainupasaṅkamiṃsu; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādaitvā catuddisā aṭṭhaṃsu saiyyathāpi mahantā aggikkhandhā| atha khau uruvailakassapau jaṭilau tassā rattiyā ac‍cayaina yaina bhagavā tainupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ aitadavauca – ‘‘kālau, mahāsamaṇa, niṭṭhitaṃ bhattaṃ, tai nu khau tai, mahāsamaṇa, abhik‍kantāya rattiyā abhik‍kantavaṇṇā kaivalakappaṃ vanasaṇḍaṃ aubhāsaitvā yaina tvaṃ tainupasaṅkamiṃsu; upasaṅkamitvā taṃ abhivādaitvā catuddisā aṭṭhaṃsu saiyyathāpi mahantā aggikkhandhā’’ti| aitai khau, kassapa, cattārau mahārājānau yaināhaṃ tainupasaṅkamiṃsu dhammassavanāyāti| atha khau uruvailakassapassa jaṭilassa aitadahausi – ‘‘mahiddhikau khau mahāsamaṇau mahānubhāvau, yatra hi nāma cattāraupi mahārājānau upasaṅkamissanti dhammassavanāya, na tvaiva ca khau arahā yathā aha’’nti| atha khau bhagavā uruvailakassapassa jaṭilassa bhattaṃ bhuñ‍jitvā tasmiṃyaiva vanasaṇḍai vihāsi|

dutiyaṃ pāṭihāriyaṃ|

atha khau sak‍kau daivānamindau abhik‍kantāya rattiyā abhik‍kantavaṇṇau kaivalakappaṃ vanasaṇḍaṃ aubhāsaitvā yaina bhagavā tainupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādaitvā aikamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi saiyyathāpi mahāaggikkhandhau purimāhi vaṇṇanibhāhi abhik‍kantatarau ca paṇītatarau ca| atha khau uruvailakassapau jaṭilau tassā rattiyā ac‍cayaina yaina bhagavā tainupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ aitadavauca – ‘‘kālau, mahāsamaṇa, niṭṭhitaṃ bhattaṃ, kau nu khau sau, mahāsamaṇa, abhik‍kantāya  rattiyā abhik‍kantavaṇṇau kaivalakappaṃ vanasaṇḍaṃ aubhāsaitvā yaina tvaṃ tainupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā taṃ abhivādaitvā aikamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi saiyyathāpi mahāaggikkhandhau purimāhi vaṇṇanibhāhi abhik‍kantatarau ca paṇītatarau cā’’ti| aisau khau, kassapa, sak‍kau daivānamindau yaināhaṃ tainupasaṅkami dhammassavanāyāti| atha khau uruvailakassapassa jaṭilassa aitadahausi – ‘‘mahiddhikau khau mahāsamaṇau mahānubhāvau, yatra hi nāma sak‍kaupi daivānamindau upasaṅkamissati dhammassavanāya, na tvaiva ca khau arahā yathā aha’’nti| atha khau bhagavā uruvailakassapassa jaṭilassa bhattaṃ bhuñ‍jitvā tasmiṃyaiva vanasaṇḍai vihāsi|

tatiyaṃ pāṭihāriyaṃ|

atha khau brahmā sahampati abhik‍kantāya rattiyā abhik‍kantavaṇṇau kaivalakappaṃ vanasaṇḍaṃ aubhāsaitvā yaina bhagavā tainupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādaitvā aikamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi saiyyathāpi mahāaggikkhandhau purimāhi vaṇṇanibhāhi abhik‍kantatarau ca paṇītatarau ca| atha khau uruvailakassapau jaṭilau tassā rattiyā ac‍cayaina yaina bhagavā tainupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ aitadavauca – ‘‘kālau, mahāsamaṇa, niṭṭhitaṃ bhattaṃ, kau nu khau sau, mahāsamaṇa, abhik‍kantāya rattiyā abhik‍kantavaṇṇau kaivalakappaṃ vanasaṇḍaṃ aubhāsaitvā yaina tvaṃ tainupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā taṃ abhivādaitvā aikamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi saiyyathāpi mahāaggikkhandhau purimāhi vaṇṇanibhāhi abhik‍kantatarau ca paṇītatarau cā’’ti| aisau khau, kassapa, brahmā sahampati yaināhaṃ tainupasaṅkami dhammassavanāyāti| atha khau uruvailakassapassa jaṭilassa aitadahausi – ‘‘mahiddhikau khau mahāsamaṇau mahānubhāvau, yatra hi nāma brahmāpi sahampati upasaṅkamissati  dhammassavanāya, na tvaiva ca khau arahā yathā aha’’nti| atha khau bhagavā uruvailakassapassa jaṭilassa bhattaṃ bhuñ‍jitvā tasmiṃyaiva vanasaṇḍai vihāsi|

catutthaṃ pāṭihāriyaṃ|

taina khau pana samayaina uruvailakassapassa jaṭilassa mahāyañ‍ñau pac‍cupaṭṭhitau hauti, kaivalakappā ca aṅgamagadhā pahūtaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhaujanīyaṃ  ādāya abhik‍kamitukāmā haunti| atha khau uruvailakassapassa jaṭilassa aitadahausi – ‘‘aitarahi khau mai mahāyañ‍ñau pac‍cupaṭṭhitau, kaivalakappā ca aṅgamagadhā pahūtaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhaujanīyaṃ ādāya abhik‍kamissanti, sacai mahāsamaṇau mahājanakāyai iddhipāṭihāriyaṃ karissati, mahāsamaṇassa lābhasak‍kārau abhivaḍḍhissati, mama lābhasak‍kārau parihāyissati, ahau nūna mahāsamaṇau svātanāya nāgacchaiyyā’’ti| atha khau bhagavā uruvailakassapassa jaṭilassa caitasā caitauparivitak‍kamañ‍ñāya uttarakuruṃ gantvā tatau piṇḍapātaṃ āharitvā anautattadahai paribhuñ‍jitvā tatthaiva divāvihāraṃ akāsi| atha khau uruvailakassapau jaṭilau tassā rattiyā ac‍cayaina yaina bhagavā tainupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ aitadavauca – ‘‘kālau, mahāsamaṇa, niṭṭhitaṃ bhattaṃ, kiṃ nu khau, mahāsamaṇa, hiyyau nāgamāsi, apica mayaṃ taṃ sarāma, ‘kiṃ nu khau mahāsamaṇau nāgacchatī’ti, khādanīyassa ca bhaujanīyassa  ca tai paṭivīsau ṭhapitau’’ti| nanu tai, kassapa, aitadahausi – ‘‘aitarahi khau mai mahāyañ‍ñau pac‍cupaṭṭhitau kaivalakappā ca aṅgamagadhā pahūtaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhaujanīyaṃ ādāya abhik‍kamissanti, sacai mahāsamaṇau mahājanakāyai iddhipāṭihāriyaṃ karissati, mahāsamaṇassa lābhasak‍kārau abhivaḍḍhissati, mama lābhasak‍kārau parihāyissati, ahau nūna mahāsamaṇau svātanāya nāgacchaiyyā’’ti, sau khau ahaṃ, kassapa, tava caitasā caitauparivitak‍kamañ‍ñāya uttarakuruṃ gantvā tatau piṇḍapātaṃ āharitvā anautattadahai paribhuñ‍jitvā tatthaiva divāvihāraṃ akāsinti| atha khau uruvailakassapassa jaṭilassa aitadahausi – ‘‘mahiddhikau khau mahāsamaṇau mahānubhāvau, yatra hi nāma caitasāpi cittaṃ pajānissati, na tvaiva ca khau arahā yathā aha’’nti| atha khau bhagavā uruvailakassapassa jaṭilassa bhattaṃ bhuñ‍jitvā tasmiṃyaiva vanasaṇḍai vihāsi|

pañ‍camaṃ pāṭihāriyaṃ|

taina  khau pana samayaina bhagavatau paṃsukūlaṃ uppan‍naṃ hauti| atha khau bhagavatau aitadahausi – ‘‘kattha nu khau ahaṃ paṃsukūlaṃ dhauvaiyya’’nti? atha khau sak‍kau daivānamindau bhagavatau caitasā caitauparivitak‍kamañ‍ñāya  pāṇinā paukkharaṇiṃ khaṇitvā bhagavantaṃ aitadavauca – ‘‘idha, bhantai bhagavā, paṃsukūlaṃ dhauvatū’’ti| atha khau bhagavatau aitadahausi – ‘‘kimhi nu khau ahaṃ paṃsukūlaṃ parimaddaiyya’’nti? atha khau sak‍kau daivānamindau bhagavatau caitasā caitauparivitak‍kamañ‍ñāya mahatiṃ silaṃ upanikkhipi – ‘‘idha, bhantai bhagavā, paṃsukūlaṃ parimaddatū’’ti| atha khau bhagavatau aitadahausi – ‘‘kimhi nu khau ahaṃ ālambitvā uttaraiyya’’nti? atha khau kakudhai adhivatthā daivatā bhagavatau caitasā caitauparivitak‍kamañ‍ñāya sākhaṃ aunāmaisi – ‘‘idha, bhantai bhagavā, ālambitvā uttaratū’’ti| atha khau bhagavatau aitadahausi – ‘‘kimhi nu khau ahaṃ paṃsukūlaṃ vissaj‍jaiyya’’nti? atha khau sak‍kau daivānamindau bhagavatau caitasā caitauparivitak‍kamañ‍ñāya mahatiṃ silaṃ upanikkhipi – ‘‘idha, bhantai bhagavā, paṃsukūlaṃ vissaj‍jaitū’’ti| atha khau uruvailakassapau jaṭilau tassā rattiyā ac‍cayaina yaina bhagavā tainupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ aitadavauca – ‘‘kālau, mahāsamaṇa, niṭṭhitaṃ bhattaṃ, kiṃ nu khau, mahāsamaṇa, nāyaṃ pubbai idha paukkharaṇī sāyaṃ idha paukkharaṇī, nayimā silā pubbai upanikkhittā, kainimā silā upanikkhittā, nayimassa kakudhassa pubbai sākhā aunatā, sāyaṃ sākhā aunatā’’ti? idha mai, kassapa, paṃsukūlaṃ uppan‍naṃ  ahausi, tassa mayhaṃ, kassapa, aitadahausi – ‘‘kattha nu khau ahaṃ paṃsukūlaṃ dhauvaiyya’’nti? atha khau, kassapa, sak‍kau daivānamindau mama caitasā caitauparivitak‍kamañ‍ñāya pāṇinā paukkharaṇiṃ khaṇitvā maṃ aitadavauca – ‘‘idha, bhantai bhagavā, paṃsukūlaṃ dhauvatū’’ti| sāyaṃ, kassapa, amanussaina pāṇinā khaṇitā paukkharaṇī| tassa mayhaṃ, kassapa, aitadahausi – ‘‘kimhi nu khau ahaṃ paṃsukūlaṃ parimaddaiyya’’nti? atha khau, kassapa, sak‍kau daivānamindau mama caitasā caitauparivitak‍kamañ‍ñāya mahatiṃ silaṃ upanikkhipi – ‘‘idha, bhantai bhagavā, paṃsukūlaṃ parimaddatū’’ti? sāyaṃ, kassapa, amanussaina upanikkhittā silā| tassa mayhaṃ, kassapa, aitadahausi – ‘‘kimhi nu khau ahaṃ ālambitvā uttaraiyya’’nti? atha khau, kassapa, kakudhai adhivatthā daivatā mama caitasā caitauparivitak‍kamañ‍ñāya sākhaṃ aunāmaisi – ‘‘idha, bhantai bhagavā, ālambitvā uttaratū’’ti? svāyaṃ āharahatthau kakudhau| tassa mayhaṃ, kassapa, aitadahausi – ‘‘kimhi nu khau ahaṃ paṃsukūlaṃ vissaj‍jaiyya’’nti? atha khau, kassapa, sak‍kau daivānamindau mama caitasā caitauparivitak‍kamañ‍ñāya  mahatiṃ silaṃ upanikkhipi – ‘‘idha, bhantai bhagavā, paṃsukūlaṃ vissaj‍jaitū’’ti? sāyaṃ, kassapa, amanussaina upanikkhittā silāti| atha khau uruvailakassapassa aitadahausi – ‘‘mahiddhikau mahāsamaṇau mahānubhāvau, yatra hi nāma sak‍kaupi daivānamindau vaiyyāvac‍caṃ karissati, na tvaiva ca khau arahā yathā aha’’nti| atha khau bhagavā uruvailakassapassa jaṭilassa bhattaṃ bhuñ‍jitvā tasmiṃyaiva vanasaṇḍai vihāsi|

atha khau uruvailakassapau jaṭilau tassā rattiyā ac‍cayaina yaina bhagavā tainupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatau kālaṃ āraucaisi – ‘‘kālau, mahāsamaṇa, niṭṭhitaṃ bhatta’’nti| ‘‘gaccha tvaṃ, kassapa, āyāmaha’’nti uruvailakassapaṃ jaṭilaṃ uyyaujaitvā yāya jambuyā jambudīpau pañ‍ñāyati, tatau phalaṃ gahaitvā paṭhamataraṃ āgantvā agyāgārai nisīdi| addasā khau uruvailakassapau jaṭilau bhagavantaṃ agyāgārai nisin‍naṃ, disvāna bhagavantaṃ aitadavauca – ‘‘katamaina tvaṃ, mahāsamaṇa, maggaina āgatau, ahaṃ tayā paṭhamataraṃ pak‍kantau, sau tvaṃ paṭhamataraṃ āgantvā agyāgārai nisin‍nau’’ti? ‘‘idhāhaṃ, kassapa, taṃ uyyaujaitvā yāya jambuyā jambudīpau pañ‍ñāyati, tatau phalaṃ gahaitvā paṭhamataraṃ āgantvā agyāgārai nisin‍nau| idaṃ khau, kassapa, jambuphalaṃ vaṇṇasampan‍naṃ gandhasampan‍naṃ rasasampan‍naṃ, sacai ākaṅkhasi paribhuñ‍jā’’ti| ‘‘alaṃ, mahāsamaṇa, tvaṃyaiva taṃ arahasi, tvaṃyaiva taṃ paribhuñ‍jā’’ti| atha khau uruvailakassapassa jaṭilassa aitadahausi – ‘‘mahiddhikau khau mahāsamaṇau mahānubhāvau, yatra hi nāma maṃ paṭhamataraṃ uyyaujaitvā yāya jambuyā  jambudīpau pañ‍ñāyati, tatau phalaṃ gahaitvā paṭhamataraṃ āgantvā agyāgārai nisīdissati, na tvaiva ca khau arahā yathā aha’’nti| atha khau bhagavā uruvailakassapassa jaṭilassa bhattaṃ bhuñ‍jitvā tasmiṃyaiva vanasaṇḍai vihāsi|

atha khau uruvailakassapau jaṭilau tassā rattiyā ac‍cayaina yaina bhagavā tainupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatau kālaṃ āraucaisi – ‘‘kālau, mahāsamaṇa, niṭṭhitaṃ bhatta’’nti| ‘‘gaccha tvaṃ, kassapa, āyāmaha’’nti uruvailakassapaṃ jaṭilaṃ uyyaujaitvā yāya jambuyā jambudīpau pañ‍ñāyati, tassā avidūrai ambau…pai॰… tassā avidūrai āmalakī…pai॰…  tassā avidūrai harītakī…pai॰… tāvatiṃsaṃ gantvā pāricchattakapupphaṃ gahaitvā paṭhamataraṃ āgantvā agyāgārai nisīdi| addasā khau uruvailakassapau jaṭilau bhagavantaṃ agyāgārai nisin‍naṃ, disvāna bhagavantaṃ aitadavauca – ‘‘katamaina tvaṃ, mahāsamaṇa, maggaina āgatau, ahaṃ tayā paṭhamataraṃ pak‍kantau, sau tvaṃ paṭhamataraṃ āgantvā agyāgārai nisin‍nau’’ti? ‘‘idhāhaṃ, kassapa, taṃ uyyaujaitvā tāvatiṃsaṃ gantvā pāricchattakapupphaṃ gahaitvā paṭhamataraṃ āgantvā agyāgārai nisin‍nau| idaṃ khau, kassapa, pāricchattakapupphaṃ vaṇṇasampan‍naṃ gandhasampan‍naṃ, sacai ākaṅkhasi gaṇhā’’ti| ‘‘alaṃ, mahāsamaṇa, tvaṃyaiva taṃ arahasi, tvaṃyaiva taṃ gaṇhā’’ti| atha khau uruvailakassapassa jaṭilassa aitadahausi – ‘‘mahiddhikau khau mahāsamaṇau mahānubhāvau, yatra hi nāma maṃ paṭhamataraṃ uyyaujaitvā tāvatiṃsaṃ gantvā pāricchattakapupphaṃ gahaitvā paṭhamataraṃ āgantvā agyāgārai nisīdissati, na tvaiva ca khau arahā yathā aha’’nti|

taina khau pana samayaina tai jaṭilā aggiṃ paricaritukāmā na sak‍kaunti kaṭṭhāni phālaituṃ| atha khau taisaṃ jaṭilānaṃ aitadahausi – ‘‘nissaṃsayaṃ khau mahāsamaṇassa iddhānubhāvau yathā mayaṃ na sak‍kauma kaṭṭhāni phālaitu’’nti| atha khau bhagavā uruvailakassapaṃ  jaṭilaṃ aitadavauca – ‘‘phāliyantu, kassapa, kaṭṭhānī’’ti| ‘‘phāliyantu, mahāsamaṇā’’ti| sakidaiva pañ‍ca kaṭṭhasatāni phāliyiṃsu| atha khau uruvailakassapassa jaṭilassa aitadahausi – ‘‘mahiddhikau khau mahāsamaṇau mahānubhāvau, yatra hi nāma kaṭṭhānipi phāliyissanti, na tvaiva ca khau arahā yathā aha’’nti|

taina khau pana samayaina tai jaṭilā aggiṃ paricaritukāmā na sak‍kaunti aggiṃ uj‍jalaituṃ| atha khau taisaṃ jaṭilānaṃ aitadahausi – ‘‘nissaṃsayaṃ khau mahāsamaṇassa iddhānubhāvau yathā mayaṃ na sak‍kauma aggiṃ uj‍jalaitu’’nti| atha khau bhagavā uruvailakassapaṃ jaṭilaṃ aitadavauca – ‘‘uj‍jaliyantu, kassapa, aggī’’ti| ‘‘uj‍jaliyantu, mahāsamaṇā’’ti| sakidaiva pañ‍ca aggisatāni uj‍jaliyiṃsu| atha khau uruvailakassapassa jaṭilassa aitadahausi – ‘‘mahiddhikau khau mahāsamaṇau mahānubhāvau, yatra hi nāma aggīpi uj‍jaliyissanti, na tvaiva ca khau arahā yathā aha’’nti|

taina  khau pana samayaina tai jaṭilā aggiṃ paricaritvā na sak‍kaunti aggiṃ vijjhāpaituṃ| atha khau taisaṃ jaṭilānaṃ aitadahausi – ‘‘nissaṃsayaṃ khau mahāsamaṇassa iddhānubhāvau yathā mayaṃ na sak‍kauma aggiṃ vijjhāpaitu’’nti| atha khau bhagavā uruvailakassapaṃ jaṭilaṃ aitadavauca – ‘‘vijjhāyantu, kassapa, aggī’’ti| ‘‘vijjhāyantu, mahāsamaṇā’’ti| sakidaiva pañ‍ca aggisatāni vijjhāyiṃsu| atha khau uruvailakassapassa jaṭilassa aitadahausi – ‘‘mahiddhikau khau mahāsamaṇau mahānubhāvau, yatra hi nāma aggīpi vijjhāyissanti, na tvaiva ca khau arahā yathā aha’’nti|

taina khau pana samayaina tai jaṭilā sītāsu haimantikāsu rattīsu antaraṭṭhakāsu himapātasamayai  naj‍jā nairañ‍jarāya ummuj‍jantipi nimuj‍jantipi ummuj‍jananimuj‍janampi karaunti| atha khau bhagavā pañ‍camattāni mandāmukhisatāni abhinimmini yattha tai jaṭilā uttaritvā visibbaisuṃ| atha khau taisaṃ jaṭilānaṃ aitadahausi – ‘‘nissaṃsayaṃ khau mahāsamaṇassa iddhānubhāvau yathayimā mandāmukhiyau nimmitā’’ti| atha khau uruvailakassapassa jaṭilassa aitadahausi – ‘‘mahiddhikau khau mahāsamaṇau mahānubhāvau, yatra hi nāma tāva bahū mandāmukhiyaupi abhinimminissati, na tvaiva ca khau arahā yathā aha’’nti|

taina khau pana samayaina mahā akālamaighau pāvassi, mahā udakavāhakau sañ‍jāyi, yasmiṃ padaisai bhagavā viharati sau padaisau udakaina na autthaṭau hauti| atha khau bhagavatau aitadahausi – ‘‘yaṃnūnāhaṃ samantā udakaṃ ussāraitvā majjhai raiṇuhatāya bhūmiyā caṅkamaiyya’’nti| atha khau bhagavā samantā udakaṃ ussāraitvā majjhai raiṇuhatāya bhūmiyā caṅkami| atha khau uruvailakassapau jaṭilau ‘‘māhaiva khau mahāsamaṇau udakaina vūḷhau ahausī’’ti nāvāya sambahulaihi jaṭilaihi saddhiṃ yasmiṃ padaisai bhagavā viharati, taṃ padaisaṃ agamāsi| addasā khau uruvailakassapau jaṭilau bhagavantaṃ  samantā udakaṃ ussāraitvā majjhai raiṇuhatāya bhūmiyā caṅkamantaṃ, disvāna bhagavantaṃ aitadavauca – ‘‘idaṃ nu tvaṃ, mahāsamaṇā’’ti| ‘‘ayamahamasmi, kassapā’’ti bhagavā vaihāsaṃ abbhuggantvā nāvāya pac‍cuṭṭhāsi| atha khau uruvailakassapassa jaṭilassa aitadahausi – ‘‘mahiddhikau khau mahāsamaṇau mahānubhāvau, yatra hi nāma udakampi na pavāhissati, na tvaiva ca khau arahā yathā aha’’nti|

atha khau bhagavatau aitadahausi – ‘‘cirampi khau imassa maughapurisassa aivaṃ bhavissati ‘mahiddhikau khau mahāsamaṇau mahānubhāvau, na tvaiva ca khau arahā yathā aha’nti, yaṃnūnāhaṃ imaṃ jaṭilaṃ saṃvaijaiyya’’nti| atha khau bhagavā uruvailakassapaṃ jaṭilaṃ aitadavauca – ‘‘naiva ca khau tvaṃ, kassapa, arahā, nāpi arahattamaggasamāpan‍nau, sāpi tai paṭipadā natthi, yāya tvaṃ arahā vā assasi arahattamaggaṃ vā samāpan‍nau’’ti| atha khau uruvailakassapau jaṭilau bhagavatau pādaisu sirasā nipatitvā bhagavantaṃ aitadavauca – ‘‘labhaiyyāhaṃ, bhantai, bhagavatau santikai pabbaj‍jaṃ, labhaiyyaṃ upasampada’’nti| ‘‘tvaṃ khausi, kassapa, pañ‍can‍naṃ jaṭilasatānaṃ nāyakau vināyakau aggau pamukhau pāmaukkhau, taipi tāva apalaukaihi, yathā tai mañ‍ñissanti, tathā tai karissantī’’ti| atha khau uruvailakassapau jaṭilau yaina tai jaṭilā tainupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā tai jaṭilai aitadavauca – ‘‘icchāmahaṃ, bhau, mahāsamaṇai brahmacariyaṃ carituṃ, yathā bhavantau mañ‍ñanti tathā karauntū’’ti| ‘‘cirapaṭikā mayaṃ, bhau, mahāsamaṇai abhippasan‍nā, sacai bhavaṃ  mahāsamaṇai brahmacariyaṃ carissati, sabbaiva mayaṃ mahāsamaṇai brahmacariyaṃ carissāmā’’ti| atha khau tai jaṭilā kaisamissaṃ jaṭāmissaṃ khārikājamissaṃ aggihutamissaṃ udakai pavāhaitvā yaina bhagavā tainupasaṅkamiṃsu; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatau pādaisu sirasā nipatitvā bhagavantaṃ aitadavaucuṃ – ‘‘labhaiyyāma mayaṃ, bhantai, bhagavatau santikai pabbaj‍jaṃ, labhaiyyāma upasampada’’nti| ‘‘aitha, bhikkhavau’’ti bhagavā avauca – ‘‘svākkhātau dhammau, caratha brahmacariyaṃ sammā dukkhassa antakiriyāyā’’ti| sāva taisaṃ āyasmantānaṃ upasampadā ahausi|

addasā khau nadīkassapau jaṭilau kaisamissaṃ jaṭāmissaṃ khārikājamissaṃ aggihutamissaṃ udakai vuyhamānai, disvānassa aitadahausi – ‘‘māhaiva mai bhātunau upasaggau ahausī’’ti, jaṭilai pāhaisi – ‘‘gacchatha mai bhātaraṃ jānāthā’’ti, sāmañ‍ca tīhi jaṭilasataihi saddhiṃ yaināyasmā uruvailakassapau tainupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ  uruvailakassapaṃ aitadavauca – ‘‘idaṃ nu khau, kassapa, saiyyau’’ti? ‘‘āmāvusau, idaṃ saiyyau’’ti| atha khau tai jaṭilā kaisamissaṃ jaṭāmissaṃ khārikājamissaṃ aggihutamissaṃ  udakai pavāhaitvā yaina bhagavā tainupasaṅkamiṃsu; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatau pādaisu sirasā nipatitvā bhagavantaṃ aitadavaucuṃ – ‘‘labhaiyyāma mayaṃ, bhantai, bhagavatau santikai pabbaj‍jaṃ, labhaiyyāma upasampada’’nti| ‘‘aitha, bhikkhavau’’ti bhagavā avauca – ‘‘svākkhātau dhammau, caratha brahmacariyaṃ sammā dukkhassa antakiriyāyā’’ti| sāva taisaṃ āyasmantānaṃ upasampadā ahausi|

addasā khau gayākassapau jaṭilau kaisamissaṃ jaṭāmissaṃ khārikājamissaṃ aggihutamissaṃ udakai vuyhamānai, disvānassa aitadahausi – ‘‘māhaiva mai bhātūnaṃ upasaggau ahausī’’ti, jaṭilai pāhaisi – ‘‘gacchatha mai bhātarau jānāthā’’ti, sāmañ‍ca dvīhi jaṭilasataihi saddhiṃ yaināyasmā uruvailakassapau tainupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ uruvailakassapaṃ aitadavauca – ‘‘idaṃ nu khau, kassapa, saiyyau’’ti? ‘‘āmāvusau, idaṃ saiyyau’’ti| atha khau tai jaṭilā kaisamissaṃ jaṭāmissaṃ khārikājamissaṃ aggihutamissaṃ udakai pavāhaitvā yaina bhagavā tainupasaṅkamiṃsu; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatau pādaisu sirasā nipatitvā bhagavantaṃ aitadavaucuṃ – ‘‘labhaiyyāma mayaṃ, bhantai, bhagavatau santikai pabbaj‍jaṃ, labhaiyyāma upasampada’’nti| ‘‘aitha, bhikkhavau’’ti, bhagavā avauca – ‘‘svākkhātau dhammau, caratha brahmacariyaṃ sammā dukkhassa antakiriyāyā’’ti| sāva taisaṃ āyasmantānaṃ upasampadā ahausi|

‘‘bhagavatau  adhiṭṭhānaina pañ‍ca kaṭṭhasatāni na phāliyiṃsu, phāliyiṃsu, aggī na uj‍jaliyiṃsu, uj‍jaliyiṃsu, na vijjhāyiṃsu, vijjhāyiṃsu, pañ‍ca mandāmukhisatāni abhinimmini, aitaina nayaina aḍḍhuḍḍhapāṭihāriyasahassāni haunti|

‘‘atha khau bhagavā uruvailāyaṃ yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā yaina gayāsīsaṃ taina cārikaṃ pak‍kāmi mahatā bhikkhusaṅghaina saddhiṃ sahassaina sabbaihaiva purāṇajaṭilaihi| tatra sudaṃ bhagavā gayāyaṃ viharati gayāsīsai saddhiṃ bhikkhusahassaina| tatra khau bhagavā bhikkhu āmantaisi (saṃ॰ ni॰ 4.28) – ‘sabbaṃ, bhikkhavai, ādittaṃ, kiñ‍ca, bhikkhavai, sabbaṃ ādittaṃ, cakkhu, bhikkhavai, ādittaṃ, rūpā ādittā, cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇaṃ  ādittaṃ, cakkhusamphassau ādittau, yamidaṃ cakkhusamphassapac‍cayā uppaj‍jati vaidayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi  ādittaṃ| kaina ādittaṃ, rāgagginā dausagginā mauhagginā ādittaṃ, jātiyā jarāya maraṇaina saukaihi paridaivaihi dukkhaihi daumanassaihi upāyāsaihi ādittanti vadāmi? sautaṃ ādittaṃ, saddā ādittā…pai॰… ghānaṃ ādittaṃ, gandhā ādittā…pai॰… jivhā ādittā, rasā ādittā…pai॰… kāyau ādittau, phauṭṭhabbā ādittā…pai॰… manau ādittau, dhammā ādittā, manauviñ‍ñāṇaṃ ādittaṃ, manausamphassau ādittau, yamidaṃ manausamphassapac‍cayā uppaj‍jati vaidayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi ādittaṃ| kaina ādittaṃ, rāgagginā dausagginā mauhagginā ādittaṃ, jātiyā jarāya maraṇaina saukaihi paridaivaihi dukkhaihi daumanassaihi upāyāsaihi āditta’’’nti vadāmi|

‘‘aivaṃ passaṃ, bhikkhavai, sutavā ariyasāvakau cakkhusmimpi nibbindati, rūpaisupi nibbindati, cakkhuviñ‍ñāṇaipi nibbindati, cakkhusamphassaipi nibbindati, yamidaṃ cakkhusamphassapac‍cayā uppaj‍jati vaidayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tasmimpi nibbindati| sautasmimpi nibbindati, saddaisupi nibbindati…pai॰… ghānasmimpi nibbindati, gandhaisupi nibbindati…pai॰… jivhāyapi nibbindati, rasaisupi nibbindati…pai॰… kāyasmimpi nibbindati, phauṭṭhabbaisupi nibbindati…pai॰… manasmimpi nibbindati, dhammaisupi nibbindati, manauviñ‍ñāṇaipi nibbindati, manausamphassaipi nibbindati, yamidaṃ manausamphassapac‍cayā uppaj‍jati vaidayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tasmimpi nibbindati| nibbindaṃ viraj‍jati, virāgā vimuc‍cati, vimuttasmiṃ vimuttamiti ñāṇaṃ hauti, ‘khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā’ti pajānātī’’ti|

imasmiñ‍ca pana vaiyyākaraṇasmiṃ bhañ‍ñamānai tassa bhikkhusahassassa anupādāya āsavaihi cittāni vimuc‍ciṃsu|

29. aivaṃ ādittapariyāyadaisanaṃ sutvā saha paṭisambhidāhi arahattaṃ sampattau nadīkassapau thairau saumanassajātau attanau pubbacaritāpadānaṃ  pakāsaintau padumuttarassa bhagavatautiādimāha| tattha aggaphalanti uttamaphalaṃ, attanā raupitaambarukkhassa ādimhi gahitaphalaṃ vā| saisaṃ suviñ‍ñaiyyamaivāti|

nadīkassapatthairaapadānavaṇṇanā samattā|

3. gayākassapatthairaapadānavaṇṇanā

tatiyāpadānai  ajinacammavatthauhantiādikaṃ āyasmatau gayākassapatthairassa apadānaṃ| ayampi purimabuddhaisu katādhikārau tattha tattha bhavai vivaṭṭūpanissayaṃ kusalaṃ upacinantau itau aikatiṃsakappai sikhissa bhagavatau kālai kulagaihai nibbattau viñ‍ñutaṃ pattau nissaraṇajjhāsayatāya gharāvāsaṃ pahāya tāpasapabbaj‍jaṃ pabbajitvā arañ‍ñāyatanai assamaṃ māpaitvā vanamūlaphalāhārau vasati| taina ca samayaina bhagavā aikau adutiyau tassa assamasamīpaināgacchi, sau bhagavantaṃ disvā pasan‍namānasau upasaṅkamitvā vanditvā aikamantaṃ ṭhitau vailaṃ aulaukaintau manauharāni kaulaphalāni satthu upanaisi| sau taina puñ‍ñakammaina daivamanussaisu saṃsarantau imasmiṃ buddhuppādai brāhmaṇakulai nibbattitvā vayappattau nissaraṇajjhāsayatāya gharāvāsaṃ pahāya tāpasapabbaj‍jaṃ pabbajitvā dvīhi tāpasasataihi saddhiṃ gayāya viharati| gayāya vasanatau hissa kassapagauttatāya ca gayākassapauti samañ‍ñā ahausi| sau bhagavatau saddhiṃ parisāya aihibhikkhūpasampadaṃ datvā nadīkassapassa vuttanayaina ādittapariyāya daisanāya auvadiyamānau arahattai patiṭṭhāsi|

35. sau arahattaṃ patvā saumanassajātau attanau pubbacaritāpadānaṃ pakāsaintau ajinacammavatthauhantiādimāha| tattha ajinacammavatthauti tāpasapabbajitattā ajinacammanivāsanapāvuraṇauti atthau| khāribhāradharauti tāpasakālai tāpasaparikkhāraparipuṇṇakājadharauti atthau| khārikatāpasaparikkhārai pūraitvā| kaulaṃ ahāsi assamanti kaulaphalaṃ assamai pūraitvā assamai nisin‍nauti atthau| agaupayinti  pāṭhai kaulaphalaṃ pariyaisitvā assamaṃ gaupaisiṃ rakkhinti atthau| saisaṃ sabbaṃ uttānatthamaivāti|

gayākassapatthairaapadānavaṇṇanā samattā|

4. kimilatthairaapadānavaṇṇanā

catutthāpadānai nibbutai kakusandhamhītiādikaṃ āyasmatau kimilatthairassa apadānaṃ| ayampi purimabuddhaisu katādhikārau tattha tattha bhavai vivaṭṭūpanissayāni puñ‍ñāni upacinantau kakusandhassa bhagavatau kālai kulagaihai nibbattitvā viñ‍ñutaṃ pattau parinibbutai satthari  tassa dhātuyau uddissa salalamālāhi maṇḍapaṃ kāraitvā pūjaṃ akāsi| sau taina puñ‍ñakammaina tāvatiṃsaisu uppaj‍jitvā aparāparaṃ daivamanussaisu saṃsarantau imasmiṃ buddhuppādai kapilavatthunagarai sakyarājakulai nibbattitvā kimilauti tassa nāmaṃ akāsi| sau vayappattau bhaugasampattiyā pamattau viharati| tassa ñāṇaparipākaṃ ñatvā saṃvaigajananatthaṃ anupiyāyaṃ viharantau satthā paṭhamayaubbanai ṭhitaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ itthirūpaṃ abhinimminitvā puratau dassaitvā puna anuk‍kamaina yathā jarāraugavipattīhi abhibhūtā dissati, tathā akāsi| taṃ disvā kimilakumārau ativiya saṃvaigajātau attanau saṃvaigaṃ pakāsaintau bhagavatau pākaṭaṃ katvā laddhānusāsanau arahattaṃ pāpuṇi|

42. sau arahattaṃ patvā saumanassajātau attanau pubbacaritāpadānaṃ pakāsaintau nibbutai kakusandhamhītiādimāha| brāhmaṇamhi vusīmatīti pañ‍cahi vasitāhi vasippattamhi bhagavati| brāhmaṇassa sabbaguṇagaṇaihi maṇḍitattā abhivūḷhītattā brāhmaṇamhi kakusandhai bhagavati parinibbutaiti atthau| saisaṃ sabbaṃ uttānamaivāti|

kimilatthairaapadānavaṇṇanā samattā|

5. vaj‍jiputtatthairaapadānavaṇṇanā

sahassaraṃsī  bhagavātiādikaṃ āyasmatau vaj‍jiputtatthairassa apadānaṃ| ayampi purimabuddhaisu katādhikārau tattha tattha bhavai vivaṭṭūpanissayaṃ puñ‍ñaṃ upacinantau itau catunavutikappai aikaṃ pac‍caikabuddhaṃ bhikkhāya gacchantaṃ disvā pasan‍namānasau kadaliphalāni adāsi| sau taina puñ‍ñakammaina daivamanussaisu saṃsarantau imasmiṃ buddhuppādai vaisāliyaṃ licchavirājakumārau hutvā nibbatti, vaj‍jirājaputtattā vaj‍jiputtautvaivassa samañ‍ñā| sau daharau hutvā hatthisippādisikkhanakālaipi haitusampan‍natāya nissaraṇajjhāsayauva hutvā vicarantau satthu dhammadaisanaṃ sutvā paṭiladdhasaddhau satthu santikai pabbajitvā vipassanāya kammaṃ katvā nacirassaiva chaḷabhiñ‍ñau ahausi| chaḷabhiñ‍ñau pana hutvā aparabhāgai aciraparinibbutai satthari dhammaṃ saṅgāyituṃ saṅkaitaṃ katvā mahāthairaisu tattha tattha viharantaisu aikadivasaṃ āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ saikhaṃyaiva samānaṃ mahatiyā parisāya parivutaṃ dhammaṃ daisaintaṃ disvā tassa uparimaggādhigamāya ussāhaṃ janaintau –

‘‘rukkhamūlagahanaṃ  pasak‍kiya, nibbānaṃ hadayasmiṃ aupiya|

jhāya gautama mā ca pamādau, kiṃ tai biḷibiḷikā karissatī’’ti|| (thairagā॰ 119) – gāthaṃ abhāsi|

tattha rukkhamūlagahananti rukkhamūlabhūtaṃ gahanaṃ, gahanañhi atthi, na rukkhamūlaṃ, rukkhamūlañ‍ca atthi, na gahanaṃ, taisu rukkhamūlaggahaṇaina ṭhānassa chāyāya sampan‍natāya vātātapaparissayābhāvaṃ dīpaiti, gahanaggahaṇaina nivātabhāvaina vātaparissayābhāvaṃ janasambādhābhāvañ‍ca dassaiti, tadubhayaina ca bhāvanāyaugyataṃ| pasak‍kiyāti upagantvā| nibbānaṃ hadayasmiṃ aupiyāti ‘‘aivaṃ mayā paṭipaj‍jitvā nibbānaṃ adhigantabba’’nti nibbutiṃ hadayai ṭhapaitvā cittai katvā| jhāyāti tilakkhaṇūpanijjhānaina jhāya, vipassanābhāvanāsahitaṃ maggabhāvanaṃ bhāvaihi| gautamāti dhammabhaṇḍāgārikaṃ gauttainālapati| mā ca pamādauti adhikusalaisu dhammaisu mā pamādaṃ āpaj‍ji| idāni yādisau  thairassa pamādau, taṃ paṭikkhaipavasaina dassaintau ‘‘kiṃ tai biḷibiḷikā karissatī’’ti āha| tattha biḷibiḷikāti biḷibiḷikiriyā, biḷibiḷitisaddapavatti yathā niratthakā, aivaṃ biḷibiḷikāsadisā janapañ‍ñatti| kiṃ tai karissatīti kīdisaṃ atthaṃ tuyhaṃ sādhaissati, tasmā janapañ‍ñattiṃ pahāya sadatthapasutau hauhīti auvādaṃ adāsi|

taṃ  sutvā añ‍ñaihi vuttaina vissagandhavāyanavacanaina saṃvaigajātau bahudaiva rattiṃ caṅkamaina vītināmaintau vipassanaṃ ussuk‍kāpaitvā saināsanaṃ pavisitvā mañ‍cakai nisin‍namattauva ‘‘kiñ‍ci sayāmī’’ti sīsaṃ bimbauhanamasampattaṃ pādaṃ bhūmitau uggataṃ sarīrassa ākāsagatakkhaṇaiyaiva arahattaṃ pāpuṇi|

49. vaj‍jiputtatthairau aparabhāgai saumanassajātau attanau pubbacaritāpadānaṃ pakāsaintau sahassaraṃsī bhagavātiādimāha| tattha sahassaraṃsīti aittha ‘‘anaikasatasahassaraṃsī’’ti vattabbai gāthābandhasukhatthaṃ ‘‘sahassaraṃsī’’ti vuttanti vaiditabbaṃ| saisaṃ suviñ‍ñaiyyamaivāti|

vaj‍jiputtatthairaapadānavaṇṇanā samattā|

6. uttaratthairaapadānavaṇṇanā

chaṭṭhāpadānai sumaidhau nāma sambuddhautiādikaṃ āyasmatau uttarasāmaṇairassa apadānaṃ| ayampi purimabuddhaisu katādhikārau  tattha tattha bhavai vivaṭṭūpanissayāni puñ‍ñāni upacinantau sumaidhassa bhagavatau kālai vij‍jādharau hutvā ākāsaina vicarati| taina ca samayaina satthā tassaiva anuggaṇhanatthaṃ vanantarai añ‍ñatarasmiṃ rukkhamūlai nisīdi chabbaṇṇabuddharaṃsiyau vissaj‍jaintau| sau antalikkhaina gacchantau bhagavantaṃ disvā pasan‍namānasau ākāsatau auruyha suvisuddhaihi vipulaihi kaṇikārapupphaihi bhagavantaṃ pūjaisi, pupphāni buddhānubhāvaina satthu upari chattākāraina aṭṭhaṃsu, sau taina bhiyyausaumattāya pasan‍nacittau hutvā aparabhāgai kālaṃ katvā tāvatiṃsaisu nibbattitvā dibbasampattiṃ anubhavantau yāvatāyukaṃ tattha ṭhatvā tatau cutau daivamanussaisu saṃsarantau imasmiṃ buddhuppādai rājagahai brāhmaṇamahāsālassa puttau hutvā  nibbatti, uttarautissa nāmaṃ ahausi| sau viñ‍ñutaṃ pattau brāhmaṇavij‍jāsu nipphattiṃ gantvā jātiyā rūpaina vij‍jāya vayaina sīlācāraina ca laukassa sambhāvanīyau jātau|

tassa taṃ sampattiṃ disvā vassakārau magadhamahāmattau attanau dhītaraṃ dātukāmau hutvā attanau adhippāyaṃ pavaidaisi| sau nissaraṇajjhāsayatāya taṃ paṭikkhipitvā kālaina kālaṃ dhammasaināpatiṃ payirupāsantau tassa santikai dhammaṃ sutvā paṭiladdhasaddhau pabbajitvā vattasampan‍nau hutvā thairaṃ upaṭṭhahati|

taina  ca samayaina thairassa añ‍ñatarau ābādhau uppan‍nau, tassa bhaisaj‍jatthāya uttarau sāmaṇairau pātauva pattacīvaramādāya vihāratau nikkhantau antarāmaggai taḷākassa samīpai pattaṃ ṭhapaitvā udakasamīpaṃ gantvā mukhaṃ dhauvati| atha añ‍ñatarau umaṅgacaurau katakammau ārakkhapurisaihi anubaddhau aggamaggaina nagaratau nikkhamitvā palāyantau attanā gahitaṃ ratanabhaṇḍitaṃ sāmaṇairassa pattai pakkhipitvā palāyi| sāmaṇairaupi pattasamīpaṃ upagatau| cauraṃ anubandhantā rājapurisā sāmaṇairassa pattai bhaṇḍikaṃ disvā ‘‘ayaṃ caurau, iminā cauriyaṃ kata’’nti sāmaṇairaṃ pacchābāhaṃ bandhitvā vassakārassa brāhmaṇassa dassaisuṃ| vassakārau ca tadā rañ‍ñau vinicchayai niyuttau hutvā chaij‍jabhaij‍jaṃ anusāsati, sau ‘‘pubbai mama vacanaṃ nādiyi, suddhapāsaṇḍiyaisu pabbajī’’ti (thairagā॰ aṭṭha॰ 1.uttaratthairagāthāvaṇṇanā) kammaṃ asaudhaitvā ghātukāmattāva jīvantamaiva taṃ sūlai uttāsaisi|

athassa bhagavā ñāṇaparipākaṃ aulaukaitvā taṃ ṭhānaṃ gantvā vipphurantahatthanakhamaṇimayūkhasambhin‍nasitābhatāya paggharantajātihiṅgulakasuvaṇṇarasadhāraṃ viya jālāguṇṭhitamudutalunadīghaṅgulihatthaṃ uttarassa sīsai ṭhapaitvā ‘‘uttara, idaṃ tai purimakammassa  phalaṃ uppan‍naṃ, tattha tayā pac‍cavaikkhaṇabalaina adhivāsanā kātabbā’’ti vatvā ajjhāsayānurūpaṃ dhammaṃ daisaisi| uttarau amatābhisaikasadisaina satthu hatthasamphassaina sañ‍jātappasādasaumanassatāya uḷārapītipāmauj‍jaṃ paṭilabhitvā yathāparicitaṃ vipassanāmaggaṃ samārūḷhau ñāṇassa paripākaṃ gatattā satthu ca daisanāvilāsaina tāvadaiva maggapaṭipāṭiyā sabbai kilaisai khaipaitvā chaḷabhiñ‍ñau  ahausi| chaḷabhiñ‍ñau pana hutvā sūlatau uṭṭhahitvā parānuddayāya ākāsai ṭhatvā pāṭihāriyaṃ dassaisi| mahājanau acchariyabbhutacittajātau ahausi| tāvadaivassa vaṇau saṃrūḷhi, sau bhikkhūhi, ‘‘āvusau, tādisadukkhaṃ anubhavantau kathaṃ tvaṃ vipassanaṃ anuyuñ‍jituṃ asakkhī’’ti puṭṭhau, ‘‘pagaiva mai, āvusau, saṃsārai ādīnavau, saṅkhārānañ‍ca sabhāvau sudiṭṭhau, aivāhaṃ tādisaṃ dukkhaṃ anubhavantaupi asakkhiṃ vipassanaṃ vaḍḍhaitvā visaisaṃ adhigantu’’nti āha| ‘‘pubbajātiyā daharakālai makkhikaṃ gahaitvā nimbasūlakaṃ gahaitvā sūlāraupanakīḷaṃ paṭic‍ca aivaṃ anaikajātisataisu sūlāraupanadukkhamanubhavitvā imāya pariyausānajātiyā aivarūpaṃ dukkhamanubhūta’’nti āha|

55. atha aparabhāgai pubbakammaṃ saritvā saumanassajātau pubbacaritāpadānaṃ pakāsaintau sumaidhau nāma sambuddhautiādimāha| tattha anuttānapadavaṇṇanamaiva karissāma|

57. vij‍jādharau tadā āsinti bāhirakamantādivij‍jāsiddhiyā ākāsagāmisamatthau hutvā caraṇavasaina taṃ vij‍jaṃ rakkhitvā avināsaitvā pariharaṇavasaina vij‍jādharayauni āsiṃ ahausinti  atthau| antalikkhacarau ahanti antaṃ pariyausānaṃ kauṭiṃ likhatai saṃkarissatīti antalikkhaṃ| atha vā antaṃ pariyausānaṃ likhyatai aulaukiyatai aitaināti antalikkhaṃ, tasmiṃ antalikkhai, ākāsai caraṇasīlau ahanti atthau| tisūlaṃ sukataṃ gayhāti tikhiṇaṃ sūlaṃ, aggaṃ āvudhaṃ| tisūlaṃ sundaraṃ kataṃ, kauṭṭanaghaṃsanamaddanapaharaṇavasaina suṭṭhu kataṃ sūlāvudhaṃ gayha gahaitvā ambaratau gacchāmīti atthau| saisaṃ sabbaṃ haiṭṭhā vuttanayattāva nayānuyaugaina suviñ‍ñaiyyamaivāti|

uttaratthairaapadānavaṇṇanā samattā|

7. aparauttaratthairaapadānavaṇṇanā

sattamāpadānai  nibbutai laukanāthamhītiādikaṃ āyasmatau aparassa uttaratthairassa apadānaṃ| ayampi purimabuddhaisu  katādhikārau tattha tattha bhavai vivaṭṭūpanissayāni puñ‍ñāni upacinantau itau catun‍navutikappai siddhatthassa bhagavatau kālai kulagaihai nibbattitvā vayappattau viñ‍ñutaṃ patvā sāsanai laddhappasādau hutvā upāsakattaṃ nivaidaisi| sau satthari parinibbutai attanau ñātakai san‍nipātaitvā bahupūjāsak‍kāraṃ saṃharitvā dhātupūjaṃ akāsi| sau taina puñ‍ñakammaina daivamanussaisu saṃsarantau imasmiṃ buddhuppādai sākaitai brāhmaṇakulai nibbattitvā uttarauti laddhanāmau vayappattau kainacidaiva karaṇīyaina sāvatthiṃ gatau kaṇḍambamūlai kataṃ yamakapāṭihāriyaṃ disvā pasīditvā puna kāḷakārāmasuttadaisanāya abhivaḍḍhamānasaddhau pabbajitvā satthārā saddhiṃ rājagahaṃ gantvā upasampadaṃ labhitvā tathaiva carantau vipassanaṃ paṭṭhapaitvā nacirassaiva chaḷabhiñ‍ñau ahausi| chaḷabhiñ‍ñau pana hutvā satthari sāvatthiyaṃ viharantai buddhupaṭṭhānatthaṃ rājagahatau sāvatthiṃ upagatau bhikkhūhi – ‘‘kiṃ, āvusau, pabbaj‍jākic‍caṃ tayā matthakaṃ pāpita’’nti puṭṭhau añ‍ñaṃ byākāsi|

93. arahattaṃ pana patvā saumanassajātau attanau pubbacaritāpadānaṃ pakāsaintau nibbutai laukanāthamhītiādimāha| taṃ sabbaṃ haiṭṭhā vuttanayattā uttānatthamaivāti|

aparauttaratthairaapadānavaṇṇanā samattā|

8. bhaddajitthairaapadānavaṇṇanā

aṭṭhamāpadānai  augayhāhaṃ paukkharaṇintiādikaṃ āyasmatau bhaddajitthairassa apadānaṃ| ayampi purimabuddhaisu katādhikārau tattha tattha bhavai vivaṭṭūpanissayāni puñ‍ñāni upacinantau padumuttarassa bhagavatau kālai brāhmaṇakulai nibbattitvā viñ‍ñutaṃ pattau brāhmaṇānaṃ vij‍jāsippaisu pāraṃ gantvā kāmai pahāya tāpasapabbaj‍jaṃ pabbajitvā arañ‍ñāyatanai assamaṃ  kāraitvā vasantau aikadivasaṃ satthāraṃ ākāsaina gacchantaṃ disvā pasan‍namānasau añ‍jaliṃ paggayha aṭṭhāsi| satthā tassa ajjhāsayaṃ disvā ākāsatau autari| autiṇṇassa pana bhagavatau madhuñ‍ca bhisamuḷālañ‍ca sappikhīrañ‍ca upanāmaisi, tassa taṃ bhagavā anukammaṃ upādāya paṭiggahaitvā anumaudanaṃ katvā pak‍kāmi| sau taina puñ‍ñakammaina tusitaisu nibbattau tattha yāvatāyukaṃ ṭhatvā tatau cutau aparāparaṃ sugatīsuyaiva saṃsarantau vipassissa bhagavatau kālai mahaddhanau saiṭṭhi hutvā aṭṭhasaṭṭhibhikkhusatasahassaṃ bhaujaitvā ticīvaraina acchādaisi|

aivaṃ bahuṃ kusalaṃ  katvā daivalaukai nibbatti| tattha yāvatāyukaṃ ṭhatvā tatau cavitvā manussalaukaisu uppan‍nau buddhasuñ‍ñai laukai pañ‍ca pac‍caikabuddhasatāni catūhi pac‍cayaihi upaṭṭhahitvā tatau cutau rājakulai nibbattitvā raj‍jaṃ anusāsantau attanau puttaṃ pac‍caikabaudhiṃ adhigantvā ṭhitaṃ upaṭṭhahitvā tassa parinibbutassa dhātuyau gahaitvā caitiyaṃ katvā pūjaisi| aivaṃ tattha tattha tāni tāni puñ‍ñāni katvā imasmiṃ buddhuppādai bhaddiyanagarai asītikauṭivibhavassa bhaddiyasaiṭṭhissa aikaputtakau hutvā nibbatti, bhaddajītissa nāmaṃ ahausi| tassa kira issariyabhaugaparivārasampatti carimabhavai baudhisattassa viya ahausi|

tadā satthā sāvatthiyaṃ vasitvā bhaddajikumāraṃ saṅgaṇhanatthāya mahatā bhikkhusaṅghaina saddhiṃ bhaddiyanagaraṃ gantvā jātiyāvanai vasi tassa ñāṇaparipākaṃ āgamayamānau| saupi uparipāsādai nisin‍nau sīhapañ‍jaraṃ vivaritvā aulaukaintau bhagavatau santikai dhammaṃ sautuṃ gacchantaṃ mahājanaṃ disvā, ‘‘katthāyaṃ mahājanau gacchatī’’ti pucchitvā taṃ kāraṇaṃ sutvā sayampi mahatā parivāraina satthu santikaṃ gantvā dhammaṃ suṇantau sabbābharaṇapaṭimaṇḍitauva sabbakilaisai khaipaitvā arahattaṃ pāpuṇi| arahattai pana taina adhigatai satthā bhaddiyasaiṭṭhiṃ āmantaisi – ‘‘tava puttau alaṅkatapaṭiyattau dhammaṃ suṇantau arahattai patiṭṭhāsi, tainassa idānaiva pabbajituṃ yuttaṃ, nau cai pabbajissati, parinibbāyissatī’’ti| saiṭṭhi ‘‘na mayhaṃ puttassa daharassaiva satau parinibbānaina kic‍caṃ  atthi, pabbājaitha na’’nti āha| taṃ satthā pabbājaitvā upasampādaitvā tattha sattāhaṃ vasitvā kauṭigāmaṃ pāpuṇi, sau ca gāmau gaṅgātīrai ahausi| kauṭigāmavāsinau ca buddhappamukhassa bhikkhusaṅghassa mahādānaṃ pavattaisuṃ| bhaddajitthairau satthārā anumaudanāya āraddhamattāya bahigāmaṃ gantvā ‘‘gaṅgātīrai maggasamīpai satthu āgatakālai vuṭṭhahissāmī’’ti kālaparicchaidaṃ katvā añ‍ñatarasmiṃ rukkhamūlai samāpattiṃ samāpaj‍jitvā nisīdi| mahāthairaisu āgacchantaisupi avuṭṭhahitvā satthu āgatakālaiyaiva vuṭṭhāsi| puthuj‍janā bhikkhū – ‘‘ayaṃ adhunā pabbajitau, mahāthairaisu āgacchantaisu mānathaddhau hutvā na vuṭṭhāsī’’ti ujjhāyiṃsu|

kauṭigāmavāsinau satthu bhikkhusaṅghassa ca bahū nāvāsaṅghāṭai bandhiṃsu| satthā ‘‘bhaddajissānubhāvaṃ pakāsaimī’’ti nāvāya ṭhatvā ‘‘kahaṃ bhaddajī’’ti pucchi| bhaddajitthairau – ‘‘sauhaṃ, bhantai’’ti satthāraṃ upasaṅkamitvā añ‍jaliṃ katvā aṭṭhāsi| satthā ‘‘aihi, bhaddaji, amhaihi saddhiṃ aikanāvaṃ abhiruhā’’ti| sau uppatitvā satthu ṭhitanāvāyaṃ aṭṭhāsi| satthā gaṅgāya majjhai gatakālai, ‘‘bhaddaji, tayā mahāpanādakālai ajjhāvuṭṭharatanapāsādau  kaha’’nti āha| ‘‘imasmiṃ ṭhānai nimuggau, bhantai’’ti| ‘‘taina hi, bhaddaji, sabrahmacārīnaṃ kaṅkhaṃ chindā’’ti| tasmiṃ khaṇai thairau satthāraṃ vanditvā iddhibalaina gantvā pāsādathūpikaṃ pādaṅgulantaraina san‍nirujjhitvā pañ‍cavīsatiyaujanaṃ pāsādaṃ gahaitvā ākāsai uppati, uppatantau ca pañ‍ñāsayaujanāni ukkhipi| athassa purimabhavai ñātakā pāsādagataina laubhaina macchakacchapamaṇḍūkā hutvā nibbattā tasmiṃ pāsādai uṭṭhahantai parivattitvā patiṃsu| satthā tai sampatantai disvā ‘‘ñātakā tai, bhaddaji, kilamantī’’ti āha| thairau satthu vacanaina pāsādaṃ vissaj‍jaisi| pāsādau yathāṭhānaiyaiva patiṭṭhahi| satthā pāraṅgatau bhikkhūhi – ‘‘kadā, bhantai, bhaddajitthairaina ayaṃ pāsādau ajjhāvuṭṭhau’’ti puṭṭhau mahāpanādajātakaṃ (jā॰ 1.3.40 ādayau) kathaitvā bahujanaṃ dhammāmataṃ pāyaisi|

98. thairau pana arahattaṃ pattau pubbasambhāraṃ saritvā saumanassajātau pubbacaritāpadānaṃ pakāsaituṃ augayhāhaṃ paukkharaṇintiādimāha| tattha augayhāhaṃ paukkharaṇinti puthunānāanaikamahaughaihi khaṇitattā ‘‘paukkharaṇī’’ti laddhanāmaṃ jalāsayaṃ augayha augahaitvā pavisitvā ajjhaugāhaitvā ghāsahaitukhādanatthāya tattha paukkharaṇiyaṃ pavisitvā  bhisaṃ padumapuṇḍarīkamūlaṃ uddharāmīti atthau| saisaṃ haiṭṭhā vuttanayattā uttānapadatthattā ca nayānusāraina suviñ‍ñaiyyamaivāti|

bhaddajitthairaapadānavaṇṇanā samattā|

9. sivakatthairaapadānavaṇṇanā

navamāpadānai  aisanāya carantassātiādikaṃ āyasmatau sivakatthairassa apadānaṃ| ayampi purimabuddhaisu katādhikārau tattha tattha bhavai vivaṭṭūpanissayāni puñ‍ñāni upacinantau vipassissa bhagavatau kālai kulagaihai nibbattitvā viñ‍ñutaṃ pattau aikadivasaṃ bhagavantaṃ piṇḍāya carantaṃ disvā pasan‍namānasau pattaṃ ādāya kummāsassa pūraitvā adāsi| sau taina puñ‍ñakammaina daivamanussaisu saṃsarantau imasmiṃ buddhuppādai rājagahai brāhmaṇakulagaihai nibbattitvā sivakautissa nāmaṃ ahausi| sau vayappattau vij‍jāsippaisu nipphattiṃ gatau naikkhammajjhāsayatāya kāmai pahāya tāpasapabbaj‍jaṃ pabbajitvā vicarantau satthāraṃ upasaṅkamitvā dhammaṃ sutvā paṭiladdhasaddhau pabbajitvā vipassanāya kammaṃ karauntau nacirassaiva arahattaṃ  pāpuṇi|

117. arahattaṃ patvā saumanassajātau attanau pubbacaritāpadānaṃ pakāsaintau aisanāya carantassātiādimāha| taṃ sabbaṃ suviñ‍ñaiyyamaivāti|

sivakatthairaapadānavaṇṇanā samattā|

10. upavānatthairaapadānavaṇṇanā

dasamāpadānai padumuttarau nāma jinautiādikaṃ āyasmatau upavānatthairassa apadānaṃ| ayaṃ kira purimabuddhaisu katādhikārau tattha tattha bhavai vivaṭṭūpanissayāni puñ‍ñāni upacinantau kainaci kammacchiddaina padumuttarassa bhagavatau kālai dal‍liddakulai nibbattitvā viñ‍ñutaṃ pattau bhagavati parinibbutai tassa dhātuṃ gahaitvā manussadaivanāgagaruḷayakkhakumbhaṇḍagandhabbaihi sattaratanamayai sattayaujanikai thūpai katai  tattha sudhautaṃ attanau uttarāsaṅgaṃ vaiḷaggai ābandhitvā dhajaṃ katvā pūjaṃ akāsi| taṃ gahaitvā abhisammatakau nāma yakkhasaināpati daivaihi caitiyapūjārakkhaṇatthaṃ ṭhapitau adissamānakāyau ākāsai dhāraintau caitiyaṃ tikkhattuṃ padakkhiṇaṃ akāsi| taṃ disvā bhiyyausaumattāya pasan‍namānasau ahausi| sau taina puñ‍ñakammaina daivamanussaisu saṃsarantau imasmiṃ buddhuppādai sāvatthiyaṃ brāhmaṇakulai nibbattitvā upavānauti laddhanāmau vayappattau jaitavanapaṭiggahaṇai buddhānubhāvaṃ disvā paṭiladdhasaddhau pabbajitvā vipassanāya kammaṃ karauntau chaḷabhiñ‍ñau ahausi| athāyasmā upavānau bhagavatau upaṭṭhākau ahausi| taina ca samayaina bhagavatau vātābādhau uppaj‍ji| thairassa gihisahāyau daivahitau nāma brāhmaṇau sāvatthiyaṃ paṭivasati| sau thairaṃ catūhi pac‍cayaihi pavāraisi| athāyasmā upavānau nivāsaitvā pattacīvaraṃ gahaitvā tassa brāhmaṇassa nivaisanaṃ upagañchi| brāhmaṇau ‘‘kainaci mañ‍ñai payaujanaina thairau āgatau bhavissatī’’ti ñatvā ‘‘vadaiyyātha, bhantai, kainatthau’’ti āha| thairau tassa brāhmaṇassa payaujanaṃ ācikkhantau –

‘‘arahaṃ sugatau laukai, vātaihābādhikau muni|

sacai uṇhaudakaṃ atthi, muninau daihi brāhmaṇa||

‘‘pūjitau pūjanaiyyānaṃ, sak‍karaiyyāna sak‍katau|

apacitaupacaiyyānaṃ, tassa icchāmi hātavai’’ti|| (thairagā॰ 185-186) –

gāthādvayaṃ abhāsi|

tassatthau – yau imasmiṃ laukai pūjanaiyyānaṃ pūjaitabbaihi sak‍kādīhi daivaihi mahābrahmādīhi ca brahmaihi pūjitau, sak‍karaiyyānaṃ sak‍kātabbaihi bimbisārakausalarājādīhi sak‍katau, apacaiyyānaṃ apacāyitabbaihi mahaisīhi khīṇāsavaihi apacitau, kilaisaihi  ārakattādinā arahaṃ, saubhanagamanādinā sugatau sabbañ‍ñū muni mayhaṃ satthā daivadaivau sak‍kānaṃ atisak‍kau brahmānaṃ atibrahmā, sau dāni vātaihi vātahaitu vātakkhaubhanimittaṃ ābādhikau jātau| sacai, brāhmaṇa, uṇhaudakaṃ atthi, tassa vātābādhavūpasamanatthaṃ taṃ hātavai upanaituṃ icchāmīti|

taṃ sutvā brāhmaṇau uṇhaudakaṃ tadanurūpaṃ vātaharañ‍ca bhaisaj‍jaṃ bhagavatau upanāmaisi| taina ca satthu raugau vūpasami| tassa bhagavā anumaudanaṃ akāsi|

122. athāyasmā upavānau aparabhāgai attanau pubbakammaṃ saritvā saumanassajātau pubbacaritāpadānaṃ pakāsaintau padumuttarau nāma jinautiādimāha| tattha padumuttarautiādīni pubbai vuttatthānaiva|

123. mahājanā samāgammāti sakalajambudīpavāsinau rāsibhūtāti atthau| citakaṃ katvāti yaujanubbaidhaṃ candanarāsicitakaṃ katvā bhagavatau sarīraṃ tattha abhiraupayiṃsūti sambandhau|

124. sarīrakic‍caṃ  katvānāti ādahanāti agginā dahanakic‍caṃ katvāti atthau|

127-28. jaṅghā maṇimayā āsīti manussaihi katathūpai jaṅghā pupphavāhatthaṃ caritaṭṭhānaṃ maṇimayā indanīlamaṇinā katāti atthau| mayampīti sabbai daivā thūpaṃ karissāmāti atthau|

129. dhātu āvaiṇikā natthīti daivamanussaihi visuṃ visuṃ caitiyaṃ kātuṃ āvaiṇikā visuṃ dhātu natthi, taṃ dassaintau sarīraṃ aikapiṇḍitanti āha| adhiṭṭhānabalaina sakalasarīradhātu aikaghanasilāmayapaṭimā viya aikamaiva ahausīti atthau| imamhi buddhathūpamhīti sakalajambudīpavāsīhi katamhi imamhi suvaṇṇathūpamhi mayaṃ sabbai samāgantvā kañ‍cukathūpaṃ karissāmāti atthau|

133. indanīlaṃ mahānīlanti indīvarapupphavaṇṇābhaṃ maṇi indanīlamaṇi| tatau adhikavaṇṇatā mahāmaṇi indanīlamaṇayau ca mahānīlamaṇayau ca jautirasamaṇijātiraṅgamaṇayau ca aikatau san‍nipātaitvā rāsī katvā suvaṇṇathūpai kañ‍cukathūpaṃ katvā achādayunti sambandhau|

144. pac‍caikaṃ  buddhasaiṭṭhassāti buddhuttamassa pati aikaṃ visuṃ uparichadanaina thūpaṃ akaṃsūti atthau|

147. kumbhaṇḍā guyhakā  tathāti kumbhamattāni aṇḍāni yaisaṃ daivānaṃ tai kumbhaṇḍā, paṭicchādaitvā niguhitvā paṭicchādanatau garuḷā guyhakā nāma jātā, tai kumbhaṇḍā guyhakāpi thūpaṃ akaṃsūti atthau|

151. atibhaunti na tassābhāti tassa caitiyassa pabhaṃ candasūriyatārakānaṃ pabhā na atibhaunti, na ajjhauttharantīti atthau|

158. ahampi kāraṃ kassāmīti tādinau laukanāthassa thūpasmiṃ ahampi kāraṃ puñ‍ñakiriyaṃ kusalakammaṃ dhajapaṭākapūjaṃ karissāmīti atthau|

upavānatthairaapadānavaṇṇanā samattā|

11. raṭṭhapālatthairaapadānavaṇṇanā

aikādasamāpadānai  padumuttarassa bhagavatautiādikaṃ āyasmatau raṭṭhapālatthairassa apadānaṃ| ayampi purimabuddhaisu katādhikārau tattha tattha bhavai vivaṭṭūpanissayāni puñ‍ñāni upacinantau padumuttarassa bhagavatau kālai tassa uppattitau puraitaramaiva haṃsavatīnagarai gahapatimahāsālakulai nibbattitvā vayappattau pitu ac‍cayaina gharāvāsai patiṭṭhitau ratanakauṭṭhāgārakammikaina dassitaṃ aparimāṇaṃ kulavaṃsānugataṃ dhanaṃ disvā ‘‘imaṃ aittakaṃ dhanarāsiṃ mayhaṃ ayyakapayyakādayau attanā saddhiṃ gahaitvā gantuṃ nāsakkhiṃsu, mayā pana gahaitvā gantuṃ vaṭṭatī’’ti cintaitvā kapaṇaddhikādīnaṃ mahādānaṃ daiti| sau abhiñ‍ñālābhiṃ aikaṃ tāpasaṃ upaṭṭhahantau taina daivalaukādhipac‍cai uyyaujitau yāvajīvaṃ puñ‍ñāni katvā tatau cutau daivau hutvā nibbatti| sau tattha daivalaukai daivaraj‍jaṃ karauntau yāvatāyukaṃ ṭhatvā tatau cutau manussalaukai bhin‍naṃ raṭṭhaṃ sandhāraituṃ samatthassa kulassa aikaputtau hutvā nibbatti| taina ca samayaina padumuttarau nāma bhagavā laukai uppaj‍jitvā pavattitavaradhammacak‍kau vainaiyyasattaṃ nibbānamahānagarasaṅkhātakhaimantabhūmiṃ sampāpaisi| atha sau kulaputtau anuk‍kamaina viñ‍ñutaṃ pattau aikadivasaṃ upāsakaihi  saddhiṃ vihāraṃ gatau satthāraṃ dhammaṃ daisaintaṃ disvā pasan‍nacittau parisapariyantai nisīdi|

taina ca samayaina satthā aikaṃ bhikkhuṃ saddhāpabbajitānaṃ aggaṭṭhānai ṭhapaisi, taṃ disvā pasan‍namānasau tadatthāya cittaṃ ṭhapaitvā satasahassabhikkhuparivārassa bhagavatau mahatā sak‍kāraina sattāhaṃ mahādānaṃ pavattaitvā paṇidhānaṃ akāsi| satthā tassa anantarāyaina  ijjhanabhāvaṃ disvā ‘‘anāgatai gautamassa nāma sammāsambuddhassa sāsanai saddhāpabbajitānaṃ aggau bhavissatī’’ti byākāsi| sau satthāraṃ bhikkhusaṅghañ‍ca vanditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pak‍kāmi| sau tattha yāvatāyukaṃ puñ‍ñāni katvā tatau cavitvā daivamanussaisu saṃsarantau itau dvānavutikappai phussassa bhagavatau kālai satthu vaimātikabhātikaisu tīsu rājaputtaisu satthāraṃ upaṭṭhahantaisu taisaṃ puñ‍ñakiriyāya sahāyakic‍caṃ akāsi| aivaṃ tattha tattha bhavai taṃ taṃ bahuṃ kusalaṃ upacinitvā sugatīsuyaiva saṃsarantau imasmiṃ buddhuppādai kururaṭṭhai thul‍lakauṭṭhikanigamai raṭṭhapālasaiṭṭhigaihai nibbatti, tassa bhin‍naṃ raṭṭhaṃ sandhāraituṃ samatthai kulai nibbattattā raṭṭhapālauti vaṃsānugatamaiva nāmaṃ ahausi| sau mahatā parivāraina vaḍḍhantau anuk‍kamaina yaubbanaṃ pattau mātāpitūhi patirūpaina dāraina saṃyaujaitvā mahantai ca yasai patiṭṭhāpitau dibbasampattisadisaṃ sampattiṃ pac‍canubhauti| atha bhagavā kururaṭṭhai janapadacārikaṃ carantau thul‍lakauṭṭhikaṃ anupāpuṇi| taṃ sutvā raṭṭhapālau kulaputtau satthāraṃ upasaṅkamitvā satthu santikai  dhammaṃ sutvā paṭiladdhasaddhau sattavārai bhattacchaidai katvā kicchaina kasiraina mātāpitarau anujānāpaitvā satthāraṃ upasaṅkamitvā pabbaj‍jaṃ yācitvā satthu āṇattiyā añ‍ñatarassa thairassa santikai pabbajitvā yaunisaumanasikāraina kammaṃ karauntau vipassanaṃ vaḍḍhaitvā arahattaṃ pāpuṇi|

179-180. athāyasmā aparabhāgai attanau pubbakammaṃ saritvā saumanassajātau pubbacaritāpadānaṃ pakāsaintau padumuttarassa bhagavatautiādimāha| sunāgau sau mayā din‍nauti tadā mahādhanasaiṭṭhi hutvā sabbaṃ sāpataiyyaṃ dānamukhai vissaj‍janasamayai sattappatiṭṭhau sundarau nāgau  hatthirājā mayā din‍nau ahausi| taṃ dassaintau īsādantautiādimāha| īsādantau rathaīsappamāṇadantau, sau mayā din‍nau hatthināgau| urūḷhavāti rājāvahanayauggasamatthau, rājārahau vā| saitacchattauti alaṅkāratthāya upaṭṭhahanasaitacchattasahitauti atthau| pasaubhitauti ārauhapariṇāhavā rūpasaubhāhi sampan‍nauti atthau| sakappanau sahatthipauti hatthialaṅkārasahitau hatthigaupakasahitauti atthau| itthambhūtau hatthināgau padumuttarassa bhagavatau mayā din‍nauti atthau|

181. mayā bhattaṃ kāraitvānāti mayā kārāpitavihārai vasantānaṃ kauṭisaṅkhānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ nic‍cabhattaṃ paṭṭhapaitvā mahaisinau niyyādaisinti sambandhau|

183. jalajuttamanāmakauti  jalatau jātau jalajau, kiṃ taṃ? padumaṃ, padumaina samānanāmattā uttamattā ca padumuttarau nāma bhagavāti atthau| saisaṃ sabbattha uttānatthamaivāti|

raṭṭhapālatthairaapadānavaṇṇanā samattā|

chappañ‍ñāsamamahāvaggavaṇṇanā samattā|

iti visuddhajanavilāsiniyā apadāna-aṭṭhakathāya

aittāvatā buddhapac‍caikabuddhasāvakatthairāpadāna-aṭṭhakathā samattā|

nigamanakathā

sīhaḷadīpakai  appicchatādiguṇavantānaṃ thairavaṃsappadīpānaṃ ānandatthairādīnaṃ sabbasattānaṃ taṇhāmānadiṭṭhādayau chaidananiggahavivaicanādyatthaṃ sattahi māsaihi ativiya ārādhanaina laddhakausal‍laina baudhisambhāraṃ gavaisantaina satidhitigativīriyaparak‍kamantaina mahāsamantaguṇasaubhanaina tipiṭakadharaina paṇḍitaina ābhataṃ imaṃ apadāna-aṭṭhakathaṃ sabbau sadaivalaukau jānātūti|

anaina laubhādimalā pajānaṃ, cakkhādiraugā vividhā ca dukkhā|

kalahādibhayā dukkhitā jātā, caurādayaunatthakarā ca laukai||

nassantu mai pañ‍ca vairā ca pāpā, nassantu gimhai yathā vuṭṭhivātā|

aṭṭhaṅgikamaggavaraina patvā, nibbānapuraṃ paṭipādayāmi||

sabbadiṭṭhiñ‍ca maddantau, rāgadausādipāpakai|

saṃsāravaṭṭaṃ chinditvā, upaimi saggamaukkhakai||

āṇākhaittamhi  sabbattha, avīcimhi bhavaggatau|

sabbai dhammānuyāyantu, tayau laukā utupi cāti||

apadāna-aṭṭhakathā samattā|
